text.body: <1> ||śrīḥ|| ||siddhāntaleśasaṅgrahākhyo'yaṃ granthaḥ|| adhigatabhidā pūrvācāryānupetya sahastradhā saridiva mahībhedān samprāpta śauripadodgatā| jayati bhagavatpādaśrīmanmukhāmbujanirgatā jananaharaṇī sūktirbrahmāhvayaikaparāyaṇā||1|| prācīnairvyavahārasiddhaviṣayeṣvātmaikyasiddhau paraṃ sannahyadbhiranādarātsaraṇayo nānāvidhā darśitāḥ| tanmūlāniha saṅgraheṇa katicitsiddhāntabhedāndhiyaśśuddhayai skalayāmi tātacaraṇavyākhyāvacaḥkhyāpitān||2|| teṣūpapādanāpekṣān pakṣān prāyo yathāmati| yuktyopapādayanneva likhāmyanativistaram||3|| tatra tāvat "ātmā vā are draṣṭavyaḥ śrotavyo mantavyaḥ" iti adhītasāṅgasvādhyāyasya vedāntairāpātapratipanne brahmātmani samuditajijñāsasya tajjñānāya vedāntaśravaṇe vidhiḥ pratīyamānaḥ kiṃvidha iti cintyate| tistraḥ khalu vidhervidhāḥ apūrvavidhiḥ, niyamavidhiḥ, parisaṅkhyāvidhiśceti| tatra kālatraye'pi kathamapyaprāptasya prāptiphalako vidhirādyaḥ| yathā "vrīhīnprokṣati" iti| nātra vrīhīṇāṃ prokṣaṇasya saṃskārakarmaṇo vināniyogaṃ mānāntareṇa kathamapi prāptisasti| pakṣaprāptasyāprāptāṃśaparipūraṇaphalako vidhirdvitīyaḥ| yathā "vrīhīnavahanti" iti| atra vidhyabhāve'pi puroḍāśaprakṛtidravyāṇāṃ vrīhīṇāṃ taṇḍulaniṣpattyākṣepādevāvahananaprāptirbhaviṣyatīti na tatprāptyartho'yaṃ vidhiḥ, kintvākṣepādavahananaprāptau tadvadeva lokāvagatakāraṇatvāviśeṣāt nakhavidalanādirapi pakṣe prāpnuyāditi avahananāprāptāṃśasya sambhavāt sadaṃśaparipūraṇaphalakaḥ| dvayoḥ śeṣiṇorekasya śeṣasya vā ekasmiñcheṣiṇi dvayoḥ śeṣayorvā nityaprāptai śeṣyantarasya śeṣāntarasya vā nivṛttiphalako vidhistṛtīyaḥ| yathā agnicayane "imāmagṛbhṇannaśanāmṛtasyetyaśvābhidhānīmādattaṃ" iti, yathā vā cāturmāsyāntargateṣṭiviśeṣe gṛhamedhīye gṛhamedhīye "ājyabhāgau yajati" iti| agnicayane aśvaraśanāgrahaṇaṃ gardabharaśanāgrahaṇaṃ ceti dvayamanuṣṭheyam| tatrāśvaraśanāgrahaṇe "imāmagṛbhṇan" iti mantro liṅgādeva raśanāgrahaṇaprakāśanasāmarthyarūpānnityaṃ prāpnotīti na tatprāptyarthaḥ, tadaprāptāṃśaparipūraṇārtho vā vidhiḥ, kiṃ tu liṅgāviśeṣāt gardabharaśanāgrahaṇe'pi mantraḥ prāpnuyāditi tannivṛttyarthaḥ| tathā gṛhamedhīyasya darśapūrṇamāsaprakṛtikatvādatideśādevājyabhāgau nityaṃ prāpnuta iti na tatra vidhiḥ tatprāptyarthaḥ, tanniyamārtho vā kintvatideśāt prayājādikamapi prāpnuyāditi tannivṛttyarthaḥ| gṛhamedhīyādhikaraṇapūrvapakṣarītyedamudāharaṇaṃ yatra kkacidudāhartavyamityudāhṛtam| na ca niyamavidhāvapi pakṣaprāptāvahananasyāprāptāṃśaparipūraṇe kṛte tadavaruddhatvāt pākṣikasādhanāntarasya nakhavidalanādernivṛttirapi labhyata itītaranivṛttiphalakatvāviśeṣānniyamaparisaṅkhyayoḥ phalato viveko na yukta iti śaṅkyam| vidhito'vahanananiyamaṃ vinā ākṣopalabhyasya nakhavidalanādernivartayitumaśakyatayā aprāptāṃśaparipūraṇarūpasya niyamasya prāthamyāt vidheyāvahananagatatvena pratyāsannatvācca tasyaiva niyamavidhiphalatvopagamāt| tadanuniṣpādinyā avidheyagatatvena viprakṛṣṭāyā itaranivṛtteḥ sānnikṛṣṭaphalasambhave phalatvānaucityāt| evaṃ viviktāsu tisṛṣu vidhāsu kiṃvidhaḥ śravaṇavidhirāśrīyate| atra prakaṭārthakārādayaḥ kecidāhuḥ apūrvavidhirayam| aprāptatvāt| na hi `vedāntaśravaṇaṃ brahmasākṣātkārahetuḥ'ityatra anvayavyatirekapramāṇamasti| loke kṛtaśravaṇasyāpi bahuśastadanutpatteḥ, akṛtaśrahavaṇasyāpi garbhagatasya vāmadevasya tadutpatterubhayato vyabhicārāt| na vā `śravaṇamātraṃ śotavyārthasākṣātkārahetuḥ' iti śāstrāntaraśravaṇe gṛhītaḥ sāmānyaniyamo'sti| yenātra viśiṣya hetutvagrāhakābhāve'pi sāmānyamukhenaiva hetutvaṃ prāpyata ityāśaṅkyeta| gāndharvādiśāstraśravaṇasya ṣaḍjādisākṣātkārahetutvābhyupagame'pi karmakāṇḍādiśravaṇāt tadarthadhaऱmādisākṣātkārādarśanena vyabhicārāt| tasmādapūrvavidhirevāyam| bhāṣye'pi "sahakāryantaravidhiḥ pakṣeṇa tṛtīyaṃ tadvato vidhyādivat" ityadhikaraṇe "vidyāsahakāriṇo maunasya bālyapāṇḍityavādvidhirevāśrayitavyaḥ apūrvatvād" iti pāṇḍityaśabdaśabdite śravaṇe apūrvavidhirevāṅgīkriyate iti| anyetu vedāntaśravaṇasya nityāparokṣabrahmasākṣātkārahetutvaṃ na aprāptam| aparokṣavastuviṣayakapramāṇatvāvacchedena sākṣātkārahetutvasya prāpteḥ śābdāparokṣavāde vyavasthāpanāt| tadarthameva hi tatprstāvaḥ| na ca tāvatā brahmapramāṇatvenāpātadarśanasādhāraṇabrahmasākṣātkārahetutvaprāptāvapi avidyānivṛttyarthamiṣyamāṇasattāniścayarūpatatsākṣātkārahetutvaṃ śravaṇasya na prāptamiti vācyam| vicāramātrasya vicāryanirṇayahetutvasya, brahmapramāṇasya tatsākṣātkārahetutvasya ca prāptau vicāritavedāntaśabdajñānarūpasya śravaṇasya taddhetutvapārpateḥ| na cokta ubhayato vyabhicāraḥ, sahakārivaikalyenānvayavyabhicārasyādoṣatvāt| jātismarasya janmāntaraśravaṇāt phalasambhavena vyatirekavyabhicārābhāvāt| anyathā viyabhicāreṇaiva hetutvabādhe śrutyā'pi tatsādhanatājñānāsambhavāt| ghaṭasākṣātkāre cakṣuratirekeṇa tvagindriyamiva brahmasākṣarātkāre śravaṇātirekeṇa upāyāntaramastītiśaṅkāyā vyatirekavyabhicārasyāpyadoṣatvātū| katathā ca prāptatvānnapūrvavidhiḥ| ata eva "āvṛttirasatṛdupadeśāt" ityadhikaraṇabhāṣye "darśanaparyavasānāni he śravaṇādīnyāvartyamānāni dṛṣṭārthāni bhavanti| yathā'vaghātādīni taṇḍulaniṣpattiparyavasānāni" iti śravaṇasya brahmadarśanārthasya dṛṣṭārthatayā dārśapūrṇamāsikāvaghātanyāyaprāptāvāvṛttayupadeśaḥ| apūrvavidhitve tu sa na saṅgacchate sarvauṣadhāvaghātavat| agnicayane "sarvauṣadhasya pūrayitvā'vahanti athaitadupadadhāti" ityupadheyolūkhalasaṃskārārthatvena vihitasyāvaghātasya dṛṣṭārthatvābhāvānnāvṛttiriti hi tantralakṣaṇe sthitam| ato niyamavidhirevāyam| tadabhāve hi yathā vastu kiñciccakṣuṣā vīkṣamāṇastatra svāgṛhīte sūkṣme viśeṣāntare kenacit kathite tadavagamāya tasyaiva cakṣuṣaḥ punarapi sapraṇidhānaṃ vyāpāre pravartate, evaṃ manasā `aham' itigṛhyamāṇe jīve vedāntairadhyayanagṛhītairupadiṣṭaṃ nirviśeṣabrahmaṭacaitanyarūpatvamākarṇya tadavagaprāya tatra sāvadhānaṃ manasa eva praṇidhāne kadācit puruṣaḥ pravarteteti vedāntaśravaṇe pravṛttiḥ pākṣikī syāt| "aprāpya manasā saha" iti śrutiḥ "manasaivānudraṣṭavyam" "dṛśyate tvagtyayā buddhyā" ityapi śravaṇenānavahitamanoviṣayeti śaṅkāsambhavāt| athavā "juṣṭaṃ yadā paśyatyanyamīśamasya sahimānamiti vītaśokaḥ" ityādiśravaṇāt bhinnātmajñānānmuktiriti bhramasambhavena muktisādhanajñānāya bhinnātmavicārarūpe śāstrantaraśravaṇe'pi pakṣe pravṛttissyādityadvaitātmaparevadāntaśravaṇaniyamāvidhirayamastu| ihātmaśabdasya "idaṃ sarvaṃ yadayamātmā" ityādi prakaraṇaparyālocanayā advitīyātmaparatvāt| na hi vastusatsādhanāntaraprāptāveva niyamavidhiriti kuladharmaḥ| yena vedāntaśravaṇaniyamārthavattvāya niyamādṛṣṭajanyasvapratibandhakakalmaṣanivṛttidvārā sattāniścayarūpabrahamasākṣātkārasya vedāntaśrahavaṇaikasādhyatvasyābhyupagantavyatvena tatra vastutaḥ sādhanāntarābhāvānna niyamavidhiryujyata iti āśaṅkayeta| kiṃ tu yatra sādhanāntaratayā sāmbhāvyamānasya pakṣe prāptyā, vidhitsitasādhanasya pākṣikyaprāptirnivārayituṃ na śakyate, tatra niyamavidhiḥ| tāvataivāprāptāṃśaparipūraṇasya tatphalasya siddheḥ| athavā gurumukhādhīnādhyayanādiva nipuṇasya svaprayatnamātrasādhyādapi vedān,tavicārāt sambhavati sattāniścayarūpaṃ brahmaparokṣajñānam, kintu gurumukhādhīnavedāntavākyaśravaṇaniyamādṛṣṭamavidyānivṛttiṃ prati kalmaṣanirāsenopayujyata iti tadabhāvena pratibaddhamavidyāmanivartayat parokṣajñānakalpamavatiṣṭhate | na ca jñānodaye ajñānānivṛttyanupapattiḥ| pratibandhakābhāvasya sarvatrāpekṣitatvena satyapi pratyakṣaviśeṣadarśane upādhinā pratibandhat pratibimbabhramānivṛttivat tadanivṛttyupapatteḥ| evaṃ ca likhitapāṭhādinā'pi svādhyāyagrahaṇaprasaktau gurumukhādhīnādhyayananiyamavidhivat svaprayatnamātrapūrvakasyāpi vedāntavicārasya sattāniścayarūpabrahmasākṣātkārārthatvena pakṣe prāptau gurumukhādhīnaśravaṇaniyamavidhirayamastu| na ca "tadvijñānārthaṃ sa gurumevābhigacchet" iti gurupasadanavidhinaiva gururahitavicāravyāvṛttisiddherviphalo niyamavidhiriti śaṅkyam| gurupasadanasya śravaṇāṅgatayāṃ śravaṇavidhyabhāve tadvidhireva nāstīti tena tasya vaiphalyāprasakte| anyathā adhyayanāṅgabhūtopagamanavidhinaiva likhitapāṭhādivyāvṛttirityadhyayananiyamo'pi viphalassyāt| athavā advaitātmaparabhāṣāprabandhaśravaṇasya pakṣe prāptyā vedāntaśravaṇe niyamavidhirastu| na ca "na mlecchitatrai" ityādiniṣedhādeva tadaprāptiḥ| śāstravyutpattimāndyāt vedānśravaṇamaśakyamiti puruṣārthaniṣedhamullaṅdhyāpi bhāṣāprabandheñādvaitaṃ jijñāsamānasya tatra pravṛttisambhavena niyamavidherarthavattvopapatteḥ| abhyupagamyate hi kartradhikaraṇe vyutpāditaṃ puruṣārthe anṛtavadananiṣedhe satyapi darśapūrṇamāsamadhye kutaściddhetoraṅgīkṛtaniṣedhollaṅghanasyāvikalāṃ kratusiddhiṃ kāmayamānasyānṛtavadane pravṛttissyāditi punaḥ kratvarthatayā darśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇe "nānṛnaṃ vadet" iti niṣedha iti kratvarthatayā niṣedhasyārthavattvam| yadvā yathā `mantraireva mantārthasmṛtiḥ sādhyā' iti niyamaḥ| tanmūlakalpasūtrātmīyagrahaṇakavākyādīnāmapi pakṣe prāpteḥ tathā vedāntamūletihāsapurāṇapauruṣeyaprabandhānāmapi pakṣe prāptisambhavānniyamo'yamastu| sarvathā niyamavidhirevāyam| `sahakāryantaravidhiḥ' ityadhikaraṇabhāṣye apūrvavidhitvoktistu niyamavidhitve'pi pākṣikāprāptisidbhāvāt tadabhiprāyeti tatraiva "pakṣeṇa" iti pākṣikāprāptikathanaparasūtrapadayojanena spaṣṭīkṛtamiti vivaraṇānusāriṇaḥ| kṛtaśravaṇasya prathamaṃ śabdannirvicikitsaṃ parokṣajñānamevotpadyate| śabdasya parokṣajñānajananasvābhāvyena klṛptasāmarthyānatilaṅghanāt| paścāttu kṛtamanananididhyāsanasya sahakāriviśeṣasampannāt tata evāparokṣajñānaṃ jāyate| tattāṃśagocarajñānajananāsamarthasyāpīndriyasya tatsamarthasaṃskārasāhityāt pratyabhijñānajanakatvavat svato'parokṣajñānanāsamarthasyāpi śabdasya vidhuraparibhāvitakāminīsākṣātkārasthale tatsamarthatvena klṛptabhāvanāpracayasāhityādaparokṣajñānajanakatvaṃ yuktam| tataśca śabdasya svataḥ svaviṣaye parokṣajñānajanakatvasya bhāvanāpracayasahakṛtajñānakaraṇatvāvacchedena vidhurāntaḥkaraṇavadaparokṣajñānajanakatvasya ca prāptatvāt pūrvavanniyamavidhiriti tadekadeśinaḥ|| vedāntaśravamena na brahmasākṣātkāraḥ, kintu manasaiva| "manasaivānudraṣṭavyam" iti śruteḥ| "śāstrācāryopadeśaśamadamādisaṃskṛtaṃ mana ātmadarśane karaṇam" iti gītābhāṣyavacanācca| śravaṇaṃ tu nirvicikitsapokṣajñānārthamiti tādarthyenaiva niyamavidhiriti kecit| aparokṣajñānārthatvenaiva śravaṇe niyamavidhiḥ| "dvaṣṭavyaḥ" iti phalakīrtināt| tādarthyaṃ ca tasya karaṇabhūtamanaḥsahakāritayaiva, na sākṣāt| śabdādaparokṣajñānānaṅgīkaraṇāt| na ca tasya tena rūpeṇa tādarthyaṃ na prāptamityapūrvavidhitvaprasaṅgaḥ| śrāvaṇeṣu ṣaḍjādiṣu samāropitaparasparāvivekanivṛttyartha gāndharvaśāstraśravaṇasahakṛtaśrotreṇa parasparāsaṅkīrṇatadyāthārthyāparokṣyadarśanena prakāśamāne varatunyāropitāvivekanivṛttyarthaśāstrasadbhāve tacchravaṇaṃ tatsākṣātkārajanakendriyasahakāribhāvenopayujyate ityasya klṛptatvādityapare|| vedāntavākyānāmadvitīye brahmaṇi tātparyanirṇayānukūlanyāyavicārātmakacetovṛttiviśeṣarūpasya śravaṇasya na brahmaṇi parokṣamaparokṣaṃ vā jñānaṃ phalam| tasya śabdādipramāṇaphalatvāt| na coktarūpavicārāvadhāritatātparyaviśiṣṭaśābdajñānameva śravaṇamastu tasya brahmajñānaṃ phalaṃ yujyata iti vācyam| jñāne vidhyanupapatteḥ| śravaṇavidhervicārakartavyatāvidhāyakajijñāsāsūtramūlatvopagamācca| śravaṇavidhervicārikartavyatāvidhāyakajijñāsāsūtramūlatvopagamācca ūhāpohātmakamānasakriyārūpavicārasyaiva śravaṇatvaucityāt| na ca vicārasyaiva tātparyanirṇayadvārā, tajjanyatātparyabhramādipuruṣāparādharūpapratibandhakavigamadvārā vā brahamajñānaṃ phalamastviti vācyam| tātparyajñānasya śābdajñāne kāraṇatvānupagamāt, kārye kvacidapi prātibandhakābhāvasya kāraṇatvānupagamācca tayordvāratvānupapatteḥ| brahmajñānasya vicārarūpātiriktakāraṇajanyatve tatprāmāṇyasya paratastvāpatteśca| tasmāttātparyanirṇayadvārā puruṣāparādhanirāsārthatvenaiva vicārarūpe śravaṇe niyamavidhiḥ| "draṣṭavyaḥ" iti tu darśanārhatvena stutimātram, na śravaṇaphalasaṅkīrtanamiti saṅkṣepaśārīrakānusāriṇaḥ|| brahmajñānārthaṃ vedāntaśravaṇe pravṛttasya cikitsājñānārthaṃ carakasuśrutādiśravaṇe pravṛttasyeva madhye vyāpārāntare'pi pravṛttiḥ prasajyata iti tannivṛttiphalakaḥ "śrotavyaḥ" iti parisaṅkhyāvidhiḥ| "brahmasaṃstho'mṛtatvameti" iti chāndegyeṃ ananyavyāpāratvasya muktyupāyatvāvadhāraṇātsampūrvasya tiṣṭhateḥ sāmāptivācitayā brahmasaṃsthāśabdaśabditāyā brahmaṇi samāpterananyavyāpārarūpatvāt| "tamevaikaṃ jānatha anyā vāco vimuñcatha" ityātharvaṇe kaṇṭhata eva vyāpārāntarapratiṣedhācca| "āsupterāmṛteḥ kālaṃ nayedvedāntacintayā" ityādismṛteśca| na ca brahmajñānānupayogino vyāpārāntarasya ekasmini sādhye śravaṇena saha samuccitya prāptyabhāvānna tannivṛttyarthaḥ parisaṅkhyāvidhiryujyate iti vācyam| "sahakāryantaravidhiḥ" ityādisūtre `yasmāt pakṣe bhedadarśanaprābalyānna prāpnoti, tasmānniyamavidhiḥ' iti tadbhāṣye ca kṛtaśravaṇasya śābdajñānamātrāt kṛtakṛtyātāṃ manvānasyāvidyānivartakasākṣātkāropayogini nidhidhyāsane pravṛttirna syādini atatsādhanapakṣaprāptimātreṇa nididhyāsane niyamavidherabhyupagatatayā tannyāyenāsādhanasya samuccitya prāptāvapi tannivṛttiphalakasya parisaṅkhyāvidheḥ sambhavāditi| niyamaḥ parisaṅkhyā vā vidhyartho'tra bhavedyataḥ|| anātmādarśanenaiva parātmānamupāsmahe ||1|| iti vārtikavacanānusāriṇaḥ kecidāhuḥ|| "ātmā śrotavyaḥ" iti mananādivat ātmavipayakatvena nibadhyamānaṃ śravaṇamāgamācāryopadeśajanyamātma jñānameva, na tu tātparyavicārarūpamiti na tatra ko'pi vidhiḥ| ata eva samanvayasūtre ātmajñānavidhinirākaraṇānantaraṃ bhāṣyam `kimarthāni tarhi "ātmā vā are draṣṭavyaḥ śrotavyaḥ" ityādīni vacanāni vidhicchāyāni? svābhāvikapravṛttiviṣayavimukhīkaraṇārthānīni vrūmaḥ' ityādi| yadi ca vedāntatātparyavicārarūpaṃ śravaṇaṃ tadā tasya tātparyanirṇayadvārā vedāntatātparyabhramasaṃśayarūpapratibandhakanirāsa eva phalaṃ, na pratibandhakāntaranirāso brahmāvagamo vā| tatphalakatvaṃ ca tasya lokata eva prāptam| sādhanāntaraṃ ca kiñcidvikalpya samuccitya vā na prāptamiti na tatra vidhitrayasyāpyavakāśaḥ| vicāravidhyabhāve'pi vijñānārthatayā vidhīyamānaṃ gurūpasadanaṃ dṛṣṭadvārasambhave adṛṣṭakalpanāyogāt gurubhukhādhīnavedāntavicāradvāraiva vijñānārthaṃ paryavasyatīti| ata eva svaprayatnasādhyavicāravyāvṛttiḥ| adhyayanavidhyabhāve tūpagamanaṃ vidhīyamānamakṣārāvāptyarthatvenāvidhīyamānatvānna tadarthaṃ gurumukhoccāraṇānūccāraṇamadhyayanaṃ dvārīkarotīti likhitapāṭhādivyāvṛttyasiddheḥ saphalo'dhyayananiyamavidhiḥ| na ca tātparyādibhramanirāsāya vidāntavicārārthinaḥ kadācit dvaitaśāstre'pi pravṛttiḥ syāt| tatrāpi tadabhimatayojanayā vedāntavicārasattvāt ityadvaitātmaparavedāntavicāraniyamavidhirarthavāniti vācyam| svayameva tātparyabhramahetostasya tannirāsakatvābhāvena sādhanāntaraprāptyabhāvāt| tannirāsakatvabhrameṇa tatrāpi kasyācitpravṛttiḥ syādityetāvatā "śrotavyaḥ" iti niyamavidherabhyupagama ityapi na| īśvarānugrahaphalādvaitaśraddhārahitasya śrotavyavākye'pi parabhimatayojanayā sadvitīyātmavicāravidhiparatvabhramasambhavena bhramaprayuktāyā anyatra pravṛttervidhiśatenāpyaparihāryatvāt| na ca vyāpārāntaranivṛttyarthā parisaṅkhyeti vācyam asannyāsino vyāpārāntaranivṛtteraśakyātvāt| sannyāsinastannivṛtteḥ brahmasaṃsthayā saha sannyāsavidhāyakena "brahmasaṃstho'mṛtatvameti" iti śrutyantareṇa siddhatayā sannyāsavidhāyakaśrutyantaramapekṣya śrotavyavākyena tasya vyāpārāntaranivṛttyupadeśasya vyarthatvāt| na ca vicāravidhyasambhave'pi vicāraviṣayavedāntaniyamavidhiḥ sambhavati, bhāṣāprabandhādivyāvartyasattvāditi saṅkyam| sannidhānādeva vedāntaniyamasya labdhatvena vidhiviṣayatvāyogāt, "svādhyāyo'dhyetavyaḥ" ityarthāvabodhārthaniyamavidhibalādevādhyayanagṛhītavedotpāditaṃ vedārthajñānaṃ phalaparyavasāyi, na kāraṇāntarotpāditamityasyārthasya labdhatvena vedārthe brahmaṇi mokṣāya jñātavye bhāṣāprabandhādīnāmaprāpteśca| na ca `sahakāryantaravidhiḥ' ityadhikaraṇe bālyapāṇḍityamaunaśabditeṣu śravaṇamanananididhyāsaneṣu vidhirabhyupagata iti vācyam| vicāre vicāryyatātparyanirṇahetutvasya vastusidhdyanukūlayuktyanusandhānarūpe manane tatpratyayābhyāsarūpe nididhyāsane ca vastvavagamavaiśadyahetutvasya ca lokasiddhatvena teṣu vidhyanapekṣaṇāt vidhicchāyārthavādasyeva praśaṃsādvārā pravṛttyati śayakaratvamātreṇa tatra vidhivyavahārāt| evaṃ ca śravaṇavidhyabhāvāt karmakāṇḍavicāravat brahmakāṇḍavicāro'pyadhyayanavidhimūla ityācāryavācaspatipakṣānusāriṇaḥ||1|| vicāryasya ca brahmaṇaḥ jagajjanmasthitilayakāraṇatvaṃ lakṣaṇamuktaṃ "yato vā imāni bhūtāni jāyante" ityādiśrutyā| jagajjanmasthitilayeṣu ekaikakāraṇatvamapyananyagāmitvāllakṣaṇaṃ bhavitumarhatīti cet satyam| lakṣaṇatrayamevedaṃ parasparanirapekṣam| ata eva `attā carācaragrahaṇāt' ityādyadhikaraṇeṣu sarvasaṃhartṛtvādikaṃ brahmaliṅgatayopanyastamiti kaumudīkāraḥ| anye tu janmakāraṇatvasya sthitikāraṇatvasya ca nimittakāraṇasādhāraṇyāt upādānatvapratyāyanāya prapañcasya brahmaṇi layo darśitaḥ| astu brahma jagadupādānaṃ, tajjanmani ghaṭajanmani kulālavat, tatsthitau rājyasthemani rājavacca upādānādanyadeva nimittaṃ bhaviṣyatīti śaṅkāvyavacchedāya tasyaiva jagajjananajīvananiyāmakatvamuktam| tathācaikamevedaṃ lakṣaṇam abhinninimittopādānatayā'dvitīyaṃ brahmopalakṣayatītyāhuḥ||2|| brahmaṇaśca upādānatvam advitīyakūṭasthacaitanyarūpasya na paramāṇūnāmivārambhakatvarūpaṃ, na vā prakṛteriva pariṇāmitvarūpaṃ, kiṃ tvavidyayā viyadādiprapañcarūpeṇa vivartamānatvalakṣaṇam| vstunastatsamasattāko'nyathābhāvaḥ pariṇāmaḥ, tadasamasattāko vivarta iti vā; kāraṇasalakṣaṇo'nyathābhāvaḥ pariṇāmaḥ, tadvilakṣaṇo vivarta iti vā; kāraṇābhinnaṃ kāryaṃ pariṇāmaḥ, tadabhedaṃ vinaiva tavdyatirekeṇa durvacaṃ kāryaṃ vivartaḥ iti vā vivartapariṇāmayorviveka||3|| atha śuddhaṃ brahma upādānamiṣyate, īśvararūpaṃ, jīvarūpaṃ vā| atra saṅkṣepaśārīrakānusāriṇaḥ kecidāhuḥ śuddhamevopādānam| janmādisūtratadbhāṣyayorupādānatvasya jñeyabrahmalakṣaṇatvokteḥ| tathā ca "ātmana ākāśassambhataḥ" ityādikāraṇavākyeṣu śabalavācināmātmādiśabdānāṃ śuddhe lakṣaṇaiveti|| vivaraṇānusāriṇastu "yassarvajñassarvavit yasya jñānamayaṃ tapaḥ| tasmādetat brahma nāma rūpamannaṃ ca jāyate" iti śruteḥ sarvajñatvādiviśiṣṭaṃ māyāśabalamīśvararūpameva brahma upādānam| ata eva bhāṣye `antastaddharmopadeśāt' `sarvatra prasiddhopadeśāt' ityādyadhikaraṇeṣu "saiva ṛk tatsāma tadukthaṃ tadyajustad brahma sarvakarmā sarvakāmaḥ sarvagandhaḥ sarvarasaḥ" ityādiśrutyuktaṃ sarvopādānatvaprayuktaṃ sarvātmakatvaṃ jīvavyāvṛttamīśvaraliṅgamityupavarṇitam| jīveśvarānusyūtacaitanyamātrasya sarvopādānatve tu na tajjīvavyāvṛttamīśvarāliṅgaṃ syāt| saṅkṣepaśarīrake śabalopādānatvanirākaraṇamapi māyāviśiṣṭopādānatvanirākaraṇābhiprāyam, na tu niṣkṛṣṭeśvararūpacaitanyopādānatvanirākaraṇaparam| tatraiva prathamādhyāyānte jagadupādānatvasya tatpadārthavṛttitvokteḥ| evaṃ ca īśvaragatamapi kāraṇatvaṃ tadanugatamakhaṇḍacaitanyaṃ śāsvācandramasamiva taṭasthatayopalakṣayituṃ śaknotīti tasya jñeyabrahmalakṣaṇatvoktiriti manyante|| viyadādiprapañca īśvarāśritamāyāpariṇāma iti tatreśvara upādānam| antaḥkaraṇādikaṃ tu īśvarāśritamāyāpariṇāmamahābhūtopasṛṣṭajīvāvidyākṛtabhūtasūkṣmakāryamiti tatrobhayorupādānatvam| ata eva "evamevāsya paridraṣṭurimāṣṣoḍaśakalāḥ puruṣāyaṇāḥ puruṣaṃ prāpyāstaṃ gacchanti" iti śrutau kalāśabdavācyānāṃ prāṇamanaḥ prabhṛtīnāṃ viduṣo videhakaivalyasamaye vidyānivartyāvidyākāryāśābhiprāyeṇa vidyāyocchedo darśitaḥ| "gatāḥ kalāḥ pañcadaśa pratiṣṭhāḥ" iti śrutyantare tadanivartyamāyākāryamahābhūtapariṇāmarūpoṣaṣṭambhakāṃśābhiprāyeṇa teṣāṃ svasvaprakṛtiṣu layo darśita iti māyā'vidyābhedavādinaḥ|| yathā viyadādiprapañca īśvarāśritamāyāpariṇāma iti tatra āśvara upādānam, tathā'ntaḥkaraṇādi jīvāśritāvidyāmātrapariṇāma iti tatra jīva eva upādānam| na cāntaḥkaraṇādau māyākāryamahābhūtānāmapyananupraveśe udāhṛtaśrutidvayavyavasthā'nupapattiḥ| kalānāṃ vidyayocchedaśrutistattvaviddṛṣṭiviṣayā| "gatāḥ kalāḥ" iti śrutistu tattvavidi mriyamāṇe samīpavārtinaḥ puruṣāḥ naśyadghaṭavattadīyaśarīrādīnāmapi bhūmyādiṣu layaṃ manyante iti taṭasthapuruṣapratītiviṣayeti vyavasthāyāḥ kalālayādhikaraṇabhāṣye spaṣṭatvāt, iti māyā'vidyābhedavādiṣvekadeśinaḥ|| tadabhedavādiṣvapi kecit yadyapi viyadādiprapañcasya īśvara upādānam, tathā'pyantaḥkaraṇādīnāṃ jīvatādātmyapratīteḥ jīva evopādānam| ata evādhyāsabhāṣye antaḥkaraṇādīnāṃ jīve evādhyāso darśitaḥ| vivaraṇe ca pratikarmavyavasthāyāṃ brahmacaitanyasyopādānatayā ghaṭādisaṅgitvam, jīvacaitanyasya tadasaṅgitve'pyantaḥkaraṇādisaṅgitvaṃ ca varṇitamityāhuḥ|| "etasmājjāyate prāṇo manassarvendriyāṇi ca| svaṃ vāyurjyotirāpaḥ pṛthivī viśvasya dhāriṇī"|| ityādiśruteḥ kṛtstravyāvahārikaprapañcasya brahmaiva upādānam| jīvastu prātibhāsikasya svapnaprapañcasya ca| `kṛtstraprasaktirnirakyavatvaśabdakopo vā' ityadhikaraṇe brahmaṇo jagadupādānatve tasya kārtsnyena jagadākāreṇa pariṇāme vikarātirekeṇa brahmābhāvo vā, ekādeśena pariṇāme niravayavatvaśrutivirodho vā prasajyate iti pūrvapakṣe `ātmani caivaṃ vicitrāśca hi' iti satreṇa vivartavādābhiprāyeṇa svapnadṛśi jīvātmani svarūpānupamardanenānekākārasvāpnaprapañcasṛṣṭivat brahmaṇi viyadādisṛṣṭirupapadyate iti siddhāntitatvādityanye|| jīva eva svapnadraṣṭṛvat svasminnīśvaratvādisarvakalpakatvena sarvakāparaṇam ityapi kecit ||4|| atha "māyāṃ tu prakṛtiṃ vidyāt" iti śruteḥ, māyājāḍyasya ghaṭādiṣvanugamācca māyā jagadupādānaṃ pratīyate, kathaṃ brahmopādānam?| atrāhuḥ padārthatattvanirṇayakārāḥ brahma māyā cetyubhayamupādānamityubhayaśrutyupapattiḥ, sattājāḍyarūpobhayadharmānugatyupapattiśca| tatra brahma vivartamānatayopādānam, avidyā pariṇamānatayā| na ca vivartādhiṣṭhāne pāribhāṣikamupādānatvam| svātmani kāryajanihetutvasyopādānalakṣaṇasya tatrāpyaviśeṣāditi|| kecit uktāmeva prakriyāmāśritya vivartapariṇāmopādānadvayasādhāraṇamanyallakṣamāhuḥ svābhinnakāryajanakatvamupādānatvam| asti ca prapañcasya sadrūpeṇa brahmaṇā vivartamānena jaḍenājñānena pariṇāminā cābhedaḥ| `san ghaṭaḥ, jaḍo ghaṭaḥ' iti sāmānādhikaraṇyānubhavāt| na ca `tadananyatvamārambhaṇaśabdādibhyaḥ' iti sūtre `ananyatva vyatirekeṇābhāvaḥ| na khalvananyatvamityabhedaṃ brūmaḥ, kintu? bhedaṃ vyāsedhāmaḥ' iti bhāṣyabhāmatīnibrandhanābhyāṃ prapañcasya brahmābhedaniṣedhādabhedābhyupagame upasiddhānta iti vācyam| tayorbrahmarūpadharmisamānasattākābhedaniṣedhe tātparyeṇa śuktirajatayoriva prātītikābhedābhyupagame'pi virodhābhāvāditi|| saṅkṣepaśārīrakakṛtastu brahmaivopādānam|kūṭasthasya svataḥ kāraṇatvānupapatteḥ māyā dvārakāraṇam| akāraṇamapi dvāraṃ kārye'nugacchati| mṛda iva tadgataślakṣṇatvāderapi anugamanadarśanādityāhuḥ|| vācaspatimiśrāstu jīvāśritamāyāviṣayīkṛtaṃ brahama svata eva jāḍyāśrayaprapañcākāreṇa vivartamānatayopādānamiti māyā sahakārimātram, na kāryānugataṃ dvārakāraṇamityāhuḥ|| siddhāntamuktāvalīkṛtastu māyāśaktirevopādānaṃ na brahma "tadetad brahmāpūrvamanaparamabāhyam" "na tasya kāryaṃ karaṇaṃ ca vidyate" ityādiśruteḥ jagadupādānamāyādhiṣṭhānatvena upacārādupādānam, tādṛśamevopādānatvaṃ lakṣaṇe vivakṣitamityāhuḥ || 5 || atha ka īśvaraḥ ko vā jīvaḥ?| atroktaṃ prakaṭārthavivaraṇe anādiranirvācyā bhūtaprakṛtiścinmātrasambandhinī māyā| tasyāṃ citpratibimba īśvaraḥ, tasyā eva paricchinnānantapradeśeṣvāvaraṇavikṣepaśaktimatsu avidyābhidhāneṣu citpratibimbo jīva iti|| tattvaviveke tu triguṇātmikāyā mūlaprakṛteḥ "jīveśāvābhāsena karoti māyā cāvidyā ca svayameva bhavati" iti śrutisiddhau dvau rūpabhedau| rajastamo'nabhibhūtaśuddhasattvapradhānā māyā, tadabhibhūtamalinasattvā avidyeti māyā'vidyābhedaṃ parikalpya, māyāpratibimba īśvaraḥ, avidyāpratibimbo jīva ityuktam|| ekaiva mūlaprakṛtirvikṣepaprādhānyena māyāśabditeśvaropādhiḥ, āvaraṇaprādhānyenāvidyā 'jñānaśabditā jīvopādhiḥ| ata eva tasyā jīveśvarasādhāraṇacinmātrasambandhitve'pi jīvasyaiva `ajño'smi'ityajñānasambandhānubhavaḥ neśvarasyeti jīveśvaravibhāgaḥ kvacidupapāditaḥ|| saṅkṣepaśārīrake tu kāryopādhirayaṃ jīvaḥ kāraṇopādhirīśvaraḥ|| iti śrutimanusṛtyāvidyāyāṃ citpratibimba īśvaraḥ, antaḥ karaṇe citpratibimbo jīvaḥ| na cāntaḥkaraṇarūpeṇa dravyeṇa ghaṭenākāśasyeva caitanyasyāvacchedasambhavāt tadavacchinnameva caitanyaṃ jīvo'stviti vācyam| iha paratra ca jīvabhāvenāvacchedyacaitanyapradeśasya bhedena kṛtahānākṛtābhyāgamaprasaṅgāt| pratibimbastūpādhergatāgatayoravacchedyavanna bhidyate iti pratibimbapakṣe nāyaṃ doṣa ityuktam| evamukteṣveteṣu jīveśvarayoḥ pratibimbaviśeṣatvapakṣeṣu yat bimbasthānīyaṃ brahma tat muktaprāpyaṃ śuddhacaitanyam|| citradīpe `jīva īśo viśuddhā cit' iti traividhyaprakriyā vihāya yathā ghaṭāvacchinnākāśo ghaṭākāśaḥ, tadāśrite jalaṃ pratibimbitassābhranakṣatro jalākāśaḥ, anavacchinno mahākāśaḥ, mahākāśamadhyavartini meghamaṇḍale vṛṣṭilakṣaṇakāryānumeyeṣu jalarūpatadavayaveṣu tuṣārākāreṣu pratibimbito meghākāśaḥ iti vastuta ekasyāpyākāśasya cāturvidhyam, tathā sthūlasūkṣmadehadvayasyādhiṣṭhānatayā vartamānaṃ tadavacchinnaṃ caitanyaṃ kūṭavannirvikāratvena sthitaṃ kūṭastham, tatra kalpite'ntaḥ karaṇe pratibimbitaṃ caitanyaṃ saṃsārayogī jīvaḥ, anavacchinnaṃ caitanyaṃ brahma, tadāśrite māyātamasi sthitāsu sarvaprāṇināṃ dhīvāsanāsu pratibimbitaṃ caitanyamīśvaraḥ iti caitanyasya cāturvidhyaṃ parikalpyāntaḥkaraṇadhīvāsanoparaktājñānopādhibhedena jīveśvaravibhāgo darśitaḥ| ayaṃ cāparastadabhihito viśeṣaḥ caturvidheṣu caitanyeṣu jīvaḥ `aham' iti prakāśamānaḥ kūṭasthe avidyātirohitāsaṅgānandarūpaviśeṣāśeśuktau rupyavadadhyastaḥ| ata evedantvarajatatvayorivādhiṣṭhānasāmānyāṃśādhyastaviśeṣāṃśarūpayosvayantvāhantvayoḥ saha prakāśaḥ `svayamahaṃ karomi' ityādau| ahantvaṃ tvadhyastaviśeṣāṃśarūpam | puruṣāntarasya puruṣāntare `aham' itivyavahārābhāvena vyāvṛttatvāt| svayantvaṃ cānyatvapratiyogyadhiṣṭhānasāmānyāśarūpam| `svayaṃ devadatto gacchati' iti puruṣāntare'pi vyavahāreṇānuvṛttatvāt| evaṃ parasparādhyāsādeva kūṭasthajīvayoraviveko laukikānām| vivekastu tayorbṛhadāraṇyake "prajñānaghana evaitebhye bhūtebhyaḥ samutthāya tānyevānu vinaśyati" iti jīvābhiprāyeṇopādhivināśānuvināśapratipādanena, "avināśī vā are'yamātmā" iti kūṭasthābhiprāyeṇāvināśapratipādanena ca spaṣṭaḥ| ahamarthasya jīvasya vināśitve kathamavināśibrahmābhedaḥ| nedamabhede sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ, kiṃ tu bādhāyām| yathā `yaḥ sthāṇureṣa pumān' iti puruṣatvabodhena sthāṇutvabuddhirnivartyate| evam `ahaṃ brahmāsmi' iti kūṭasthabrahmasvarūpatvabodhenādhyastāhamartharūpatvaṃ nivartyate| yo'yaṃ sthāṇuḥ pumāneṣa pundhiyā sthāṇudhīriva|| brahmāsmītidhiyā'raśeṣā hyahambuddhirnivartate || 1 || iti naiṣkarmyasiddhivacanāt| yadi ca vivaraṇādyuktarītyā idamabhede sāmānādhikaraṇyam, tadā jīvavācino'haṃśabdasya lakṣaṇayā kūṭasthaparatvamastu| tasyānadhyastasya brahmābhede yogyatvāt| yastu meghākāśatulyo dhīvāsanāpratibimba īśvara uktaḥ, so'yaṃ "suṣuptasthāna ekībhūtaḥ prajñānaghana evānandamayo hyānandabhuk" iti māṇḍūkyaśrutisiddhaḥ sauṣuptānandamayaḥ| tatraiva tadanantaram "eṣa sarveśvara eṣa sarvajña eṣo'ntaryāmyeṣa yoniḥ sarvasya prabhavāpyayau hi bhūtānām" iti śruteḥ| sarvavastuviṣayasakalaprāṇidhīvāsanopādhikasya tasya sarvajñatvasya tata eva sarvakartṛtvāderapyupapatteśca| na cāsmadbuddhivāsanopāhitasya, kasyacit sārvajñyaṃ nānubhūyate iti vācyam| vāsanānāṃ parokṣatvena tadupahitasyāpi parokṣatvāditi|| brahmānande tu suṣuptisaṃyogāt māṇḍūkyokta ānandamayo jīva ityuktam| yadāhi jāgradādiṣu bhogapradasya karmaṇaḥ kṣaye nidrārūpeṇa vilīnamantaḥkaraṇaṃ purbhogapradakarmavaśāt prabodhe ghanībhavati, tadā tadupādhiko jīvaḥ vijñānamaya ityucyate| sa eva pūrvaṃ suṣuptisamaye vilīnāvasthopādhikaḥ sannānandamaya ityucyate| sa eva māṇḍūkye "suṣuptasthānaḥ" ityādinā darśita iti| evaṃ sati tasya sarveśvaratvādivacanaṃ kathaṃ saṅgacchatām?| ittham| santyadhidaivatamadhyātmaṃ ca paramātmanaḥ saviśeṣāṇi trīṇitrīṇi rūpāṇi| tatrādhidaivataṃ trīṇi śuddhacaitanyaṃ ceti catvāri rūpāṇi citrapaṭadṛṣṭāntena citradīpe samarthitāni| yathā svataśśubhraḥ paṭo dhautaḥ, annalipto ghaṭṭitaḥ, maṣyādivikārayukto lāñchitaḥ, varṇapūrito rañjitaḥ, ityavasthācatuṣṭayamekasyaiva citrapaṭasya, tathā paramātmā māyatatkāryopādhirahitaḥ śuddhaḥ, māyopahita āśvaraḥ, apañcīkṛtabhūtakāryasamaṣṭisūkṣmaśarīropahito hiraṇyagarbhaḥ, pañcīkṛtabhūtakāryasamaṣṭisthūlaśarīropahito virāṭ puruṣa ityavasthā catuṣṭayamekasyaiva paramātmanaḥ| asmiṃśca citrapaṭasthānīye paramātmani citrasthānīyaḥ sthāvarajaṅgamātmako nikhilaḥ prapañcaḥ| yathā citragatamanuṣyāṇāṃ citrādhāravastrasadṛśā vastrābhāsā likhyante, tathā paramātmādhyastadohināmadhiṣṭhānacaitanyasadṛśāścidābhāsāḥ kalpyante te ca jīvanāmānaḥ saṃsarantīti| adhyātmaṃ tu viśvataijasaprājñabhedena trīṇi rūpāṇi| tatra sūṣuptau vilīne antaḥ karaṇe ajñānamātrasākṣī prājñaḥ, yo'yamihānandamaya uktaḥ| svapne vyaṣṭisūkṣmaśarīrābhimānī taijasaḥ| jāgare vyaṣṭisthūlaśarīrābhimānī viśvaḥ| tatra māṇḍūkyaśrutirahamanubhave prakāśamānasyātmano viśvataijasaprājñaturyāvasthābhedarūpaṃ pādacatuṣṭayaṃ "so'yamātmā catuṣpāt" ityupakṣipya pūrvapūrvapādapravilāpane na niṣprapañcabrahmātmakaturyapādapratipattisaukaryyāya sthūlasūkṣmasūkṣmataropādhisāmyāt virāḍādīn viśvādiṣvantarbhāvya "jāgaritasthāno bāhiḥ prajñaḥ" ityādinā viśvādipādānnyarūpayat| ataḥ prājñaśabdite ānandamaye avyākṛtasyeśvarasyāntarbhāvaṃ vivakṣitvā tasya sarveśvaratvāditaddharmavacanamiti| itthameva bhagavatpādairgauḍapādīyavivaraṇe vyākhyātam| dṛgdṛśyaviveke tu citradīpavyutpāditaṃ kaṭasthaṃ jīvakoṭāvantarbhāvya cittraividhyaprakriyaivālambiteti viśeṣaḥ| tatra hyuktaṃ jalāśayataraṅgabudanyāyenoparyupari kalpanājjīvaḥ trividhaḥ pāramārthiko, vyāvahārikaḥ, prātibhāsikaśceti| tatrāvacchinnaḥ pāramārthiko jīvaḥ| tasminnavacchedakasya kalpitatve'pi avacchedyasya tasyākalpitatvena brahmaṇo'bhinnatvāt| tamāvṛtya sthitāyāṃ māyāyāṃ kalpite'ntaḥkaraṇe cidābhāso'ntaḥ karaṇatādātmyāpattyā `aham' ityabhimanyamāno vyāvahārikaḥ, tasya māyikatve'pi yāvadvyavahāramanuvṛtteḥ| svapne tamapyāvṛtya sthitayā māyāvasthābhedarūpayā nidrayā kalpite svāpnadehādāvahamabhimānī prātibhāsikaḥ| svapnaprapañcena saha taddraṣṭurjīvasyāpi prabodhe nivṛtteriti| evamete pratibimbeśvaravādināṃ pakṣabhedā darśitāḥ|| vivaraṇānusāriṇastvāhuḥ vibhedajanake'jñāne nāśamātyantikaṃ gate|| ātmano brahmaṇo bhedamasantaṃ kaḥ kariṣyati || 1 || iti smṛtyaikasyaivājñānasya jīveśvaravibhāgopādhitvapratipādanāt bimbapratibimbabhāvena jīveśvarayorvibhāgaḥ, nobhayorapi pratibimbabhāvena| upādhidvayamantareṇobhayoḥ pratibimbatvāyogāt| tatrāpi pratibimbo jīvaḥ| bimbasthānīya īśvaraḥ| tathā satyeva laukikabimbapratibimbadṛṣṭāntena svātantryamīśvarasya, tatpāratantrayaṃ jīvasya ca yujyate| pratibimbagatāḥ paśyannṛjuvakrādivikriyāḥ|| pumān krīḍedyāthā brahma tathā jīvasthavikriyāḥ || 1 || iti kalpatarūktarītyā `lokavattu līlākaivalyam' iti sūtramapi saṅgacchate| ajñānapratibimbitasya jīvasyāntaḥkaraṇarūpo'jñānapariṇāmabhedo viśeṣābhivyaktisthānaṃ sarvataḥ prasṛtasya savitṛprakāśasya darṣaṇa iva| atastasya tadupādhikatvavyavahāro'pi| naitavatā'jñānopādhiparityāgaḥ| antaḥkaraṇopādhiparicchinnasyaiva caitanyasya jīvatve yoginaḥ kāyavyūhādhiṣṭhānatvānupapatteḥ| na ca yogaprabhāvādyogino'rantaḥ karaṇaṃ kāyavyūhābhivyaktiyogyaṃ vaipulyaṃ prāpnotīti tadavacchinnasya kāyavyūhādhiṣṭhānatvaṃ yujyate iti vācyam| `pradīpavadāveśastathāhi darśayati' iti śāstropāntyādhikaraṇabhāṣyādiṣu kāyavyūhe pratidehamantaḥ karaṇasya cakṣuradivat bhinnasyaiva yogaprabhāvāt sṛṣṭerupavarṇanāt| pratibimbe bimbāt bhedamātrasyādhyastatvena svarūpeṇa tasya satyatvānna pratibimbarūpajīvasya muktyanvayāsambhava iti na tadatirekeṇa muktyanvayāyāvacchinnarūpajīvāntaraṃ vā pratibimbajīvātiriktaṃ jīveśvaravilakṣaṇaṃ kūṭasthaśabditaṃ caitanyāntaraṃ vā kalpanīyam| "avināśī vā are'yamātmā" iti śravaṇaṃ jīvasya tadupādhinivṛttau pratibimbabhāvāṣagame'pi svarūpaṃ na vinaśyatītyetatparam, na tadatiriktakūṭasthanāmakacaitanyāntaraparam| jīvopādhinā antaḥkaraṇādinā'vacchinnaṃ caitanyaṃ vimbabhūta īśvara eva| "yo vijñāne tiṣṭhan" ityādiśrutyā īśvarasyaiva jīvasannidhānena tadantaryāmibhāvena vikārāntarāvasthānaśravaṇāditi|| anye tu rūpānupahitapratibimbo na yuktaḥ sutarāṃ nirūpe| gaganapratibimbodāharaṇamapyayuktam| gaganābhogavyāpini savatṛkiraṇamaṇḍale salile pratibimbate gaganapratibimbatvavyavahārasya bhramamātramūlakatvāt| dhvanau varṇapratibimbatvavapādo'pyayuktaḥ| vyañjakatayā sannidhānamātreṇa dhavanidharmāṇāmudāttādisvarāṇāṃ varṇeṣvāropopapatteḥ dhvanervarṇapratibimbagrāhitvakalpanāyā niṣpramāṇakatvāt| pratidhvanirapi na pūrvaśabdapratibimbaḥ| pañcīkaraṇaprakriyayā paṭahapayonidhiprabhṛtiśabdānāṃ kṣitisalilādiśabdasvena pratidhvanerevākāśaśabdatvena tasyānyaśabdapratibimbatvāyogāt| varṇarupapratiśabdo'pi na pūrvavarṇapratibimbaḥ| varṇābhivyañjakadhvaninimittakapratidhvanermūladhvanivadeva varṇā bhivyañjakatvenopapatteḥ| tasmāt ghaṭākāśavadantaḥ karaṇāvacchinnaṃcaitanyaṃ jīvaḥ| tadanavacchinnam īśvaraḥ| nacaivamaṇḍāntarvartinaścaitanyasya tattadantaḥkataraṇopādhibhiḥ sarvātmanā jīvabhāvenāvacchedāt tadavacchedarahitacaitanyarūpasyeśvarasyāṇḍāt bahireva sattvaṃ syāditi "yo vijñāne tiṣṭhan" ityādāvantaryāmibhāvena vikārāntarāvasthānaśravaṇaṃ virudhyeta| pratibimbapakṣe tu jalagatasvābhāvikākāśe satyeva pratibimbākāśadarśanāt ekatra dviguṇīkṛtya vṛttirupapadyate iti yācyam| yataḥ pratibimbapakṣe'pyupādhāvanantargatasyaiva caitanyasya tatra pratibimbo vācyaḥ, na tu jalacandranyāyena kṛtsnapratibimbaḥ| tadantaragtabhāgasya tatra pratibimbāsambhavāt| na hi meghāvacchinnasyākāśasyālokasya vā jale pratibimbavat jalāntargatasyāpi tatra pratibimbo dṛśyate| na vā mukhādīnāṃ bahiḥsthitisamaye iva jalāntarnimajjane'pi pratibimbo'sti| ato jalapratibimbaṃ prati meghākāśāderivāntaḥkaraṇādyupādhipratibimbaṃ prati tadanantargatasyaiva bimbatvaṃ syāditi bimbabhūtasya vikārāntaravasthānāyogāt īśvare antaryāmibrāhmaṇājñasyābhāvastulyaḥ| etenāvacchinnasya jīvatve kartṛbhāktṛsamayayostatra tatrāntaḥ karaṇāvacchedyacaitanyapradeśasya bhinnatvāt kṛtahānākṛtābhyāgamaprasaṅga iti nirastam| pratibimbapakṣe'pi svānantargatasya svasannihitasya caitanyapradeśasyāntaḥkaraṇe pratibimbasya vaktavyatayā tatra tatrāntaḥkaraṇasya gamane bimbabhedāt tatpparatibimbasyāpi bhedāvaśyambhāvena doṣataulyāt| na ca `antaḥkaraṇapratibimbo jīvaḥ' iti pakṣe doṣataulye'pi `avidyāpratibimbo jīvaḥ'| tasya ca tatra tatra gatvaramantaḥkaraṇaṃ jalāśayavyāpino mahāmeghamaṇjalapratibimbasya tadupari visṛtvarasphītāloka ivaṃ tatra tatra viśeṣābhivyaktiheturiti pakṣe nāyaṃ doṣaḥ| antaḥkaraṇavadavidyāyā gatyabhāvena pratibimbabhedānāptteriti vācyam| tathaivāvacchedapakṣe'pi `avidyāvacchinne jīvaḥ' ityabhyupagamasambhavāt| tatrāpyekasya jīvasya kkacit pradeśe kartṛtvaṃ pradeśāntare bhoktṛtvamityevaṃ kṛtahānādidoṣāpanuttaye vastuto jīvaikyasya śaraṇīkaraṇīyatvena tannyāyādantaḥkaraṇopādhipakṣe'pi vastutaścaitanyaikyasya tadavacchedakopādhyekyasya ca tantratvābhyupagamena taddoṣanirākaraṇasambhavācca| na cāvacchedapakṣe "yathā hyayaṃ jyotirātmā vivasvānapo bhinnā bahudhaiko'nugacchan| upādhinā kriyate bhedarūpo devaḥ kṣetreṣvevama jo'yamātmā" "ata eva copamā sūryakādivat" iti śrutisūtrābhyāṃ virodhaḥ| `ambuvadagrahaṇāttu na tathātvam' ityudāhṛtasūtrānantarasūtreṇa yathā sūryasya rūpavataḥ pratibimbodayayogyaṃ tato viprakṛṣṭadeśaṃ rūpavajjalaṃ gṛhyate, naivaṃ sarvagatasyātmanaḥ pratibimbodayayogyaṃ kiñcidasti tato viprakṛṣṭamiti pratibimbāsambhavamuktvā `vṛddhihrāsāktvamantarbhāvādubhayasāmañjasyādevam' iti tadanantarasūtreṇa yathā jalapratibimbitaḥ sūryo jalavṛddhau vardhate iva, jalahrāse hrasatīva, jalacalane calatīveti tasyādhyāsikaṃ jalānurodhivṛddhihrāsādibhāktvam, tathā ātmano'ntaḥ karaṇādinā'vacchedena upādhyantarbhāvadādhyāsikaṃ tadanurodhivṛddhihrāsādibhāktvamityevaṃ dṛṣṭāntadārṣṭāntikayossāmañjasyādavirodha iti svayaṃ sūtrakṛtaivāvacchedapakṣe tayostātparyakathanāt| ghaṭasaṃvṛttamākāśaṃ nīyamāne yathā ghaṭe| ghaṭo nīyeta nākāśaṃ tadvajjīvo nabhopamaḥ|| `aṃśo nānāvyapadeśāt' iti śrutisūtrābhyāmavacchedapakṣasyaiva parigrahācca| tasmāt sarvagatasya caitanyasyāntaḥkaraṇādinā'vacchedo'vaśyambhāvīti āvaśyakatvāt`avacchinno jīvaḥ' iti pakṣaṃ rocayante|| apare tu na pratibimbaḥ, nāpyavacchinno jīvaḥ| kiṃ tu kauntoyasyaiva rādheyatvavadavikṛtasya brahmaṇa eva avidyāyā jīvabhāvaḥ| vyādhakulasaṃvardhitarājakumāradṛṣṭāntena `brahmaiva svāvidyāyā saṃsarati, svavidyayā mucyate' iti bṛhadāraṇyakabhāṣye pratipādanāt| rājasūnoḥ smṛtiprāptau vyādhabhāvo nivartate|| tathaivamātmano'jñasya tattvamasyadivākyataḥ|| iti vārtikokteśca| evaṃ ca svāvidyayā jīvabhāvamāpannasyaiva brahmaṇaḥ sarvaprapañcakalpakatvāt īśvaro'pi saha sarvajñatvādidharmaiḥ svapnopalabdhadevatāvajjīvakalpita ityācakṣate || 6|| athāyaṃ jīva ekaḥ, utānekaḥ? anupadoktapaśaṅkāpaṅkaprakṣalanaṃ svapnadṛṣṭāntasaliladhārayaiva kartavyamiti| anye tvasminnekaśarīraikajīvavāde manaḥpratyayamalabhamānāḥ `adhikaṃ tu bhedanirdeśāt' `lokavattu līlā kaivalyam' ityādisūtrairjīvādhika īśvara eva jagataḥ straṣṭā, na jīvaḥ| tasyāptakāmatvena prayojanābhāve'pi kevalaṃ līlayaiva jagataḥ sṛṣṭirityādi pratipādayadbhirvirodhaṃ ca manyamānā hiraṇyagarbha eko brahmapratibimbo mukhyo jīvaḥ| anye tu tatpratibimbabhūtāścitrapaṭalikhitamanuṣyadehārpitapaṭābhāsakalpāḥ jīvābhāsāḥ saṃsārādibhāja iti saviśeṣānekaśarīraikajīvavādamātiṣṭhante|| apare tu hiraṇyagarbhasya pratikalpaṃ bhedena kasya hiraṇyagarbhasya mukhyaṃ jīvatvamityatra niyāmakaṃ nāstīti manyamānā eka eva jīvo'viśeṣeṇa sarvaṃ śarīramadhitiṣṭhati| na caivaṃ śarīrāvayavabheda iva śarīrabhede'pi parasparasukhādyanusandhānaprasaṅgaḥ| janmāntarīyasukhādyanusandhānādarśanena śarīrabhedasya tadananusandhānaprayojanakatvaklṛpteḥ| yoginastu kāyavyūhasukhādyanusandhānaṃ vyavahitārthagrahaṇavadyogaprabhāvanibandhanamiti na tadudāharaṇamiti aviśeṣānekaśarīraikajīvavādaṃ rocayante|| itare tvatrāpi baddhamuktavyavasthā'bhāvasya tulyatvena "tadyo yo devānāṃ pratyabudhyata sa eva tadabhavat" ityādiśruteḥ `pratiṣedhāditi cet, naśarīrāt' ityādhikaraṇe baddhamuktatvapratipādakabhāṣyasya ca nāñjasyamityaparinuṣyanto'ntaḥkaraṇādīnāṃ jīvopādhitvābhyupagamenānekajīvavādamāśritya baddhamuktavyavasthāṃ pratipadyante|| teṣukecidevamāhuḥ yadyapi śuddhabrahmāśrayaviṣayamekamevājñānam, tannāśa eva ca mokṣaḥ, tathāpi jīvanmuktāvajñānaleśānuvṛttyabhyupagamenājñānasya sāṃśatvāt tadeva kkacidupādhau brahmavagamotpattau aṃśena nivartate, upādhyantareṣu yathāpūrvamaṃśāntarairanuvartate iti| anye tu yathā nyāyaikadeśimate bhūtale ghaṭātyantābhāvasya vṛttau ghaṭasaṃyogābhāvo niyāmaka iti anekeṣu pradeśeṣu tadvatsu saṃsṛjya vartamāno ghaṭātyantābhāvaḥ kkacitpradeśe ghaṭasaṃyogotpattyā tadabhāvanivṛttau na saṃsṛjyate| evamajñānasya caitanye vṛttau mano niyāmakamiti tadupādhinā tatpradeśeṣu saṃsṛjya vartamānamajñānaṃ kkacid brahmadarśanotpattyā "bhidyate hṛdayagranthiḥ" ityuktarītyā manaso nivṛttau na saṃsṛjyate| anyatra yathāpūrvamavatiṣṭhate| ajñānasaṃsargāsaṃsargāveva ca bandhamokṣāvityāhaḥ|| apare tu nājñānaṃ śuddhacaitanyāśrayam, kiṃ tu jīvāśrayaṃ brahmaviṣayam| ataścāntaḥkaraṇapratibimbarūpeṣu sarveṣu jīveṣu vyaktiṣu jātivat pratyekaparyavasāyitayā vartamānamutpannavidyaṃ kaṃ cit‌tyajati naṣṭāṃ vyaktimiva jātiḥ| sa eva mokṣaḥ| anyaṃ yathāpūrvamāśrayatīti vyavasthetyāhuḥ|| itare tu pratijīvamavidyābhedamabhyupagamyaiva tadanuvṛttinivṛttibhyāṃ, baddhamuktavyavasthāṃ samarthayante| asmin pakṣe kasyāvidyayā prapañcaḥ kṛto'stviti cet, vinigamakābhāvāt sarvāvidyākṛto'nekatantvārabdhapaṭatulyaḥ| ekasya muktau tadavidyānāśe ekatantunāśe paṭasyeva tatsādhāraṇaprapañcasya nāśaḥ| tadaiva vidyamānatantvantaraiḥ paṭāntarasyeva itarāvidyādibhiḥ sakaletarasādhāraṇaprapañcāntarasyotpādanamityeke|| tattadajñānakṛtapratibhāsikarajatavat, nyāyamate tattadapekṣābuddhijanyadvitvavacca tattadavidyākṛto viyadādiprapañcaḥ pratipuruṣaṃ bhinnaḥ| śuktirajate tvayā yad dṛṣṭaṃ rajataṃ, tadeva mayā'pītivadaikyabhramamātramityanye|| jīvāśritādavidyānivahādbhinnā māyaiva īśvarāśritā prapañcakāraṇam| jīvānāmavidyāstu āvaraṇamātre prātibhāsikaśuktirajatādivikṣepe'pi ca upayujyante ityapare||7|| avasitamupādānatvam, tatprasaktānuprasaktaṃ ca| atha kīdṛśaṃ kartṛtvam|? kecidāhuḥ "tadaikṣata so'kāmayata tadātmānaṃ svayamakuruta" iti śravaṇānnyāyamata iva kāryānukūlajñānacikīrṣākṛtimattvarūpamiti|| anye tu cikīrṣātṛtikartṛtvanirvāhāya cikīrṣākṛtyantarāpekṣāyāmanavasthāprasaṅgāt kāryānukūlajñānavattvameva brahamaṇaḥ kartṛtvam| na ca jñāne'pyeṣa prasaṅgaḥ| tasya brahmasvarūpatvenākāryatvāt| evaṃ ca vivaraṇe jīvasya sukhādikartṛtvoktiḥ, vīkṣaṇamātrasādhyatvāt viyadādi vīkṣitaṃ, hiraṇyagarbhadvārā vīkṣaṇādhikayatnasādhyatvāt bhautikaṃ smitamiti kalpatarūktiśca saṅgacchata iti vadanti|| apare tu kāryānukūlastraṣṭacavyālocanarūpajñānavattvaṃ kartṛtvaṃ, na kāryānukūlajñānavattvamātram| śuktirajatasvāpnabhramādiṣu adhyāsānukūlādhiṣṭhānajñānavattvena jīvasya kartṛtvaprasaṅgāt| na ceṣṭāpattiḥ| `atha rathān rathapogān pathaḥ sṛjate sa hi kartā' ityādiśrutyaiva jīvasya svapnaprapañcakartṛtvokteriti vācyam bhāṣyakāraiḥ `lāṅgalaṃ gavādīnudvahatītivat kartṛtvopacāramātraṃ rathādipratibhānanimittatvena' iti vyākhyātatvādityāhuḥ||8|| anenaiva nikhilaprapañcaracanākartṛbhāvenārthasiddhaṃ sarvajñitvaṃ brahmaṇaḥ `śāstrayonitvāt' ityadhikaraṇe vedakartṛtvenāpi samarthitam|| atha kathaṃ brahmaṇaḥ sarvajñatvaṃ saṅgacchate| jīvavadantaḥkaraṇābhāvena jñātṛtvasyaivāyogāt| atra sarvavastuviṣayasakalaprāṇidhīvāsanoparaktājñānopādhika īśvaraḥ| atastasya sarvaviṣayavāsanāsākṣitayā sarvajñatvamiti bhāratītīrthādipakṣaḥ prāgeva darśitaḥ|| prakaṭārthakārāstvāhuḥ yathā jīvasya svopādhyantaḥkaraṇapariṇāmāścaitanyapratibimbagrāhiṇa iti tadyogāt jñātṛtvam, evaṃ brahmaṇaḥ svopādhimāyāpariṇāmāścitpratibimbagrāhiṇassantīti tatpratibimbitaiḥ sphuraṇaiḥ kālatrayavartino'pi prapañcasyāpirokṣeṇāvakalanāt sarvajñatvamiti|| tattvaśuddhikārāstūktarītyā brahmaṇo vidyamānanikhilaprapañca sārātkārasambhavāt tajjanitasaṃskāravattayā ca smaraṇopapatteratītasakalavastvavabhāsasiddhiḥ| sṛṣṭeḥpāṅmāyāyāssṛjyamānanikhilapadārthasphuraṇarūpeṇa jīvādṛṣṭānurodhena vivartamānatvāt tatsākṣitayā tadupādhikasya brahmaṇo'pi tatsādhakatvasiddheḥ anāgatavastuviṣayavijñānopapattiriti sarvajñatvaṃ samarthayante|| kaumudīkṛtastu vadanti svarūpajñānenaiva brahmaṇaḥ svasaṃsṛṣṭasarvāvabhāsakatvāt sarvajñatvam| atītānāgatayorapyavidyāyāṃ citrabhitrau vimṛṣṭānunmīlitacitravat saṃskārātmanā sattvena tatsaṃsargasyāpyupapatteḥ| na tu vṛttijñānaistasya sarvajñātvam| "tameva bhāntamanu bhāti sarvam" iti sāvadhāraṇaśrutivirodhātsṛṣṭeḥ prāgekamevādvitīyamityavadhāraṇānurodhena mahābhūtānāmipa vṛttijñānānāmapi pralayasya vaktavyatayā brahmaṇastadā sarvajñatvābhāvāpattyā prāthamikamāyāvivartarūpe īkṣaṇe tatpūrvake mahābhūtādau ca sraṣṭṭatvābhāvaprasaṅgācca| evaṃ sati brahmaṇassrvaviviṣayajñānātmakatvameva syāt, na tu sarvajñātṛtvarūpaṃ sarvajñatvamiti cet, satyam| sarvaviṣayajñānātmakayeva brahma, na tu sarvajñānakartṛtvarūpaṃ jñātṛtvamasti| ata eva`vākyānvayāt' ityādhikaraṇe vijñātṛtvaṃ jīvaliṅgamityuktaṃ bhāṣyakāraiḥ| "yassarvajñaḥ" ityādiśrutirapi tasya jñānarūpatvābhiprāyeṇaiva yojanīyeti| yadyapi brahma svarūpacaitanyenaiva spasaṃsṛṣṭasarvāvabhāsakaṃ, tathāpi tasya svarūpeṇākāryatve'pi dṛśyāvacchinnarūpeṇa tu brahmakāryatvāt| "yassarvajñaḥ" iti jñānajananakartṛtvaśruterapi na kaścidvirodha iti ācāryavācaspatimiśrāḥ||9|| nanvīśvaravajjīvo'pi vṛttimanapekṣya svarūpacaitanyenaiva kimiti viṣayānnāvabhāsayati? atroktaṃ vivaraṇe brahmacaitanyaṃ sarvopādānatayā sarvatādātmyāpannaṃ sat svasaṃsṛṣṭaṃ sarvamavabhāsayati, na jīvacaitanyam| tasyāvidyopādhikarayā sarvagatatve'pyanupādānatvenāsaṅgitvāt| yathā sarvagataṃ gotvasāmānyaṃ svabhāvādaśvādivyaktisaṅgitvābhāve'pi sāsnāvadvyaktau saṃsṛjyate, evaṃ viṣayāsaṅgyapi jīvaḥ svabhāvādantaḥkaraṇe saṃsṛjyate| tathāca yadā'ntaḥkaraṇasya pariṇāmo vṛttirūpo nayanādidvāreṇa nirgatya viṣayaparyantaṃ cakṣuraśmivat jhaṭiti dīrghaprabhākāreṇa pariṇamya viṣayaṃ vyāpnoti, tadā tamupāruhya taṃ viṣayaṃ gocarayati| kevalāgnyadāhyasyāpi tṛṇaderayaḥpiṇḍasamārūḍhāgnidāhyatvavat kevalajīvacaitanyāprakāśyasyāpi ghaṭāderantaḥkaraṇavṛttyupārūḍhasya tatprakāśyatvaṃ yuktam| yadvā'ntaḥkaraṇopādhikatvena jīvaḥ paricchinnaḥ| ataḥ saṃsargābhāvānna ghaṭādikamavabhāsayati| vṛttidvārā tat‌saṃsṛṣṭaviṣayāvacchinnabrahmacatainyābhedābhivyaktau tu taṃ viṣayaṃ prakāśayati| athavā jīvaḥ sarvagato'pyavidyāvṛtatvāt svayamapyaprakāśamānatayā viṣayānanavabhāsayanviṣayaviśeṣe vṛttyuparāgādāvāvaraṇatirodhānena tatraivābhivyaktastameva viṣayaṃ prakāśayati| evaṃ ca ciduparāgārthatvena, viṣayacaitanyābhedābhivyaktyarthatvena, āvaraṇābhibhavārthatvena vā vṛttinirgamamapekṣya tatsaṃsṛṣṭavaliṣayamātrāvabhāsakatvāt jīvasya kiñcijjñatvamapyupapadyate iti||10|| atra prathamapakṣe sarvagatasya jīvasya vṛttyadhīnaḥ ko viṣayoparāgaḥ? vṛttyā'pi hi pūrvasiddhayorniṣkriyayorviṣayajīvacaitanyayostādātmyasya saṃyogasya vā na sambhavatyādhānam| anye tu viṣayaviṣayibhāvamātraniyāmikā vṛttiścedanirgatāyā apyaindriyakavṛttestanniyāmakatvaṃ nātiprasaṅgāvahamiti tannirgamābhyupagamavaiyarthyāpatteḥ sa nābhisaṃhitaḥ| kiṃ tu viṣayasannihitajīvacaitanyatādātmyāpannāyā vṛtterviṣayasaṃyoge tasyāpi taddvārakaḥ paramparāsambandho labhyate iti sa eva ciduparāgo'bhisaṃhita ityāhuḥ|| aparetu sākṣādaparokṣacaitanyasaṃsargiṇa eva sukhāderāparokṣyadarśanāt aparokṣaviṣaye sākṣātsaṃsarga eṣṭavyaḥ| tasmād vṛtterviṣayasaṃyoge vṛttirūpāvacchedakalābhāt tadavacchedena tadupādānasya jīvasyāpi saṃyogajasaṃyogaḥ sambhavati| kāraṇākāraṇasaṃyogāt kāryākāryasaṃyogavat kāryākāryasaṃyogāt kāraṇākāraṇasaṃyogasyāpi yuktitaulyenābhyupagantuṃ yuktatvādityāhuḥ|| ekadeśinastu antaḥkaraṇopahitasya viṣayāvabhāsakacaitanyasya viṣayatādātmyāpannabrahmacaitanyābhedābhivyaktidvārā viṣayatādātmyasampādanameva ciduparāgo'bhisaṃhitaḥ| sarvagatatayā sarvaviṣayasannihitasyāpi jīvasya tena rūpeṇa viṣayāvabhāsakatve tasya sādhāraṇatayā puruṣaviśeṣāparokṣyavyavasthityayogena tasyāntaḥkaraṇopahitatvārūpeṇaiva viṣayāvabhāsakatvāt| evaṃ ca viṣayāparokṣye ādhyāsikasambandho niyāmaka iti siddhānto'pi saṅgacchate| na caivaṃ dvitīyapakṣasāṅkaryam| jīvasya sarvagatatve prathamaḥ pakṣaḥ, paricchinnatve dvitīya ityeva tayorbhedādityāhuḥ||11|| atha dvitīyapakṣe keyamabhedābhivyaktiṛḥ?| kecidāhuḥ kulyādvārā taḍāgakedārasalilayoriva viṣayāntaḥkaraṇāvacchinnacaitanyayorvṛttidvārā ekībhāvo'bhedābhivyaktiḥ| evaṃ ca yadyapi viṣayāvacchinnaṃ brahmacaitanyameva viṣayaprakāśakam, tathāpi tasya vṛttidvārā ekībhāvena jīvatvaṃ sampannamiti jīvasya viṣayaprakāśopapattiriti|| anye tvāhuḥ vimbasthānīyasya viṣayāvacchinnasya brahmaṇaḥ pratibimbabhūtena jīvena ekībhāvo nābhedābhivyaktiḥ| vyāvartakopādhau darpaṇa iva jāgrati tayorekībhāvāyogāt| vṛttikṛtābhedābhivyaktyā viṣayāvacchinnasya brahmaṇo jīvatvaprāptau brahmaṇastadā tadviṣayasaṃsargābhāvena taddraṣṭṛtvāsambhave sati tasya sarvajñatvābhāvāpatteśca| kiṃ tu viṣayāvacchinnaṃ brahmacaitanyaṃ viṣayasaṃsṛṣṭāyā vṛtteragrabhāge viṣayaprakāśakaṃ pratibimbaṃ samarpayatīti tasya pratibimbasya jīvenaikībhāvaḥ| evaṃ cāntaḥkaraṇatadvṛttiviṣayāvacchinnacaitanyānāṃ pramātṛpramāṇaprameyabhāvena asaṅkaro'pyupapadyate| na ca vṛttyupahitacaitanyasya viṣayapramātve tasya viṣayādhiṣṭhānacaitanyasyeva viṣayeṇādhyāsikasambandhābhāvāt viṣayāparokṣye ādhyāsikasambandhastantraṃ na syāditi vācyam| viṣayādhiṣṭhānacaitanyasyaiva viṣayeṇāvacchinnasya vṛttau pratibimbitatayā tadabhedena tatsambandhasattvāditi| apare tvāhuḥ bimbabhūtaviṣayādhiṣṭhānacaitanyameva sākṣādādhyāsikasambanmadhalābhāt viṣayaprakāśakamiti tasyaiva bimbatadvaviśiṣṭarūpeṇa bhedasadbhāve'pi tadupalakṣitacaitanyātmanā ekībhāvo'bhedābhivyaktiḥ| na caivaṃ sati jīvabrahmasāṅkaryam, na vā brahmaṇaḥ sarvajñatvavirodhaḥ| bimbātmanā tasya yathāpūrvamavasthānāditi||12|| atha tṛtīyapakṣe ko nāmāvaraṇābhibavaḥ? ajñānanāśaścet, ghaṭajñānenaivājñānamūlaḥ prapañco nivarteteti cet| atra kecidāhuḥ caitanyamātrāvārakasyājñānasya viṣayāvacchinnapradeśe spadyotādiprakāśena mahāndhakārasyeva jñānenaikadeśena nāśo vā, kaṭavat saṃveṣṭanaṃ vā bhītabhaṭavadapasaraṇaṃ vā'bhibhava iti|| anye tu ajñānasyaikadeśena nāśe upādānābhāvāt punastatra kandalanāyogena sakṛdagate samayāntare'pyāvaraṇābhāvaprasaṅgāt, niṣkriyasyāpasaraṇasaṃveṣṭanayorasambhavācca na yathoktarūpo'bhibhavaḥ sambhavati| ataḥ caitanyamātrāvārakasyāpyajñānasya tattadākāravṛttisaṃsṛṣṭāvasthaviṣayāvacchinnacaitanyānāvārakatvasvābhāvyamevābhibhavaḥ| na ca viṣayāvaguṇṭhanapaṭavadviṣayacaitanyamāśritya sthitasyājñānasya kathaṃ tadanāvārakatvaṃ yujyate iti śaṅkyam| `ahamajñaḥ' iti pratītyā'hamanubhave prakāśamānacaitanyamāśrayata eva tasya tadanāvārakatvāpratipatterityāhuḥ|| apare tu `ghaṭaṃ na jānāmi'iti ghaṭajñānavirodhitvena, ghaṭajñāne sati ghaṭājñānaṃ nivṛttamiti tannivartyatvena cānubhūyamānaṃ na mūlājñānam| śuddhacaitanyaviṣayasya tajjñānanivartyasya ca tasya tathātvāyogāt| kintu ghaṭāvacchinnacaitanyaviṣayaṃ mūlājñānasyāvasthābhedarūpamajñānāntaramiti tannāśa evābhibhavaḥ| na caivamekena jñānena tannāśe tatsamānaviṣayāṇāṃ jñānāntarāṇāmāvaraṇābhibhāvakatvānāpattiḥ| yāvanti jñānāni, tāvanti ajñānānītyabhyupagamādityāhuḥ || imāni cāvasthārūpāṇi ajñānāni mūlājñānavadajñānatvādanādīnīti kecit|| vyāvahārikau jagajjīvāvāvṛtya svāpnau jagajjīvau vikṣipantī nidrā tāvadāparaṇavikṣepaśaktiyogāt ajñānāvasthābhedarūpā| tathā suṣuptyavasthā'pyantaḥkaraṇādau vilīne `sukhamahamasvāpsaṃna kiñicidavediṣam' iti parāmarśadarśanāt mūlājñānavat suṣuptikāle anubhūyamānājñānāvasthābhedarūpaiva| tayośca jāgradbhogapradakarmoparame satyevodbhavāt sāditvam, tadvad anyadapyajñānamavasthārūpaṃ sādītyanye|| nanvanāditvapakṣe ghaṭe prathamamutpannenaiva jñānena sarvatadajñānanāśo bhavet| vinigamanāvirahāt tadavacchinnacaitanyāvarakasarvājñānanāśe viṣayaprakāśāyogācca| ataḥ pāścāttyajñānānāmāvaraṇānabhibhāvakatvaṃ tadavasthameveti cet, atra kecidāhuḥ yathā jñānaprāgabhāvānāmanekeṣāṃ sattve'pyekajñānodaye eka eva prāgabhāvo nivartate| saṃśayādijananaśaktatayā tadāvaraṇarūpeṣu prāgabhāvāntareṣu satsvapi viṣayāvabhāsaḥ| tathaikajñānodaye ekamevājñānaṃ nivartate, ajñānāntareṣu satsvapi viṣayāvabhāsa iti|| anye tu āvṛtasyāparokṣyaṃ virūddham| ekajñānodaye ca prāgabhāvāntarasttve'pi yāvadviśeṣadarśanābhāvakūṭarūpamāvaraṇaṃ viśeṣadarśanānnāstīti manyamānā vadanti yadā yadajñānabhāvṛṇoti, tadā tena jñānena tasyaiva nāśaḥ| sarvaṃ ca sarvadā nāvṛṇoti, ghaiyarthyāt| kiṃ tvāvarakājñāne vṛttyā nāśite tadvṛttyuparame ajñānāntaramāvṛṇoti| na caivaṃ brahmāvagamotpattikāle'māvarakatvena sthitānāmajñānānāṃ tato'pyanivṛttiprasaṅgaḥ| teṣāṃ sākṣāttadvirodhitvābhāve'pi tannivartyamūlājñānaparatantratayā ajñānasambandhādivat tannivṛttyupapatteḥ| etadarthameva teṣāṃ tadavasthābhedarūpatayā tatpāratantryamiṣyata iti|| apare tu ajñānasya saviṣayatvasvabhāvatvāt utsargataḥ sarvaṃ sarvadā''vṛṇotyeva| na ca viṣayotpatteḥ prāgāvaraṇīyābhāve nāvarakatvaṃ na yujyata iti vācyam| tadā'pi sūkṣmarūpeṇa tatsattvāditi manyamānāḥ kalpayanti yathā bahujanasamākule pradeśe kasyacit śirasi patannaśaniritarānapyapasārayati| yathā vā sannipātaharamauṣadhamekaṃ doṣaṃ nivartayaddoṣāntaramapi dūrīkaroti| evamekamajñānaṃ nāśayat jñānamajñānāntarāṇyapi tiraskaroti| tiraskāraśca yāvad jñānasthitiḥ tāvad āvaraṇaśaktipratibandha iti|| nanvevaṃ sati dhārāvāhikasthale dvitīyādivṛttīnāmāvaraṇānabhibhāvakatve vaiphalyaṃ syāt, prathamajñānenaiva nivartanatiraskārābhyāmāvaraṇamātrasyābhibhavāditi|| atrāhuḥ vṛttitiraskṛtamapyajñānaṃ taduparame punarāvṛṇoti pradīpatiraskṛtaṃ tama iva pradīpoparame| vṛttyuparamasamaye vṛttyantarodaye tu tiraskṛtamajñānaṃ tathaivāvatiṣṭhate pradīpoparamasamaye pradīpāntarodaye tama iva| tathā ca`yasmin sati agrimakṣaṇe yasya sattvaṃ, yadvyatireke cāsattvaṃ, tat tajjanyam' iti prāgabhāvaparipālanasādhāraṇalakṣaṇānurodhenānāvaraṇasya dvitīyādivṛttikāryatvasyāpi lābhānna tadvaiphalyamiti|| nyāyacandrikākṛtastvāhuḥ kenacijjñānena kasyacidajñānasya nāśa eva| na tvāvarakāṇāmapyajñānāntarāṇāṃ tiraskāraḥ| tathā ca dhārāvāhikadvitīyādivṛttūnāmapyekaikājñānanāśakatvena sāphalyam| na caivaṃ jñānodaye'pyāvaraṇasambhavādviṣayānavabhāsaprasaṅgaḥ| avasthārūpāṇyajñānāni hi tattatkālopalakṣitasvarūpāvarakāṇi, jñānāni ca yāvatsvakālopalakṣitaviṣayāvarakājñānanāśakāni| tathā ca kuñcijjñānodayo tatkālīnaviṣayāvarakājñānasya nāśāt vidyamānānāmajñānāntarāṇāmanyakālīnaviṣayāvārakatvācca na tatkālīnaviṣayāvabhāse kācidanupapattiḥ| kārīrīphale vṛṣṭāvāsannasamayasyevājñānaviṣaye ghaṭādau tatkālasyopalakṣaṇatayā viṣayakoṭāvananupraveśena sūkṣmatatkālabhedāviṣayairdhārāvāhikādvitīyādijñānairajñānānāṃ nivṛttāvapi na kācidanupapattiriti|| kecittu prathamajñānanivartyamevājñānaṃ svarūpāvārakam| dvitīyādijñānanivartyāni tu deśakālādiviśeṣaṇāntaraviśiṣṭaviṣayāṇi| ata eva sattāniścayarūpe ajñānanivartake caitradarśane sakṛjjāte `caitraṃ na jānāmi' iti svarūpāvaraṇaṃ nānubhūyate, kiṃ tu `idānīṃ sakutreti na jānāmi' ityādirūpeṇa viśiṣṭāvaraṇameva| vismaraṇaśālinaḥ kvacit sakṛta dṛṣṭe'pi `na jānāmi'iti svarūpāvaraṇaṃ dṛśyate cet, tatra tathā'stu| anyatra sakṛddṛṣṭe viśiṣṭaviṣayāṇyevājñānāni jñānāni ca| na caivaṃ sati dhārāvāhikadvitīyādijñānānāmajñānanivartakatvaṃ na syāt, sthūlakālaviśiṣṭājñānasya prathamajñānenaiva nivṛtteḥ pūrvāparajñānavyāvṛttasūkṣmakālaviśiṣṭājñānasya tadaviṣayairdvitīyādijñānairnivṛttyayogāditi vācyam| dhārāvahanasthale prathamotpannāyā eva vṛttestāvatkālāvasthāyitvasambhavena vṛttibhedānabhyupagamāt| tadabhyupagame'pi bahukālāvasthāyipañcaṣavṛttirūpatvasambhavena parasparavyāvṛttasthūlakālādiviśeṣaṇabhedaviṣayatvopapatteḥ| pratikṣaṇodyadanekavṛttisantānarūpatvābhyupagame'pi dvitīyādivṛttīnāmadhigatārthamātraviṣayatayā prāmāṇyābhāvenāvaraṇānivartakatve'pyahāneśca| na hi viṣayābādhamātraṃ prāmāṇyam| prāgavagatānavagatayoḥ parvatatadvṛttipāvakayoranumitiviṣayayorabādhasyāviśeṣeṇa ubhayatrāpyanumiteḥ prāmāṇyaprasaṅgāt| na ceṣṭāpattiḥ| `vahnāvanumitiḥ pramāṇam' itivat `parvate'pyanumitiḥ pramāṇam' iti vyavahārādarśanāt| vivaraṇe sākṣisiddhasyājñānasyābhāvavyāvṛtti pratyāyanārthānumānādiviṣayatve'pi pramāṇāvedyatvokteśca| tasmāt dvitīyādivṛttīnāṃ prāmāṇyābhāvāt upāsanādivṛttīnāmivājñānānivartakatve'pi na hāniḥ| pramāṇvṛttīnāmeva tannivartakatvābhyupagamāt|| nanu nāyamapi niyamaḥ, parokṣavṛtteranirgamenājñānānivartakatvāditi cet| atra kecidāhuḥ dvividhaṃ viṣayāvarakamajñānam| ekaṃ viṣayāśritaṃ rajjvādivikṣepopādānabhūtaṃ kāryakalpyam| anyata puruṣāśritam `idamahaṃ na janāmi' ityanubhūyamānam| puruṣāśritasya viṣayasaṃbhinnavikṣepopādānatvāsambhavena, viṣayāśritasya `idamahaṃ na jānāmi' iti sākṣirūpaprakāśasaṃsargāyogena dvividhasyāpyāvaśyakatvāt| evaṃ ca parokṣasthale vṛtternirgamanābhāvād dūrasthavṛkṣe āptavākyāt parimāṇaviśeṣāvagame'pi tadviparītaparimāṇavikṣepadarśanācca viṣayagatājñānānivṛttavapi puruṣagatājñānanivṛttirastyeva| `śāstrārthaṃ na jānāmi' ityanubhūtājñānasya tadupadeśānantaraṃ nivṛttyanubhavāt| ata eva `anumeyādau suṣuptivyāvṛttiḥ' iti vivaraṇasya tadviṣayājñānanivṛttirartha ityuktaṃ tattvadīpane iti| anye tu nayanapaṭalavat puruṣāśritamevājñānaṃ viṣayāvaraṇam| na tadatirekeṇa viṣayagatājñāne pramāṇamasti| na ca puruṣāśritasya viṣayagatavikṣepapariṇāmitvaṃ na sambhavati| tatsaṃbhave vā dūrasthavṛkṣaparimāṇe parokṣajñānādajñānanivṛttau viparītaparimāṇavikṣepo na sambhavatīti vācyam| vācspatimate sarvasya prapañcasya jīvāśritājñānaviṣayīkṛtabrahmavivartatvena tadvacchuktirajatādeḥ puruṣāśritājñānaviṣayīkṛtabrahmavivartatvopapatteḥ| parokṣavṛttyā ekāvasthānivṛttāvapi avasthāntareṇa viparītaparimāṇavikṣepopapatteścetyāhuḥ| apare tu śuktirajatādipariṇāmopapattyāñjasyādviṣayāvaguṇṭhanapaṭavadviṣayagatamevājñānaṃ tadāvaraṇam| na ca tathā sati ajñānasya skṣyasaṃsargeṇa tataḥ prakāśānupapattiḥ, parokṣavṛttinivartyatvāsambhavaści doṣa iti vācyam| avasthārūpājñānasya sākṣyasaṃsarge'pi tatsaṃsṛṣṭamūlājñānasyaiva `śuktimahaṃ na jānāmi' iti prakāśopapatteḥ| śuktyāderapi mūlājñānavivayacaitanyābhinnatayā yadviṣayatvānubhavāvirodhāt| vivaraṇādiṣu mīlājñānasādhanaprasaṅge eva `idamahaṃ na jānāmi' iti pratyakṣapramāṇopadarśanācca `ahamajñaḥ' iti sāmānyato'jñānānubhava eva mīlājñānaviṣayaḥ| `śuktimahaṃ na jānāmi' ityādiviṣayaviśeṣāliṅgitājñānānubharavastvavasthā'jñānaviṣaya iti viśeṣābhyupagame'pyavasthā'vasthāvatorabhedena mūlājñānasya sākṣisaṃsargādvā sākṣiviṣayacaitanyayoḥ vāstavaikyādvā viṣayagatasyāpyavasthā'jñānasya sākṣiviṣayatvopapatteḥ| parokṣajñānasyājñānānivartakatve'pi tatastannivṛttyanubhavasya sattāniścayarūpaparokṣavṛttipratibandhakapparayuktānanubhavanibandhanabhrāntitvopapatteḥ aparokṣajñānasyaivājñānānivartakatvaniyamābhyupagamādityāhuḥ|| nanu nāyamapi niyamaḥ| avidyā'haṅkārasukhaduḥkhāditaddharmapratyakṣasyājñānanivartakatvānabhyupagamāditi cet, na| avidyādipratyakṣasya sākṣirūpatvena vṛttirūpāparokṣajñānasyāvaraṇanivartakatvaniyamānapāyāt||13|| atroktaṃ kūṭasthadīpe dehadvayādhiṣṭhānabhūtaṃ kūṭasthacaitanyaṃ svāvacchedakasya dehadvayasya sākṣādīkṣaṇānnirvikāratvācca sākṣītyucyate| loke'pi hyaudāsīnyabodhābhyāmeva sākṣitvaṃ prasiddham| yadyapi jīvasya vṛttyaḥ santi dehadvayabhāsikāḥ, tathā'pi sarvataḥ prasṛtena svāvacchinnena kūṭasthacaitanyena īṣat sadā bhāsyameva dehadvayaṃ jīvacaitanyasvarūpapratibimbagarbhādantaḥkaraṇādvicchidya vicchidyodgacchadbhirvṛttijñānerbhāsyate| antarālakāle tu saha vṛttyabhāvaiḥ kūṭasthacaitanyenaiva bhāsyate| ata evāhaṃkārādīnāṃ sarvadā prakāśasaṃsargātsaṃśayādyagocaratvam| anyajñānadhārākālīnāhaṃkārasya `etāvantaṃ kālamidamahaṃ paśyannevāsam' ityanusandhānaṃ ca| na ca kūṭasthaprakāśite kathaṃ jīvasya vyavahārasmṛtyādikamiti saṅkyam| anyo'nyādhyāsena jīvaikatvāpattyā kūṭasthasya jīvāntaraṅgatvāt| na ca jīvacaitanyameva sākṣī bhavatu, kiṃ kūṭastheneti vācyam| laukikavaidikavyavahārakartustasyodāsīnadraṣṭṭatvāsambhavena "sākṣī cetā kevalo nirguṇaśca" iti śrutyuktasākṣitvāyogāt| "tayoranyaḥ pippalaṃ svādvattyanaśnannanyo abhicākaśīti" iti karmaphalabhokturjīvādudāsīnaprakāśārūpasya sākṣiṇaḥ pṛthagāmnānācceti|| nāṭakadīpe'pi nṛtyaśālāsthadīpadṛṣṭāntena sākṣī jīvādvivicya darśitaḥ tathāhi nṛtyaśālāsthito dīpaḥ prabhuṃ sabhyāṃśca nartakīm|| dīpayedāviśeṣeṇa tadabhāve'pi dīpyate||11|| tathā cidābhāsaviśiṣṭāhaṃkārarūpaṃ jīvaṃ viṣayabhogasākalyavaikalyābhimānaprayuktaharṣaviṣādavattvāt nṛtyābhimāniprabhutulyam, tatparisaravartitve'pi tadrāhityāt sabhyapuruṣatulyān viṣayān, nānāvidhavikāravarttitvānnartakītulyāṃ dhiyaṃ ca dīpayan suṣuptyādāvahaṃkārādyabhāve'pi dīpyamānaḥ cidābhāsaviśiṣṭāhaṃkārarūpajīvabhramādhiṣṭhānakūṭasthacaitanyātmā sākṣīti| evaṃ jīvādvivecito'yaṃ sākṣī na brahmakoṭirapi, kiṃ tu, aspṛṣṭajīveśvaravibhāgaṃ caitanyamityuktaṃ kūṭasthadīpe|| tattvapradīpikāyāmapi māyāśabalite saguṇe parameśvare "kevalo nirguṇaḥ" iti viśeṣaṇānupapatteḥ sarvapratyagbhūtaṃ viśuddhaṃ brahma jīvābhedena sākṣīti pratipadyate ityuditam || kaumudyāṃ tu eko devaḥ sarvabhūteṣu gūḍhaḥ sarvavyāpī sarvabhūtāntarātmā|| karmādhyakṣaḥ sarvabhūtādhivāsaḥ sākṣarī cetā kevalo nirguṇaśca|| iti devatvādiśruteḥ parameśvarasyaiva rūpabhedaḥ kaścijjīvapravṛttinivṛttyoranumantā svayamudāsīnaḥ sākṣī nāma| sa ca kāraṇatvādidharmānāspadatvād aparokṣo jīvagatamajñānādyavabhāsayaṃśca jīvasyāntaraṅgaḥ| suṣuptyādau ca kāryakāraṇoparame jīvagatājñānamātrasya vyañjakaḥ prājñaśabditaḥ| "tadyathā priyayā striyā sampariṣvakto na bāhyaṃ kiṃcana veda nāntaramevamevāyaṃ puruṣaḥ prājñenātmanā sampariṣvakto na bāhyaṃ kiṃcana veda nāntaram" "prājñenātmanā'nvārūḍha utsarjanyāti" iti śrutivākyābhyāṃ suṣuptyutkrāntyavasthayorjīvabhedena pratipāditaḥ parameśvara iti suṣuptyutkrāntyadhikaraṇanirṇayo'pi sākṣipara ityupavarṇitam|| tattvaśuddhāvapi yathā `idaṃ rajatam' iti bhramasthale vastutaḥ śuktikoṭyantargato'pīdamaṃśaḥ pratibhāsato rajatakoṭiḥ, tathā brahmakoṭireva sākṣī pratibhāsato jīvakoṭiriti jīvasya sukhādivyavahāre tasyopayoga ityuktvā'yameva pakṣaḥsamarthitaḥ|| kecittu avidyopādhiko jīva eva sākṣād dvaṣṭṭatvātsākṣī| loke'pi hyakartṛtve sati draṣṭṭatvaṃ sākṣitvaṃ prasiddham| taccāsaṅgodāsīnaprakāśarūpe jīve eva sākṣāt sambhavati jīvasyāntaḥkaraṇatādātmyāpattyā kartṛtvadyāropabhāktve'pi svayamudāsanitvāt| "eko devaḥ" iti mantrastu brahmaṇo jīvabhāvābhiprāyeṇa sākṣitva pratipādakaḥ| "dvā suparṇā" iti mantraḥ guhādhikaraṇanyāyena jīveśvarobhayaparaḥ, guhādhikaraṇabhāṣyodāhṛtapaiṅgirahasyabrahmāṇavyākhyātena prakāreṇa jīvāntaḥkaraṇobhayaparo veti na kaścidvirodha ityāhuḥ|| anye tu satyaṃ jīva eva sākṣī, na tu sarvagatenāvidyopahitena rūpeṇa| puruṣāntarāntaḥkaraṇādīnāmapi puruṣāntaraṃ pratisvāntaḥkaraṇa bhāsakasākṣisaṃsargāviśeṣeṇa pratyakṣatvāpatteḥ| na cāntaḥkaraṇabhedena pramātṛbhedāttadanāpattiḥ| sākṣibhāsye'ntaḥkaraṇādau sarvatra sākṣyabhede sati pramātṛbhedasyāprayojakatvāt| tasmādantaḥkaraṇopadhānena jīvaḥ sākṣī| tathā ca pratipuruṣaṃ sākṣibhedāt puruṣāntarāntaḥkaraṇādeḥ puruṣāntarasākṣyasaṃsargādvā tadayogyatvādvā aprakāśa upapadyate| suṣuptavapi sūkṣmarūpeṇāntaḥkaraṇasadbhāvāt tadupahitaḥ sākṣī tadā'pyastyeva| na cāntaḥkaraṇopahitasya pramātṛtvena na tasya sākṣitvaṃ, suṣuptau pramātrabhāve'pi sākṣisattvena tayorbhedaścāvaśyaṃ vaktavya iti vācyam| viśeṣaṇopādhyorbhedasya siddhāntasammatatvenāntaḥkaraṇaviśiṣṭaḥ pramātā, tadupahitaḥ sākṣīti bhedopapatterityāhuḥ||14|| nanūktarūpasya sākṣiṇaḥ caitanyamātrāvarakeṇājñānenāvaraṇamavarjanīyamiti kathamāvṛtenāvidyāhaṅgārādibhānamiti cet| vastuto'vidyā'ntaḥkaraṇataddharmāvabhāsakaṃ sākṣicaitanyaṃ vihāyaivājñānaṃ cātanyamāvṛṇotītyanubhavānusāreṇa kalpanānna kaściddoṣaḥ| ata eva sarvadā teṣāmanāvṛtaprakāśasaṃsargāt ajñānaviparītajñānasaṃśayāgocaratvam| sākṣicaitanyasyānāvṛtatve tatsvarūpabhūtasyānandasyāpi prakāśāpattiriti cet, na| iṣṭāpatteḥ| ānandarūpaprakāśaprayuktasyātgani nirupādhikapremṇo darśanāt| `bhāsata eva paramapremāspadatvalakṣaṇaṃ sukham' iti vivaraṇācca||15|| syādetat idānīmapyānandaprakāśe muktisaṃsārayoraviśeṣaprasaṅgaḥ| nanu kalpitabhedasya sākṣyānandasya prakāśe'pi anavacchinnasya brahmānandasyāvṛtasya saṃsāradaśāyāmaprakāśena viśeṣo'stīti cet, na| ānande'navacchedāṃśasyāpuruṣārthatvādānandāparokṣamātrasya cedānīmapi sattvāt| nanvavacchinnassākṣaryānandassātiśayaḥ| suṣuptisādhāraṇādanatispaṣṭāt tato vaiṣāyikānandeṣvatiśayānumavāt| anavacchinno brahmānandastu niratiśayaḥ| ānandavallyāṃ mānuṣānandādyuttarottaraśataguṇotkarṣopavarṇanasya brahmānande samāpanāditi cet, na| siddhānte sākṣyānandaviṣayānandibrahmānandānāṃ vastuta ekatvenotkarṣāpakarṣāsabhbhavāt| mānuṣānandādīnāmuttarottaramutkarṣaṃ śrutirvadatīti cet?| ko vā brūte śrutirna vadatīti! kiṃ tu advaitavāde tadupapādanamaśakyamityucyate| nanvekasyaiva saurālokasya karatalasphaṭikadarpaṇādyabhivyañjakaviśeṣopadhānenābhivyaktitāratamyadarśanāt ekatve'pyānanda0syābhivyañjakasukhavṛttibhedopadhānenābhivyaktitāratamyarūpamutkarṣāpakarṣavattvaṃ yuktamiti cet, na| dṛṣṭāntāsampratipatteḥ| sarvataḥ prasṛmarasya saurālokasya gagane vinā karatalādisambandhamaspaṣṭaṃ prakāśamānasya nimnatale prasṛmarasya jalasyeva karatalasambandhena gatipratihatau bahulībhāvādadhikaprakāśaḥ, bhāsvaradarpaṇādisambundhena gatipratihatau bahulībhāvāttadīyadīptisaṃvalanācca tato'pyadhikaprakāśa iti tatrābhivyañjakopādhikābhivyaktitāratamyānabhyupagamāt| dṛṣṭāntasampratipattau ca gaganaprasṛtasaurālokavat anavacchinnānandasyāspaṣṭatā, karatalādyavacchinnasaurālokavat sukhavṛttyavacchinnānandasyādhikābhivyaktiriti muktitaḥ saṃsārasyaivābhyarhitatvāpatteśca| etena `saṃsāradaśāyāṃ prakāśamāno'pyānando mithyājñānatatsaṃskāravikṣiptatayā tīvravāyuvikṣiptapradīpaprabhāvadaspaṣṭaṃ prakāśate, muktau tadabhāvāt yathāvadavabhāsate' ityapi nirastam| nirviśeṣasvarūpānande prakāśamāne tatra vikṣepadoṣādaprakāśamānasya muktyanvayino'tiśayasyāsambhavāt| tasmāt sākṣyānandasyānāvṛtatvakalpanamayuktam| atrāhuradvaitavidyācāryāḥ yathā'tyutkṛṣṭasyaikasyaiva dhavalarūpasya mālinyatāratamyayuktaṣvanekeṣu darpaṇeṣu pratibimbe satyupādhimālinyatāratamyāttatra tatra pratibimbe dhāvalyāpakarṣastāratamyenādhyasyate, evaṃ vastuto niratiśayasyaikasyaiva svarūpānandasyāntaḥkaraṇapratibimbitatayā sākṣyānandabhāve prāktanasukṛtasaṃpattyadhīnaviṣayaviśeṣasaṃparkaprayuktasattvotkarṣāpakarṣarūpaśuddhitāratamyayuktasukharūpāntaḥkaraṇavṛttipratibimbitatayā viṣayānandabhāve ca tamoguṇarūpopādhimālinyatāratamyadoṣādapakarṣastāratamyenādhyasyate iti saṃsāradaśāyāṃ prakāśamāne'pyānande ādhyastāpakarṣatāratamyena sātiśayattrādatṛptiḥ| vidyodayo nikhilāpakarṣādhyāsanivṛtterāropitasāviśayatvāpāyāt kṛtakṛtyateti viśeṣopapatteḥ nirupādhikapremagocaratayā prakāśamānassākṣyānando'nāvṛta eveti|| anye tu prakāśamāno'pyānando `mayi nāsti,na prakāśate' ityāvaraṇānubhavāt āvṛta eva| ekasminnapi sākṣiṇyavidyākalpitarūpabhedasambhavena caitanyarūpeṇānāvaraṇasyānandarūpeṇāvaraṇasya cāvirodhāt| svarūpaprakāśasyāvaraṇanivartakatayā prakāśamāne āvaraṇasyāvirodhācca| `tvaduktamarthaṃ na jānāmi' iti prakāśamāne evāvaraṇadarśanācca| na ca tatrānāvṛtasāmānyākārāvacchedena viśeṣāvaraṇamevānubhūyate iti vācyam| anyāvāraṇasyānyāvacchedena bhāne'tipraśaṅgāt| na ca sāmānyaviśeṣabhāvo niyāmaka iti nātiprasaṅga iti vācyam| vyāpyavyāpakabhāvātiriktasāmānyaviśeṣabhāvābhāvena `vāhniṃ na jānāmi' iti dhūmāvarakājñānānubhavaprasaṅgāt| tasmādyadavacchinnamajñānaṃ prakāśate, tadevāvṛtamiti prakāśamāne'pyajñānaṃ yujyate| ajñānaṃ ca yathā sākṣyaṃśaṃ vihāya caitanyamāvṛṇoti, evamānandamapi tattatsukharūpavṛttikavalīkṛtaṃ vihāyaivāvṛṇoti| sa eva vaiṣayikānandasyāvaraṇābhibhavaḥ| sa cāvaraṇābhibhavaḥ pratyūṣasamaye bāhyāvaraṇābhibhavavat kāraṇaviśeṣaprayuktavṛttiviśeṣavaśāttaratamabhāvena bhavati| ataḥ svarūpānandaviṣayānandayoḥ viṣayānandānāṃ ca parasparabhedasiddhiriti vadanti| sarvathā'pi sākṣicaitanyasyānāvṛtatvenāvaraṇābhibhavārthaṃ vṛttimanapekṣyaiva tenāhaṃkārādiprakāśanamiti tulyameva||16|| nanvevaṃ kathamahaṅkārādīnāmanusandhānam| jñānasūkṣmāvasthārūpasya saṃskārasya jñāne satyayogena nityena sākṣiṇā tadādhānāsambhavāt|| atre kecidāhuḥ svasaṃsṛṣṭena sākṣiṇā sadā bhāsyamāno'haṃkārastattadghaṭādiviṣayavṛttyākārapariṇatasvāvacchinnenāpi sākṣiṇā bhāsyate iti tasyānityatvāt sambhavati saṃskārādhānaṃ ghaṭādau viṣaye iva| na hi svākāravṛttyavacchinnasākṣiṇaiva svagocarasaṃskārādhānamiti niyamo'sti| tathā sati vṛttigocarasaṃskārāsambhavena vṛtterasmaraṇaprasaṅgāt| anavasthā''pattyā vṛttigocaravṛttyantarasyānuvyavasāyanirasanena nirastatvāt| kiṃ tu vadvṛttyavacchinnacaitanyena yat prakāśate, tad‌vṛttyā tad‌gocarasaṃskārādhānamityeva niyamaḥ| evaṃ ca jñānasukhādayo'pyantaḥ karaṇavṛttayaḥ taptāyaḥpiṇḍād vyuccaranto visphuliṅgā iva svāvacchinnena vahnineva svasvāvacchinnenānityena sākṣiṇā bhāsyante iti yuktaṃ teṣvapi saṃskārādhānam| yastu ghaṭaikākāradhīsthā cid ghaṭamevāvabhāsayet|| ghaṭasya jñātatā brahmacaitanyenāvabhāsate||4|| iti kūṭasthadīpokto viṣayaviśaṣaṇasya jñānasya viṣayāvacchinnabrahmacaitanyāvabhāsyatvapakṣaḥ, paśca tattvapradīpikokto jñānecchādīnāmanavacchinnaśuddhacaitanyarūpanityasākṣibhāsyatvapakṣaḥ, tayerapi caitanyasya svasaṃsṛṣṭāparokṣarūpatvād vṛttisaṃsargo'vaśyaṃ vācya iti tatsaṃsṛṣṭānityarūpasadbhāvānna teṣu saṃskārādhāne kācidanupapattiriti|| anye tu suṣuptāvapyavidyādyanusandhānasiddhaye kalpitāmavidyāvṛttimahamākārāmaṅkīkṛtyāhamarthe saṃskāramupapādayanti| na cāsmin pakṣe `etāvantaṃ kālamidamahaṃ paśyannevāsam' iti anyajñānadhārākālīnāhamarthānusandhānānupapattiḥ| avacchedakabhedena sukhaduḥkhayaugapadyavad vṛttidvayayaugapadyasyāpyavirodhenānyajñānadhārākāle'pi ahamākārāvidyāvṛttisantānasambhavāditi|| apare tu ahamākārā vṛttirantaḥkaraṇavṛttireva| kintu upāsanādivṛttivanna jñānam, klṛptatatkāraṇājanyatvāt| na hi tatra cakṣurādipratyakṣalakṣaṇaṃ sambhavati, na vā liṅāgadikam| liṅgādipratisandhānaśūnyasyāpyahaṃkārānusandhānadarśanāt| nāpi manaḥ karaṇam| tasyopādānabhūtasya kvacidavapi karaṇatvāklṛpteḥ| tarhi ahamarthapratyabhijñā'pi jñānaṃ na syāditi cet, na| tasyā hamaṃśe jñānatvābhāve'pi tattāṃśe smṛtikaraṇatvena klṛptasaṃskārajanyatayā jñānatvāt| aśaṃbhedena jñāne parokṣatvāparokṣatvavat pramātvāpramātvavacca jñānatvā jñānatvayorapi avirodhādityāhuḥ|| itare tu ahamākrārā'pi vṛttirjñānameva| `māmahaṃ jānāmi' ityanubhavāt| naca karaṇāsambhavaḥ| anubhavānusāreṇa manasa evāntarindriyasya karaṇatvasyāpi kalpanādityāhuḥ||17|| evaṃ sati bāhyaviṣayāparokṣavṛttīnāmevāvaraṇābhibhāvakatvaniyamaḥ paryavasannaḥ| nanu nāyamapi niyamaḥ, śuktirajanasthale idamākāravṛtterajñānānabhibhāvakatvāt| anyathopādānābhāvena rajatotpattyayogāditi ceta, atrāhuḥ idamākāravṛttyā idamaṃśājñānanivṛttāvapi śuktitvādiviśeṣāśājñānanivṛtteḥ tadeva rajatopādānam, śuktitvādyajñāne rajatādhyāsasya tadbhāne tadabhāvasyānubhūyamānatvāt| adhyāsabhāṣyaṭīkāvivaraṇe anubhūyamānānvayavyatirekasyaivājñānasya rajatādyadhyāsopādānatvokteḥ| ata eva śuktyaṃśo'dhiṣṭhānam, idamaṃśa ādhāraḥ| savilāsājñānaviṣayo'dhiṣṭhānam, atadrūpo'pi tadrūpeṇāropyabuddhau sphurannādhāra iti saṃkṣepaśārīrake'pi vivecanāditi|| apare tu `idaṃ rajatam' iti idamaṃśasambhinnetvena pratīyamānasya rajatasya idamaṃśājñānamevopādānam| tasya cedamākāravṛttyā āvaraṇaśaktimātranivṛttāvapi vikṣepaśaktyā maha tadanuvṛtteḥ nopādānatvāsambhavaḥ| jalapratibimbitavṛkṣādho'gratvādhyāse jīvanmuktyanuvṛtte prapañcādhyāse ca sarvātmanā adhiṣṭhānasākṣātkārānantarabhāvinyāmāvaraṇanivṛttāvapi vikṣepaśaktikahitājñānamātrasyopādānatvasampratipatterityāhuḥ|| kavitārkikacakravartinṛsiṃhabhaṭṭopādhyāyāstu `idaṃ rajatam' iti bhramarūpavṛttivyatirekeṇa rajatotpatteḥ prāgidamākārā vṛttireva nāstīti tasyā ajñānanivartakatvasadasakadbhāvavicāraṃ nirālambanaṃ manyante| tathāhi na tāvat bhramarūpavṛttivyatirekeṇa idamākārā vṛttiranubhavasiddhā| nāpyadhiṣṭhānasāmānyajñānamadhyāsakāraṇamiti kāryaklpyā| tasyāstatkāraṇatve mānābhāvāt| na cādhiṣṭhānasamprayogābhāve rajatādyanutpāttistatra mānam| tato duṣṭendriyasamprayogasyaivādhyāsakāraṇatvaprapteḥ| na ca samprayogo na sarvatra bhramavyāpī, adhiṣṭhānasphuraṇaṃ tu svataḥprakāśamāne pratyagātmani mahaṅkārādhyāsamapi vyāpnotīti vācyam| tasyāpi ghaṭādyadhyāsāvyāpitvāt| ghaṭādipratyakṣāt prāk tadadhiṣṭhānabhūtanīrūpabrahmātragocaracākṣuṣavṛtterasambhavāt| svarūpaprakāśasyāvṛtatvāt| āvṛtānāvṛtasādhāraṇyenādhiṣṭhānaprakāśamātrasyādhyāsākāraṇatve śuktīdamaṃśasamprayogāt prāgapi tadavacchinnacaitanyarūpaprakāśasyāvṛtasya sadbhāvena tadā'pyadhyāsāpatteḥ| na cādhyāsasāmānye adhiṣṭhānaprakāśasāmānyaṃ hetuḥ, prātibhāsikādhyāse'bhivyaktādhiṣṭhānaprakāśa iti nātiprasaṅgaḥ,sāmānye sāmānyasya viśeṣe viśeṣasya hetutvaucityāditi vācyam| evamapi prātibhāsikaśaṅkhapītimakūpajalanailyādyadhyāsāvyāpanāt| rūpānupahita cākṣuṣapratyayāyogena tadānīṃ śaṅkhādigataśauklyopalambhābhāvena cādhyāsātprāk śaṅkhādinīrūpādhiṣṭhānagocaravṛttyasambhavāt| na ca prātibhāsikeṣvapi rajatādyadhyāsamātre nirukto viśeṣaheturāstāmiti vācyam| tathā sati samprayogāt prāk pītaśaṅkhādyadhyāsāprasaṅgāya tadadhyāse duṣṭendriyasamprayogaḥ kāraṇamityavaśyaṃ vaktavyatayā tasyaiva sāmānyataḥ prātibhāsikādhyāsamātre lāghavāt kāraṇatvasiddhau, tata eva rajatādhyāsakādācitkatvasyāpi nirvāhādadhiṣṭhānaprakāśasya sāmānyato viśeṣato vā'dhyāsakāraṇatvasyāsiddheḥ| nanu sādṛśyanirapekṣe adhyāsāntare akāraṇatve'pi tatsāpekṣe rajatādyadhyāse rajatādisādṛśyabhūtarūpaviśeṣādiviśeṣṭadharmijñānarūpamadhiṣṭānasāmānyajñānaṃ kāraṇamavaśyaṃ vācyam| duṣṭendriyasamprayogamātrasya kāraṇatve śuktivadiṅgāle'pi tadjatādhyāsaprasaṅgāt| na ca sādṛśyamapi viṣayadoṣatvena kālaṇamiti vācyam| visadṛśe'pi sādṛśyabhrame satyadhyāsasadbhāvāt jaladhisalilapūre dūre nīlaśilātalatvāropadarśanāt| na ca `taddhetoreva' iti nyāyāt sādṛśyajñānasāmagnyevādhyāsakāraṇamastviti yuktam| jñānasāmagpyā ārthakāraṇatvasya kvacidapyadṛṣṭeḥ| tatassādṛśyajñānatvasyaiva laghutvācca| na ca svataśśubhre'pi śubhrakaladhautabhṛṅgāragate'pi svacche jale eva nailyādhyāsaḥ, na muktāphale iti vyavasthāvat vastusvabhāvādeva śuktau rajatādhyāsaḥ neṅgālādāviti vyavasthā, na tu sādṛśyajñānāpekṣaṇāditi vācyam| svataḥ paṭakhaṇḍe puṇḍarīkamukulatvānadhyāse'pi tatraiva kartanādighaṭitatadākāre tadadhyāsadarśanena tadadhyāsasya vastusvabhāvamanunurudhya sādṛśyajñānabhāvābhāvānurodhitvaniścayāt| anyathā'nyadā'pi tatra tadadhyāsaprasaṅgāt| ucyate sādṛśyajñānasyādhyāsakāraṇatvavāde'pi viśeṣadarśanapratibadhyeṣu rajatādyadhyāseṣveva tasya kāraṇatvaṃ vācyam| na tu tadapratibadhyeṣu pītaśaṅkhādyadhyāseṣu, asambhavāt| viśeṣadarśanapratibadhyeṣu ca pratibandhakajñānasāmagtyāḥ pratibandhakatvaniyamena viśeṣadarśanasāmagtyapyavaśyaṃ pratibandhikā vācyeti tata eva sarvavyavasthopapatteḥ kiṃ sādṛśyajñānasya kāraṇatvakalpanayā| tathāhi iṅgālādau cakṣuḥsampratyukte tadīyanailyādirūpaviśeṣadarśanasāmagrīsattvānna rajatādhyāsaḥ| śuktyādāvapi nīlabhāgadivyāpicakṣuḥsamprayoge tatsattvānna tadadhyāsaḥ| sadṛśabhāgamātrasamprayoge tadabhāvādadhyāsaḥ| tadā'pi śuktitvarūpaviśeṣadarśanasāmagrīsattvādanadhyāsaprasaṅga iti cet, ni| adhyāsasamaye śuktitvadarśanābhāvena tatpūrvaṃ tatsāmagtyabhāvasya tvayā'pi vācyatvāt| mama sādṛśyajñānarūpādhyāsakāraṇadoṣeṇa pratibandhāt tadā śuktitvadarśanasāmagtyabhāvābhyupagamaḥ| tava tathā'rabhyupagame tu ghaṭṭakuṭīprabhātavṛttānta iti ced, na| sakamīpopasarpaṇānantaraṃ rajatasādṛśyarūpe cākacikye dṛśyamāne eva śuktitvopalambhena tasya tatsāmagrīpratibandhakatvāsiddhau dūratvādidoṣeṇa pratibandhādvā vyañjakanīlapṛṣṭhatvādigrāhakāsamavadhānādvā tatsāmagtyabhāvasya vaktavyatvāt| evaṃ jaladhijale niyatanīlarūpādhyāsaprayojakadoṣeṇa dūre nīratvavyañjakataraṅgādigrāhakāsamavadhānena ca śauklyajalarāśitvādiviśeṣadarśanasāmagtyabhāvācchilātalatvādyadhyāsaḥ| vistṛte paṭe pariṇāharūpaviśeṣadarśanasāmagrīsattvād na puṇḍarīkamukulatvādhyāsaḥ| kartanādighaṭitatadākāre tadabhāvāttadadhyāsa iti| nanvevaṃ karaspṛṣṭe lohaśakale tadīyanīlarūpaviśeṣadarśanasāmagtyabhāvāt rajatādhyāsaḥ kiṃ na bhavet sādṛśyajñānānapekṣaṇāditi ced| bhavatyeva| kiṃ tu tāmrādivyāvartakaviśeṣadarśanasāmagtyabhāvāt tadadhyāsenāpari bhāvyamiti kvacidanekādhyāse saṃśayagocaro bhavati| kvacittu rajataprāye kośagṛhādau rajatādhyāsa eva bhavati| kvacit satyapi sādṛśyajñāne śuktikādau kadācit karaṇadoṣādyabhāvenādhyāsānudayavadadhyāsānudaye'pi na hāniḥ| tasmānna kāryakalpyā idamākāravṛttiḥ| nāpyapratibaddhedamarthasamprayogakāraṇakalpyā| tato bhavantyā evedaṃvṛtterduṣṭendriyasamprayogakṣubhitāvidyāpariṇāmabhṛtasvasamānakālarajataviṣayatvasyāsmābhirucyamānatvāt| tatra ca jñānasamānakālotpattike pratibhāsamātraviparivartini rajate tatprācīnasamprayogābhāve'pi tattādātmyāśrayedamarthasamprayogādeva tasyāpi cakṣurgrāhyatvopapatteḥ| `cakṣuṣā rajataṃ paśyāmi' iti prātibhāsikarajatasya svasamprayogābhāve'pi cākṣuṣatvānuvāt| na ca casvasamprayogābhāvādeva bādhakānna taccākṣuṣamnāpi duṣṭendriyasamprayogajanyam idaṃvṛttisamakālam, jñānakāraṇasyendriyasamprayogasyārthakāraṇatvāklṛpteḥ| kiṃtvidaṃvṛttyanantarabhāvi tajjanyaṃ tadabhivyakte sākṣiṇyadhyāsāt tadbhāsyam| cākṣuṣatvānubhavastu svabhāsakacaitanyabhivyañjakedaṃvṛttijanakatvena paramparayā cakṣurapekṣāmātreṇeti vācyam| tathāsati pītaśaṅkhabhrame cakṣuranapekṣāprasaṅgāt| na hi tatra śaṅkhagrahaṇe cakṣurapekṣā| rūpaṃ vinā kevalaśaṅkhasya cakṣurgrāhyatvāyogāt| nāpi pītimagrahaṇe, āropye aindriyakatvānabhyupagamāt | nacapītimā svarūpato nādhyasyate, kiṃ tu nayanagatapittapītimno'nubhūyamānasya śahkhasaṃsargamātramadhyasyata iti pītimā'nubhavārthameva cakṣurapekṣeti vācyam| tathā sati śaṅkhatatsaṃsargayorapratyakṣatvaprasaṅgāt| nacanapradeśagatapittapītimā''kāravṛttyabhivyaktasākṣyasaṃsargeṇa tayostadhbhāsyatvābhāvāt| pītimasaṃsṛṣṭaśaṅkhagocaraikavṛttyanabhyupagamācca| naca nayanapradeśasthitasya pittapītimno doṣācchaṅkhe saṃsargādhyāso nopeyate, kiṃ tu nayanaraśmibhiḥ saha nirgatasya viṣayavyāpinastasya tatra saṃsargādhyāsaḥ| kusumbhāruṇita iva kausumbha iti sambhavati tadākāravṛttyabhivyaktasākṣisaṃsarga iti vācyam| tathāsati suvarṇalipta iva pittopahatanayanena vīkṣyamāṇe śaṅkhe taditareṣāmapi pītimadhīprasaṅgāt| na ca sa pītimā samīpe gṛhīta eva dūre grahītuṃ śakyaḥ| vihāyasi uparyutpatanvihaṅgama iva itareṣāṃ ca samīpe na grahaṇamiti vācyam| itareṣāmapi taccakṣurnikaṭanyastacakṣuṣāṃ pītimasāmīpyasattvena tadgrahaṇasya durvāratvāt| evamapyatidhavalasikatāmayatalapravahadacchanadījale nailyādhyāse gagananailyādhyāse ca raktavastreṣu niśi candrikāyāṃ nailyādhyāse cānubhūyamānāropasya vaktumaśakyatvena tatra nailyasaṃsṛṣṭādhiṣṭhānagocaracākṣuṣavṛttyanabhyupagame cakṣuranupayogasya duṣpariharatvācca| `anāsvāditatiktarasasya bālasya madhure tiktatā'vabhāso janmāntarānubhavajanyasaṃskārahetukaḥ' iti pratipādayatā pañcapādikāgrahanthena svarūpato'dhyasyamānasyaiva tiktarasasyaindriyakatvasphuṭīkaraṇācca| anyathā tatra rasanāvyāpārapekṣā'nupapatteḥ| tasmādudāhṛtanailyādhyāsasthaleṣvadhiṣṭhānasamprayogādeva tadgocaracākṣuṣavṛttisamakālodayo'dhyāsaḥ tasyā vṛtterviṣaya iti tasya cākṣuṣatvamabhyupagantavyam| rūpaṃ vinā kelādhiṣṭhānagocaravṛttyabhāve ca viṣayacaitanyābhivyaktyabhāvena jalatadadhyasya nailyādīnā tadbhāsyatvāyogāt| tiktarasādhyāsasthale tvadhiṣṭhānādhyāsayorekendriyagrāhyatvābhāvāt tvagindriyajanyādhiṣṭhānagocaravṛttyā tadavacchinnacaitanyābhivyaktau pittopahatarasanasamprayogādeva tatra tiktarasādhyāsaḥ tanmātraviṣayarāsanavṛttiśca samakālamudetīti tiktarasasya rāsanatvamapyabhyupagantavyam| tvagindriyajanyādhiṣṭhānagocaravṛttyabhivyaktacaitanyabhāsyetiktarase paramparayā'pi rasanopayogābhāvena tatra kathamapi prakārāntareṇa rāsanatvānubhavasamarthanāsambhavāt| tathaiva rajatasyāpi cākṣaruṣatvopapatteḥ `paśyāmi' ityanubhavo na bādhanīyaḥ| na cāsamprayuktasya rajatasya cākṣuṣatve `pratyakṣamātre viṣayendriyasannikarṣaḥ kāraṇam,' `rajatapratyakṣe rajatasaṃyogaḥ kāraṇam' iti gṛhītānekakāryakāraṇabhāvaniyamabhaṅgaḥ syāditi vācyam| sannikarṣatvasya saṃyogādyanugatasyaikasyābhāvena ādyaniyamāsiddheḥ| dvitīyaniyamasya naiyāyikarītyā tamasīva saṃyogāyogye kkacidadravye'pi dravyatvādhyāsasambhavād vyavahāradṛṣṭyā yad dravyatvādhikaraṇaṃ tadvipayatvena prātibhāsikarajate dravyatvasyādhiṣṭhānagatasyaivedaṃtvavadadhyāsāt pratītyabhyupagamena ca dvitīyaniyamāvirodhāt| dvitīyaniyamarūpasāmānyakāryakāraṇabhāvātirekeṇa viśiṣyāpi kāryakāraṇabhāvakalpanāyā gauravaparāhatatvena tṛtīyaniyamāsiddheḥ| `yatsāmānye yatsāmānyaṃ hetuḥ, tadviśeṣe tadviśeṣo hetuḥ' iti nyāyasyāpi yatra bījāṅkurādau sāmānyakāryakāraṇabhāvābhyupagame bījāntarādaṅkurāntarotpattyādiprasaṅgaḥ, tadviṣayatvena tato'jāgalastanāyamānaviśeṣakāryakāraṇabhāvāsiddheḥ| na cātrāpi `dravyapratyakṣe dravyasaṃyogaḥ kāraṇam' iti sāmānyaniyamamātropagame anyasaṃyogādanyadravyapratyakṣāpattiriti atiprasaṅgo'stīti vācyam| `tattad‌dravyapratyakṣe tattadadravyasaṃyogaḥ kāraṇam' iti niyamābhyupagamāt| anyathā tṛtīyaniyame'peyatiprasaṅgasya durvāratvāt| tasmānnāsti klṛptacaniyamabhaṅgaprasaṅgaḥ| kiṃ cātra klṛptaniyamabhaṅge'pi na doṣaḥ `idaṃ rajataṃ paśyāmi, nīlaṃ jalaṃ paśyāmi' ityāderananyathāsiddhasyānu bhavasya prathamagṛhītānāmapi `pratyakṣamātre viṣayasannikarṣaḥ kāraṇam' ityādiniyamānāṃ vyāvahārikaviṣaye saṅkocakalpanamantareṇopapādanāsambhavāt| na caivaṃsati `pramāyāṃ sannikarṣaḥ kāraṇaṃ, na bramaḥ' ityapi saṅkocakalpanāsambhavād asannikṛṣṭasyaiva deśāntarasthasya rajatasya ihāropāpattiriti anyathākhyātivādaprasārikā| abhivyaktacaitanyāvaguṇṭhanaśūnyasya deśāntarasthasya rajarasyāparokṣyanupapatteḥ| khyātibādhānupapattyādibhirbhramaviṣayasyānirvacanīyatvasiddheśca| na cādhiṣṭhānasamprayogamātrat prātibhāsikasyaindriyakatvopagame śuktirajatādhyāsasamaye tatraiva kālāntare adhyasanīyasya raṅgasyāpi cākṣuṣatvaṃ kṛto na syāditi vācyam| rajatādhyāsasamaye raṅgarajatasādhāraṇacākacakyadarśanāviśeṣe'pi yato rāgādirūpapuruṣadoṣābhāvāditastatra tadā na raṅgādhyāsaḥ, tata eva mayā tadviṣayavṛttyanudayasyābhyupagamāt| tasmādidamaṃśasaṃbhinnarajatagocaraikaiva vṛttirindriyajanyā| na tataḥ prāgidamākārā vṛttiriti nātraiveyamajñānanivartakatvasadasadbhāvacintā kāryeti| anye tu `adhiṣṭhānajñānamadhyāsakāraṇam' iti idamākārāṃ vṛttimupetya tadabhivyaktenaiva sākṣiṇā tadadhyastasya rajatasyāvabhāsasanbhavāt tadbhāsakasākṣyabhivyañjikayā tayaivedaṃvṛttyā rajataviṣayasaṃskārādhānopapatteśca rajatākāravṛttirvyartheti manyante|| jñānadvayapakṣe `idam' ityekā vṛttiradhyāsakāraṇabhūtā| `idaṃ rajatam' iti dvitīyā vṛttiradhyastarajataviṣayā, na tvidamaṃśaṃ vinā'dhyastamātragocarā sā| `idaṃ rajataṃ jānāmi' iti tasyā idamarthatādātmyāpannarajataviṣayatvānubhavāditi kecit| anye tu yathā idamaṃśāvacchinnacaitanyasthā'vidyā rajatākāreṇa vivartate evamidamaṃśaviṣayavṛttijñānāvacchinnacaitanyasthā'vidyā rajatajñānabhāsākāreṇa vivartate, na tvidamaṃśavṛttivadanadhyastaṃ rajatajñānamasti| tathā ca rajatasya adhiṣṭhānagatedaṃtvasaṃsargabhānavattjajñānasyāpyadhiṣṭhānagatedaṃtvaviṣayatvasaṃsargabhānopapatteḥ na tasyāpīdaṃviṣayatvamabhyupagantavyam| na ca rajatatvavadadhyastasya rajatedaṃtvasaṃsargasya rajatajñānagocaratvāt tatpratiyogina idaṃtvasyāpi tadviṣayatvaṃ vaktavyamiti vācyam| svatādātmyāśrayasya idaṃtvaviṣayatvādeva tasya tatsaṃsargaviṣayatve atiprasaṅgābhāvāt| na cādhiṣṭhānādhyāsayorekasmin jñiāne prakāśaniyamasya sambhāvanābhāṣyavivaraṇe pratipādanād ekavṛttiviṣayatvaṃ vaktavyamiti vācyam| vṛttibhede'pīdamākāravṛttyabhivyakte ekasmin sākṣiṇi tayoḥ prakāśopagamādityāhuḥ||18|| nanu sarvapadārthānāṃ sākṣiprasādādeva prakāśopapatteḥ kiṃ vṛttyā, ghaṭādiviṣayakasaṃskārādhānādyupapattaye tadapekṣaṇe'pi tannirgamābhyupagamo vyarthaḥ| parokṣasthala ivānirgatavṛttyavacchinnasākṣiṇaiva ghaṭāderapi prakāśopapatteḥ| na ca tathā sati parokṣāparokṣavailakṣaṇyānupapattiḥ| śābdānumityoriva karaṇaviśeṣaprayuktavṛttivaijātyādeva tadupapatteḥ|| atra kecidāhuḥ pratyakṣasthale viṣayādhiṣṭhānatayā tadavacchinnameva caitanyaṃ viṣayaprakāśaḥ| sākṣāttādātmyarūpasambandhasambhave svarūpasambandhasya vā'nyasya vā kalpanā'yogāditi tadabhivyakatyarthaṃ yukto vṛttinirgamābhyupagamaḥ| parokṣasthale vyavahite vahnyādau vṛttisaṃsargāyogādindriyavadanvayavyatirekaśālino vṛttinirgamadvārasyānupalambhāccānirgatavṛttyavacchinnacaitanyameva svarūpasambandhena viṣayagocaramagatyā'rthādabhyupagamyate iti|| itare tu śabdānumānāvagatebhyaḥ pratyakṣāvagate spaṣṭatā tāvadanubhūyate| na hi rasālaparimalādiviśeṣe śatavāramāptopadiṣṭe'pi pratyakṣāvagata iva spaṣṭatā'sti| tadanantaramapi `kathaṃ tad?'iti jijñāsā'nuvṛtteḥ| na ca śabdānmādhuryamātrāvagame'pi rasālamādhuryādivṛttyavāntarajātiviśeṣavāciśapabdābhāvāt, tatsattve'pi śrotrāttasyāgṛhītasaṅgatikatvāt śabdādasādhāraṇajātiviśeṣāvacchinnamādhuryāvagamo nāstīti jijñāsā'nuvṛttiryukteti śaṅkyam| `rasāle sarvātiśāyī
