mārdhuyāviśeṣo'sti'ityasmācchabdāttadgatāvāntarajātiviśeṣasyāpyavagamāt| na hyayaṃ viśeṣaśabdastadgataviśeṣaṃ vihāyānyagataṃ viśeṣaṃ tatra bodhayati| aprāmāṇyāpatteḥ| na ca tad‌gatameva viśeṣaṃ viśeṣatvena sāmānyena rūpeṇa bodhayati, na viśiṣyeti jijñāseti vācyam| pratyakṣeṇāpi madhurarasaviśeṣaṇasya jītiviśeṣasya svarūpata eva viṣayīkaraṇena jītiviśeṣagataviśeṣāntarāviṣayīkaraṇād jijñāsā'nuvṛttiprasaṅgāt| tasmāt pratyakṣagrāhye'bhivyaktāparokṣyaikarasacaitanyāvaguṇṭhanātspaṣṭatā jijñāsānivartanakṣamā, śabdādigamye tu tadabhāvādaspaṣṭateti vyavasthā'bhyupagantavyā| ata eva sākṣivedyasya sukhādeḥ spaṣṭatā| śābdavṛttivedyasyāpi brahmaṇo mananādeḥ prāgajñānānivṛttāvaspaṣṭatā, tadanantaraṃ tannivṛttau spaṣṭateti vṛttinirgamamupapādayanti|| nanvetāvatā'pi viṣayāvarakājñānanivṛttyarthaṃ vṛttinirgama ityuktam| tadayuktam| viṣayāvacchinnacaitanyagatasya tadāvarakājñānasyānirgatavṛttyā nivṛttyabhyupagame'pyanatiprasaṅgāt| naca tathā sati devadattīyaghaṭajñānena yajñadattīyaghaṭājñānasyāpi nivṛttiprasaṅgaḥ, samānaviṣayakatvasya sattvāt|ahamarthaviṣayacaitanyaniṣṭhayerjñānājñānayorbhinnāśrayatvena tayorvirodhe samānāśrayatvasyātantratvāditi vācyam| samānāśrayaviṣayatvaṃ jñānājñānayorvirodhaprayojakamaṅgīkṛtya vṛttinirgamanābhyupagame'pi devadattīyaghaṭavṛtteḥ yajñadattīyaghaṭājñānasya ca ghaṭāvacchinnacaitanyaikāśrayatvaprāptyātiprasaṅgatādavasthyena `yadajñānaṃ yaṃ puruṣaṃ pratipadviṣayāvarakaṃ, tat tadīyatadviṣayabhānanivartyam' iti pṛthageva virodhaprayojakasya vaktavyatayā samānāśrayatvasyānapekṣaṇāt|| atrāhuḥ vṛttinirgamanānabhyupagame jñānājñānayorvirodhaprayojakameva durnirūpam| `yadajñānaṃ yaṃ puruṣaṃ prati'ityādyuktamiti cet,na| parokṣajñānenāpi viṣayagatājñānanivṛttiprasaṅgāt| aparokṣatvamapi nivartakajñānaviśeṣaṇamiti cet,| kiṃ tadaparokṣatvam?| na tāvajjātiḥ| `daṇḍyayamāsīt' iti saṃskāropanītadaṇḍaviśiṣṭapuruṣaviṣayakasya cākṣuṣajñānasya daṇḍāṃśe'pi tatsattve tatrāpi viṣayagatājñānanivṛttyāpātāt| `daṇḍaṃ sākṣātkaromi' iti tadaṃśe'pyāparokṣyānubhavāpatteśca| ananubhave'pi saṃskāraṃ sannikarṣaṃ parikalpya indriyasannikarṣajanyatayā tatra kālpanikāparokṣyābhyupagame anumityādāvapi liṅgajñānādikaṃ sannikarṣaṃ parikalpya tadaṅgīkārāpatteḥ| daṇḍāṃśe āparokṣyāsattve tu tasya jātitvāyogād| jātervyāpyavṛttitvani yamāt| tadaniyame'pyavacchedakopādhibhedānirūpaṇena tasyāvyāpyavṛttijātitvāyogācca| nāpyupādhiḥ tadanirvacanāt| indriyajanyatvamiti cet, na| sākṣipratyakṣāvyāpanāt| anumitiśābdajñānopanītagurutvādiviśiṣṭaghaṭapratyakṣe viśeṣaṇāṃśātivyāpanācca| karaṇāntarābhāvena tadaṃśe parokṣe'pyupanayasahakārisāmarthyādindriyasyeva janakatvāt, anugatajanyatāvacchedakāgraheṇānekeṣvindriyajanyatvasya durgrahatvācca| tadgrahe ca tasyaiva prathamapratītasyāparokṣarūpatvopapattau pratyakṣānubhavāyogyasya indriyajanyatvasya tadyogyāparokṣarūpatvakalpanāyogāt| etena `indriyasannikarṣajanyatvamāparokṣyam| upanayasahakṛtendriyajanyaparokṣāṃśe ca na sannikarṣajanyatvam| anumitāvapyupanītabhānasttvena pramāṇāntarasādhāraṇasyopanayasyāsannikarṣatvāt' ityapi śaṅkā nirastā| saṃyogādisannikarṣāṇāmananugamenānanugamācca| yattavābhimatamāparokṣyaṃ, tadeva mamāpyastviti cet, na| tasya śābdāparokṣanirūpaṇaprastāve pratipādanīyasya tatraiva darśanīyayā rātyā ajñānanivṛttiprayojyatvena tannivṛttiprayojakaviśeṣaṇabhāvāyogāt| tasmāt `tarati śokamātmavid' iti śrutasya brahmajñānasya mūlājñānāśrayabhūtasarvopādānabrahmasaṃsarganiyatasya mūlājñānanivarahtakatvāt| `aindriyakavṛttayastattadindriyasannikarṣasāmamarthyātta tadviṣayāvacchinnacaitanyasaṃsṛṣṭā eva utpadyante' iti niyamamupetyājñānāśrayacaitanyasaṃsarganiyatatvaṃ nivartakajñānaviśeṣaṇaṃ vācyam| tathāca `yad ajñānaṃ yaṃ puruṣaṃ pratiyadviṣayāvarakaṃ, tat ,tadīyatadviṣayatadajñānāśrayacaitanyasaṃsargāniyatātmalābhajñānanivartyam' iti jñānājñānayorvirodhaprayojakaṃ nirūpitaṃ bhavati| na caivaṃsati nāḍīhṛdayasvarūpagocaraśabdajñānasyāpyajñānanivartakatvaprasaṅgaḥ| tasya kadācidarthasampannanāḍīhṛdayānyataravastusaṃsargasambhave'pi viṣayasaṃsargaṃ vinā'pi śābdajñānasambhavena tatsaṃsarganiyatātmalābhatvābhāvātṣa| tasmājjñānājñānavirodhanirvāhāya vṛttinirgamo vaktavya iti|| anyetu viṣayagatājñānasya lāghavāt samānādhikaraṇājñānanivartyatvasiddhau vṛttinirgamaḥ phalatītyāhuḥ|| aparetu bāhyaprakāśasya bāhyatamonivartakatvaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇye satyeva dṛṣṭamiti dṛṣṭāntānurodhād vṛttinirgamaḥ sidhyatītyāhuḥ|| kecittu āvaraṇābhibhavārthaṃ vṛttinirgamānapekṣāyāmapi ciduparāgārthaṃ, pramātṛcaitanyasya viṣayaprakāśakabrahmacaitanyabhedābhivyaktyarthaṃ vā tadapekṣetyāhuḥ|| atha kiṃpramāṇako'yaṃ jīvabrahmaṇorabhedaḥ, yo vṛttyā'bhivyajyate? `vedāntapramāṇakaḥ' iti ghaṇṭāghoṣaḥ| sarve'pi vedāntāḥ upakramopasaṃhāraikarūpyāditātparyaliṅgairvimṛśyamānāḥ pratyagabhinne brahmaṇyadvitīye samanvayanti| yathā cāyamarthaḥ, tathā śāstre eva samanvayādhyāye prapañcitaḥ| vistarabhayānneha pradarśyate iti||19|| iti siddhāntaleśasārasaṅgrahe prathamaḥ paricchedaḥ samāptaḥ| <2> || dvitīyaḥ paricchedaḥ || atha kathamadvitīye brahmaṇi vedāntānāṃ samanvayaḥ, pratyakṣā divirodhād? iti cet, na| ārambhaṇādhikaraṇodīhṛtaśrutiyuktibhiḥ pratyakṣādyadhigamyasya prapañcasya brahmavivartatayā mithyātvāvagamāt| nanu na śrutiyuktibhiḥ prapañcasya mithyātvaṃ pratyāyayituṃ śakyate| `ghaṭassan' ityādighaṭādisattvagrāhipratyakṣādivirodhāt| atrāhustattvaśuddhikārāḥ na pratyakṣaṃ ghaṭapaṭādi tatsattvaṃ vā gṛhṇāti, kiṃ tvidhiṣṭhānatvena ghaṭādyanugataṃ sanmātram| tathā ca pratyakṣamapi sadrūpabrahmādvaitasiddhyanukūlameva| tathā sati `sad' `sada' ityeva pratyakṣaṃ syāt, na tu `ghaṭaḥ san' ityādi pratyakṣamindriyānvayavyatirekānuvidhāyīti cet, na| yathā bhrameṣvidamaṃśasyādhiṣṭhānasya pratyakṣeṇa grahaṇam, indriyānvayavyatirekayoḥ tatraivopakṣayaḥ| rajatāṃśasya tvāropitasya bhrāntyā pratibhāsaḥ, tathā sarvatra sanmātrasya pratyakṣeṇa grahaṇam, tatraivendriyavyāpāraḥ| raghaṭādibhedavastupratibhāso brāntyetyabhyupagamāt| nanu tadvadihu bādhādarśanāt tathā'bhyupagama eva nirmūla iti cet, na| bādhādarśane'pi deśakālavyavahitavastuvad ghaṭādibhedavastunaḥ pratyakṣāyogyatvasyaiva tatra mūlatvāt| tathāhi indriyavyāpārānantaraṃ pratīyamāno ghaṭādiḥ sarvato bhinna eva pratīyate| tadā tatra ghaṭādibhede saṃśayaviparyayādarśanāt| yatrāpi sthāṇvādau puruṣatvādisaṃśayaḥ, tatrāpi tavdyatiriktebhyo bhedo'sandigdhaviparyastatvāt prakāśate eva| bhedasya ca pratiyogisahopalambhaniyamavato na pratyakṣaṇa grahaṇaṃ sambhavati| deśakālavyavadhānenāsannikṛṣṭānāmapi pratiyogināṃ sambhavāt| bhedajñānaṃ pratiyogyaṃśe saṃskārāpekṣaṇāt smṛtirūpamastu pratyabhijñānamiva tattāśe iti cet na| tathāpi bhedagatapratiyogivaiśiṣṭyāṃśe tadabhāvāt| na ca kanakācalo bhedapratiyogī, vastutvāditi bhede pratiyogivaiśiṣṭyagocarānumityā tatsaṃskārasambhavaḥ| bhede jñānaṃ vinā'numityabhāvenātmāśrayāpatteḥ| pakṣāsādhyahetupakṣatādyabhedabhrame sati siddhasādha)nādinā'numānāpravṛttyā tadabhedajñānavighaṭanīyasya tadbhedajñānasyāpekṣitatvāt| astu tarhi bhedāṃśe iva pratiyogivaiśiṣṭyāṃśe'pi pratyakṣamiti cet, na| pratiyogino'pratyakṣatve tadvaiśiṣṭyapratyakṣāyogāt sambandhidvayapratyakṣaṃ vinā sambandhapratyakṣāsambhavāt| tasmāt pratyakṣāyogyasya pratiyogino bhrāntirūpa eva pratibhāsa iti tadekavittivedyatvaniyatasya bhedasya bhedaikavittivedyatvaniyatasya ghaṭādeśca bhramaikaviṣayatvāt pratyakṣaṃ nirviśeṣasansātragrāhyādvaitasiddhyanukūlamiti|| nyāyasudhākṛtastvāhuḥ ghaṭāderaundriyakatve'pi `san ghaṭaḥ' ityādiradhiṣṭhānasttānuvedha iti na virodhaḥ| evaṃ "nīlo ghaṭaḥ" ityādiradhiṣṭhānanailyānuvedhaḥ kiṃ na syāditi cet, na| śrutyā sadrūpasya vastuno jagadupādānatvamuktamavirodhāt sarvasammatamiti, tadanuvedhenaiva `san ghaṭaḥ' ityādipratibhāsopapattau ghaṭādāvapi sattākalpane gauravam| tasya rūpādihīnatvād nailyādikaṃ ghaṭādāveva kalpanīyamiti vaiṣamyāditi|| saṃkṣepaśārīrakācāryāstvāhuḥ pratyakṣasya ghaṭādisattvagrāhitve'pi parāgviṣayasya pratyakṣādestattvāvedakatvasakṣaṇaprāmāṇyābhāvād na tadvirodhenādvaitaśrutyādibādhaśahkā| ajñātabodhakaṃ hi pramāṇam| na ca pratyakṣādiviṣayasya ghaṭāderajñātatvamasti| jaḍe āvaraṇakṛtyābhāvenājñānaviṣayatvānupagamāt| svaprakāśatayā prasaktaprakāśaṃ brahmaivājñānaviṣaya iti tadbodhakameva tattvāvedakaṃ pramāṇam| tadeva pramitiviṣayaḥ| ata eva śrutirapi "ātmā vā are draṣṭavyaḥ" ityātmana eva prameyatvamiti niyacchati| nahi "draṣṭavyaḥ" ityanena darśanaṃ vidhīyate, prāmāṇaparatantrasya tasya vidhyagocaratvāt kiṃ tu `ātmā darśanārhaḥ' iti| ajñātatvādātmana eva prameyatvamucitaṃ, nānyasyeti niyamyate iti|| kecittu ghaṭādisattvagrāhiṇaḥ pratyakṣasya prāmāṇye brahmapramāṇanyūnatā'navagame'pi tadgrāhyaṃ sattvamanugatapratyayāt sattājātirūpaṃ vā, `ihedānīṃ ghaṭo'sti' iti deśakālasambandhapratīteḥ tattaddeśakālasambandharūpaṃ vā, `nāsti ghaṭaḥ' iti svarūpaniṣedhapratīterghaṭādisvarūpaṃ vā paryavasyati| tacca svamithyātvena na virudhyate| na hi mithyātvavādinā'pi ghaṭādeḥ svarūpaṃ vā, tasya deśakālasambandho vā, tatra jātyādikaṃ vā nābhyupagamyate, kiṃ tu teṣāmabādhyatvam| na cābādhyatvameva sattvaṃ pratyakṣgrāhyamastviti vācyam| `kālatraye'pi nāsya bādhaḥ' iti vartamānamātragrāhiṇā pratyakṣeṇa grahītumaśakyatvādityāhuḥ|| anyetu abādhyatvarūpasatyatvasya pratyakṣagrāhyatve'pi "prāṇā vai satyaṃ teṣāmeṣa satyam" iti śrutyā pradhanabhūta prāṇagrahaṇopalakṣitasya kṛtsnasya prapañcasya brahmaṇaśca satyatvotkarṣāpakarṣapratīteḥ, satyatve cābādhyatvarūpe sarvadaivābādhyatvaṃ kiñcitkālamabādhyatvamityevaṃvidhotkarṣāpakarṣaṃ vinā`rājarājo manmathamanmathaḥ' ityādiśabdatātparyagocaraniyantṛtvasaundaryādīnāmiva bhūyoviṣayatvālpaviṣayatvādirūpotkarṣāpakarṣāsambhavād, vidhāntareṇa tatsambhave'pi prapañcasya brahmajñānabdhyatvaśrutyantaraikārthyād uktotkarṣāpakarṣe eva paryavasānācca pratyakṣagrāhyaṃ ghaṭādisatyatvaṃ yāvadbahmajñānamavādhyatvarūpamiti na mithyātśrutivirodha ityāhuḥ|| apare tu prapañcasya mithyātvasatyatvagrāhiṇoḥ śrutipratyakṣayorvirodhe'pi doṣaśaṅkākalaṅkitāt prathamapravṛttāt pratyakṣād nirdoṣatvādapacchedanyāyena paratvācca śrutireva balīyasī| prābalyamāgamasyaiva jātyā teṣu triṣu smṛtam|| iti smaraṇācca| na ca vedaikagamyārthaviṣayakamidaṃ smaraṇam| tatra pratyakṣavirodhaśaṅkā'bhāvena śaṅkitapratyakṣavirodhe eva vedārthe vedasya prābalyoktyaucityāt| talavad dṛśyate vyoma khadyoto havyavāḍiva|| na talaṃ vidyate vyoma na khadyoto hutāśanaḥ||1|| tasmāt pratyakṣadṛṣṭe'pi yuktamarthe parīkṣitum|| parīkṣya jñāpayannarthānna dharmāt parihīyate||2|| iti nāradasmṛtau sākṣiprakaraṇe pratyakṣadṛṣṭasyāpi pratyakṣamaviśvasya pramāṇopadeśādibhiḥ parīkṣaṇīyatvapratipādanācca| nahi nabhonailyapratyakṣaṃ nabhasaḥ śabdādiṣu pañcasu śabdaikaguṇatvapratipādakāgamopadeśamantareṇa pratyakṣādinā śakyamapavāditum| na ca `bhāsi samīpe nailyānupalambhād dūre taddhīrdūratvadoṣajanyā' iti niścayena tadbādhaḥ| dūre nailyadarśanāt samīpe tadanupalambhastuhināvaguṇṭhanānupalambhavat sāmīpyadoṣajanya ityapi sambhavād| anubhavabalād nabhonailyamavyāpyavṛttītyupapatteśca| nāpi dūrasthasya puṃso yatra bhūsannihite nabhaḥpradeśe nailyadhīḥ, tatraiva samīpaṃ gatasya tasyā nailyabuddherabhāvapratyakṣeṇa bādhaḥ| uparisthitasyaiva nailyasyābhranakṣatrāderiva dūratvadoṣād bhūsannidhānāvabhāsa ityupapatteḥ| pṛthivyādiṣu saṅkīrṇatayā pratīyamānānāṃ gandhādīnām upalabhyāpsu cedgandhaṃ kecid brūyuranaipuṇāḥ| pṛthivyāmeva taṃ vidyādapo vāyuṃ ca saṃkṣitam||1|| ityādibhirāgamaireva vyavasthāyā vaktavyatvena pratyakṣādāgamaprābalyasya nirviśaṅkatvācca| na hyacājānasiddhajalopaṣṭambhādigataṃ gandhādi`pṛthivīguṇa eva gandhaḥ, na jalādiguṇaḥ' ityādirūpeṇāsmadādibhiḥ pratyakṣeṇa śakyaṃ vivecayitum| pṛthivyādīnāṃ prāyaḥ parasparasaṃsṛṣṭatayā'nyadharmasyānyatrāvabhāsaḥ sambhavati ikati śaṅkitadoṣaṃ pratyakṣam| atastatrāgameva śikṣyata iti cet, tarhi ihāpi brahmapahrapañcayorupādānopādeyabhāvena parasparasaṃsṛṣṭatayā'nyadharmasyānyatrāvabhāsaḥ sambhāvyate iti śaṅkitadoṣaṃ pratyakṣam asti bhāti priyaṃ rūpaṃ nāma cetyaṃśapañcakam|| ādyaṃ trayaṃ brahmarūpaṃ jagadrūpaṃ tato dvayam||1|| iti vṛddhoktaprakāreṇāgamena vyasthāpyatāmiti tulyam| na caivamupajīvalyavirodhaḥ| āgamapramāṇena varṇapadavākyādisvarūpāṃśapratyakṣamupajīvyānupajīvyatatsatyatvāśopamardanādityāhuḥ||1|| nanvāgamasya pratyakṣād balīyastve "yajamānaḥ prastaraḥ" ityatra pratyakṣāvirodhāya yajamānaśabdasya prastare gauṇī vṛttirna kalpanīyā| tathā "somena yañeta" ityatra traiyadhikaraṇyenānvaye yāge iṣṭasādhanatvaṃ, somalatāyāṃ yāgasādhanatvaṃ ca bodhanīyamiti vyāpārabhedena vākyabhedāpatteḥ| sāmānādhikaraṇyenānvaye vaktavye pratyakṣāvirodhāya `somavatā yāgena' iti matvarthalakṣaṇā na kalpanīyā| ubhayatrāpi satyapi pratyakṣavirodhe tadanādṛtyāgamena balīyasā prastare yajamānābhedasya, yāge somābhedasya ca saddhisambhavāditi cet, atroktaṃ bhāmatīnibandhe tātparyavatī śrutipratyakṣāt balavatī, na śrutimātram| mantrārthavādānāṃ tu stutidvārabhūte'rthe vākyārthadvārabhūte padārthe iva na tātparyam| tātaparyābhāve mānāntarāviruddhadevatāvigrahādikaṃ na tebhyaḥ sidhyet| tātparyavatyeva śabdasya prāmāṇyaniyamāditi cet, na| "etasyaiva revatīṣu vāravantīyamagniṣṭomasāma kṛtvā paśukāmo hyetena yajeta" iti viśiṣṭavidhestātparyāgocare'pi viśeṣaṇasvarūpe prāmāṇyadarśanena uktaniyamāsiddheḥ| atra hi revatīṛgādhāraṃ vāravantīyaṃ sāma viśeṣaṇam| na caitat somādiviśeṣaṇavallokasiddham| yena tadviśiṣṭayāgavidhimātre prāmāṇyaṃ vākyasya syāt| nāpi viśiṣṭavidhinā viśeṣaṇākṣepaḥ| ākṣepādviśeṣaṇapratipattau viśiṣṭagocaro vidhiḥ, tasmiṃśca sati tena viśeṣaṇākṣepaḥ iti parasparāśrayāpatteḥ| ato viśiṣṭavidhiparasyaiva vākyasya viśeṣaṇasvarūpe'pi prāmāṇyaṃ vaktavyam| atha ca na tatra tātparyam| ubhayatra tātparye vākyabhedāpatteḥ| evamarthavādānāmapi vidheyastutiparāṇām̐ stutidvārabhūte'rthe na tātparyamiti tebhyaḥ pratyakṣasyaiva balavattvāt tadavirodhāya teṣu vṛttyantarakalpanam| "somena yajeta" ityatra viśiṣṭavidhipare vākye somadravyābhinnapāgarūpaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ vidheyamityupagame tsya vidheyasya "dadhnā juhoti" ityādau vidheyasya dadhyāderiva lokasiddhatvābhāvena vidhiparādvākyādeva revatyādhāravāravantīyviśeṣaṇasyeva vinā tātparyaṃ siddhireṣṭavyā| na hi tātparyavirahitādāgamādyāgasomalatābhedagrāhipratyakṣaviruddhārthaḥ sidhyatīti tatrāpi tadavirodhāyaya matvarthalakṣaṇāraśrayaṇam| advaitaśrutistu upakramopasaṃhāraikarūpyādiṣaḍvidhāliṅgāvagamitādvaitatātparyā pratyakṣād balavatīti tataḥ pratyakṣasyaiva bādhaḥ, na tadavirodhāya śruteranyathānayanamiti| vivaraṇavārtike tu pratipāditam na tātparyavattvena śruteḥ pratyakṣāt prābalyam| "kṛṣṇalaṃ śrapayed" iti vidheḥ śrapaṇasya kṛṣṇalārthatvapratipādane tātparye'pi kṛṣṇale rūparasaparāvṛttiprādurbhāvaparyantamukhyaśrapaṇasambandhaḥ pratyakṣaviruddha iti tadavirodhāya śrapaṇaśabdasya uṣṇīkaraṇamātre lakṣaṇā'bhyupagamāt| "tattvamasi" iti vākyasya jīvabrahmābhedapratipādane tātparye'pi tvampadavācyasya tatpadavācyābhedaḥ pratyakṣaviruddha iti tadavirodhāya niṣkṛṣṭacaitanye lakṣaṇā'bhyupagamācca| arthavādānāmapi prayājādyaṅgavidhivākyānāmiva svārthapramitāvananyārthatayā pramitānāmevārthānāṃ prayojanavaśādanyārthateti prayājādivākyavatteṣāmapyavāntarasaṃsarge tātparyamastyeva| vākyaikavākyatvāt| padaikavākyatāyāmeva paramavāntaratātparyānabhyupagamāditi vivaraṇācāryairnyāyanirṇaye vyavasthāpanena "yajamānaḥ prastaraḥ" ityādīnāmapi mukhyārthatātparyaprasaktau pratyakṣāvirodhāyaiva lakṣaṇā'bhyupagamācca| kathaṃ tarhi śruteḥ prabalyam?| ucyate nirdoṣatvāt paratvācca| śrutimātrasya pratyakṣāt prābalyamityutsargaḥ| kiṃ tu śrutabādhitamapi pratyakṣaṃ kathaṃcit svocitaviṣayopahāreṇa sambhāvanīyam nirviṣayajñānāyogāt| ata evādvaitaśrutivirodhena tattvāvedanāt pracyāvitaṃ satyatvam arthakriyāsamarthavyāvahārikaviṣayasamarahpaṇenopapādyate| kiṃ bahunā `nedaṃ rajatam' iti sarvasiddhapratyakṣabādhitamapi śuktirajatapratyakṣamanubhavānurodhāt purodeśe śuktisaṃbhinnarajatopagamena samarthyate| na tu tadvirodhena vyavahitamāntaramasadeva vā rajataṃ viṣaya iti parikalpyate| evaṃ ca prastare yajamānabhedagrāhiṇo yāvadbrahmajñānamarthakriyāsaṃvādenānuvartamānasya pratyakṣasya prātibhāsikaviṣayatvābhyupagamenopapādanāyogād "yajamānaḥ prastara" iti śrutibādhyatve sarvathā nirviṣayatvaṃ syāditi tatparihārāya utsargamapodya śrutireva tatsiddhyadhikaraṇādipratipāditapparakāreṇānyathā nīyate| na cādvaitaśrutipratyakṣayoriva iha śrutipratyakṣayostāttvikavyāvahārikaviṣayatvopagamena pratyakṣopapādanaṃ kartuṃ śakyam| brahmātiriktasakalamithyātvapratipādakaṣaḍvidhatātparyaliṅgopapannānekaśrutiviruddhena ekonārthavādena prastare yajamānatādātmyasya tāttvikasya pratipādanāsambhavāt| evaṃ tattvamasivākyena tvaṃpadavācyasya sarvajñatvābhoktṛtvākartṛtvādiviśiṣṭabrahmasvarūpatvabodhane tatrāsarvajñatvabhoktṛtvādipratyakṣamatyantaṃ nirālambanaṃ syāditi tatparihārāya`ahaṃkāraśabalitasya bhoktṛtvādi, tato niṣkṛṣṭasyaśuddhasya udāsīnabrahmasvarūpatvam' iti vyavasthāmāśritya bhāgatyagalakṣaṇā''śrīyate| evaṃ "kṛṣṇalaṃ śrapayed" ityādāvapi pratyakṣasyātyanta nirviṣayatvaprasaktau tatparihārāya śrutau lakṣaṇā uṣṇīkaraṇe| "neha nānā'sti kiñcana" ityatra pratyakṣasya kathaṃcidviṣayopapādanasambhave tu na prabalāyāḥ śrateranyathānayanamiti na kaścidapyavyavasthāprasaṅgaḥ| athavā "kṛṣṇalaṃ śrapayet" "somena yajeta"ityādau na pratyakṣānurodhena lakṣaṇā''śrayaṇam, ki tvanuṣṭhānāśaktyā| na hi kṛṣṇale uṣṇīkaraṇamātramiva mukhyaḥ pāko'nuṣṭhātuṃ śakyate| na vā somadravyakaraṇako yāga iva tadabhinno yāgaḥ kenacidanuṣṭhātuṃ śakyate| na cānuṣṭheyatvābhimatasya pratyakṣavirodha evānuṣṭhānāśaktiriti śabdāntareṇa vyavahriyate iti vācyam| `śaśimaṇḍalaṃ kāntimat kuryād' iti vidhau anuṣṭheyatvābhimatasya śaśimaṇḍale kāntimattvasya pratyakṣāvirodhe'pyanuṣṭhānāśaktidarśanena tasyāstato bhinnatvāt| tathā ca tatra eva lakṣaṇā''śrayaṇam| tasmādapacchedanyāyādisiddhasya śrutabalīyastvasya na kaścid bādha iti| atha kathamatrāpacchedanyāyapravṛttiḥ?| ucyate yathā jyotiṣṭome bahiṣpavamānārthaṃ prasarpatāmudgānurapacchede sati "yadyudgātā'paracchidyetādakṣiṇaṃ yajñamiṣṭvā tena punaryajeta" iti śrutinirīkṣaṇena jātā udgātrapacchedanimittakaprāyaścittakartavyatābuddhiḥ paścāt pratihartrapacchede sati "yadi pratihartā'pacchacidyeta sarvavedasaṃ dadyād" iti śrutinirīkṣaṇena jātayā tadviruddhapratihartrapacchedanimittaprāyaścittakartavyatābuddhyā bādhyate| evaṃ pūrva ghaṭādisatyatvapratyakṣaṃ parayā tanmithyātvaśrutijanyabuddhyā bādhyate| na codāhṛtasthale pūrvanaimittikakartavyatābuddheḥ paranaimittikakartavyatābuddhyā bādhe'pi pūrvanaimittikakartavyatājanakaṃ śāstraṃ yatrodgātṛmātrāpacchedaḥ, ubhayorapi yugapadapacchedau vā, udgātrapacchedasya paratvaṃ vā, tatra sāvakāśam, pratyakṣaṃ tu advaitaśrutyā bādhe viṣayāntarābhāvānnirālambanaṃ syāditi vaiṣamyaṃ śaṅkanīyam| yatra ghaṭādau śrutyā bādhye pratyakṣaṃ pravartate, tatraiva vyāvahārikaṃ viṣayaṃ labdhvā kṛtārthasya tasya parāpacchedasthale sarvathā bādhitasya pūrvāpacchedaśāstrasyeva viṣayāntarānveṣaṇābhāvād| ihāpi sarvapratyayavedyabrahmasattāyā sāvakāśaṃ pratyakṣamiti vaktuṃ śakyatvācca| yattvekasminnapi prayoge kramikābhyāṃ nimittābhyāṃ kratau tattannaimittikakartavyatayorbadaraphale śyāmaraktarūpayeriva krameṇotpādād rūpajñānadvayavat kartavyatājñānadvayamapi pramāṇaseveti na pareṇa pūrvajñānabādhe apacchedanyāya udāharaṇam| ata evāpacchedādhikaraṇe "naimittikaśāstrasya hyayamarthaḥ nimittopajananāt praganyathākartavyo'pi kraturnimitte satyanyathā kartavyaḥ" iti śāstradīpikāvacanamiti, tanna| aṅgasya sataḥ kartavyatvam| na ca paścādbhāvipratihartrapacchedavati kratau pūrvavṛttodgātrapacchedanimittakasya pāyaścittasyāṅgatvamasti| āhavanīyaśāstrasya padahomātiriktahomaviṣayatvavad "yadyudgātā'pacchidyeta" iti śāstrasya paścādbhāvipratihartrapacchedarahitakratuviṣayatvāt| uktaṃ hi nyāyaratnamālāyām `sādhāraṇasya śāstrasya viśeṣaviṣayādinā| saṃkocaḥ klṛptarūpasya prāptabādho'rabhidhīyate||' ityuktalakṣaṇaprāptabādhavivecane, "tatraivaṃ sati śāstrārtho bhavati, paścādbhāvyudgātrapacchedavidhurapratihartrapacchedavataḥ kratossarvavedasadānamaṅgam, evamudgātrapacchede'pi draṣṭavyam" iti| yattu śāstradīpikāvacanamudāhṛtam, tadapi tenotpannamapi pūrvaprāyaścittajñānaṃ mithyā bhavati bādhitatvād, uttarasya tu na kiñcidbādhakamastīti pūrvakartavyatābādhyatvapratipādakagranthopasaṃhārapaṭhitatvād nimittopajananātpraṅ nimittopajananaṃ vinā nimittopajananābhāve sati anyathā kartavyo'pīti kṛtvācintāmātraparam| na tūttaranimittopajananātprākpūrvanaimittikakartavyatā vastuta āsīdityevaṃparam| pūrvagranthasandarbhavirakodhāpatteḥ| āstāṃ mīmāṃsakamaryādā| śyāmataduttararaktarūpanyāyena kramikakartavyatādvayotpattyupagame ko virodhaḥ?| ucyate tathāhi kiṃ tat kartavyatvam, yat paranaimittikakartavyatotpattyā nivarteta| na tāvat pūrvanaimittikasya kṛtisādhyatvayogyatvam| tasya paścādapyanapāyāt| nāpi phalamukhaṃ kṛtisādhyatvam| tasya pūrvamapyajananāt| nāpi yadananuṣṭhānakratorvaikalyaṃ, tattvam, aṅgatvaṃ vā| ananuṣṭhāne kratuvaikalyaprayojakatvasya niyamaviśeṣarūpatvena karmāṅgatvasya phalopakāritayā sannipātitayā vā kāraṇatvaviśeṣarūpatvena ca tayoḥ kādācitkatvāyogena svābhāvikatvanirvāhāya paścādbhāviviruddhāpacchedābhāvavataḥ kratoḥ parvāpacchedanaimittikamaṅgam, tatraiva tadananuṣṭhānaṃ kratuvaikalyaprayojakamiti viśeṣaṇīyatayā pāścāttyāpacchedāntaravati kratau pṛrvāpacchedanaimittike kratvaṅgasya, tadananuṣṭhāne kratuvaikalyaprayojakatvasya vā pāścāttyāpacchedotpatteḥ pūrvamasambhavāt| na hi vastu kiñcacidvastvantaraṃ prati kañcitkālaṃ vyāpya paścānneti vā, kañcitkālaṃ kāraṇaṃ paścānneti vā, kkacid dṛṣṭam, yuktaṃ vā| nāpi kartavyatvaṃ nāma dharmāntarabhevāgamāpāyayogyaṃ kalpyam| mānābhāvāt| viruddhāpacchedaśāstrayoḥ padāhavanīyaśāstravavdyavasthopapatteḥ| tasmānnirālambanaṃ kramikakartavyatādvayotpattivacaḥ|| nanu copakramādhikaraṇanyāyenāsañcayātavirodhitvāt pratyakṣamevāgamād balīyaḥ kiṃ na syāt?| ucyate yatraikavākyatā pratīyate, tatraikasminnevārthe paryavasānena bhāvyam, arthabhede pratītaikavākyatābhaṅgaprasaṅgāt| atastatka prathamasañjātapratipakṣeṇa "prajāpatirvaruṇāyāśvamanayad" ityādyupakrameṇa parakṛtisarūpārthavādena dāturiṣṭau buddhimadhiropitāyāṃ tadviruddhārthaṃ "yāvato'śvān pratigṛhṇīyāttāvato vāruṇān catuṣkapālānnirvaped" ityupasaṃhāragataṃ padajātamupajātapratipakṣātvādyathāśrutārthasamarpaṇena tadekavākyatāmapratipadyamānamekavākyatānirvāhāya ṇijarthamantarbhāvya tadānuguṇyenaivātmānaṃ labhate iti upakramasya prābalyam| yatra tu parasparamekavākyatā na pratīyate| tatra pūrvavṛttamavigaṇayya labdhātmakaṃ viruddhārthakaṃ vākyaṃ svārthaṃ bodhayatyeveti na tatra pūrvavṛttasya prābalyam| ata eva ṣoḍaśigrahaṇavākyaṃ pūrvavṛttamavigaṇayya tadagrahaṇavākyasyāpi svārthabodhakatvamupeyate, kintubhayorviṣayāntarābhāvād agatyā tatraiva vikalpānuṣṭhānamiṣyate| evaṃ cādvaitāgamasya pratyakṣeṇaikavākyatvaśaṅkā'bhāvāt pūrvavṛttamapi tadavigaṇayya svārthabodhakatvamapratihatam| tadarthabodhajanane ca pūrvaṃ paramajātatvādabādhitvaiva jāyate| parasyānanyathotpādānnādyābādhena sambhavaḥ|| ityapacchedanyāyasyaiva pravṛttiḥ, nopakramanyāyasya| ata eva loke'pi prathamavṛttaṃ śuktirūpyapratyakṣamāptopadeśena bādhyata iti||2|| nanu tathā'pyupajīvyatvena pratyakṣasyaiva prābalyaṃ durvāram| apacchedaśāstrayorhi na pūrvaṃ parasyopajīvyamiti yuktaḥ pareṇa pūrvasya bādhaḥ| iha tu varṇapadādisvarūpagrahakatayā mithyātvabodhakāgamaṃ prati pratyakṣasyopajīvyatvād āgamasyaiva tadviruddhamithyātvābodhakatvarūpo bādho yujyate| na ca mithyātvaśrutyā varṇapadādisatyatvāṃśopamarde'pi upajīvyasvarūpāṃśopamardābhāvānnopajīvyavirodha iti vācyam| "neha nānāsti kiñcina" ityādiśrutibhiḥ svarūpeṇaiva prapañcābhāvābodhanāt|| atra kecidāhuḥ `vṛṣamānaya' ityādivākyaṃ śravaṇadoṣād `vṛṣabhamānaya' ityādirūpeṇa śṛṇvato'pi śābdapramitidarśanena śābdapramitau varṇapadādipratyakṣaṃ pramābhramasādhāraṇamevāpekṣitamityadvaitāgamena varṇapadādipratyakṣamātramupajīvyam, na tatpramā| tathā ca varṇapadādisvarūpopamarde'pi nopajīvyavirodha iti|| anye tvāhuḥ śābdapramitau varṇapadādisvarūpasiddhyanapekṣāyāmapyayogyaśabdāt pramityanudayādyogyatāsvarūpasiddhyapekṣā'sti| tadapekṣāyāmapi nopajīvyavirodhaḥ| "neha nānāsti" itiśrutyā niṣedhe'pi yāvadbrahmajñānamanuvartamānasyārthakriyāsaṃvādino'sadvilakṣaṇaprapañcasvarūpasyāṅgīkārāt| anyathā pratyakṣādīnāṃ vyāvahārikapramāṇānāṃ nirviṣayatvaprasaṅgāt| na ca svarūpeṇa niṣedhe'pi kathaṃ prapañcaṭasvarūpasyātmalābhaḥ| niṣedhasya pratiyogyapratikṣeparūpatve vyāghātāditi vācyam| śuktau `idaṃ rajatam,' `nedaṃ rajatam' iti pratītidvayānurodhenādhiṣṭhānagatādhyastābhāvasya bādhaparyantānuvṛttikāsadvilakṣaṇapratiyogisvarūpasahiṣṇutvābhyupagamāt| etena prapañcasya svarūpeṇa niṣedhe śaśaśṛṅgavadasattvameva syāditi nirastam| pabrahmajñānanivartyasvarūpāṅgīkāreṇa vaiṣamyāt| na cāsyādhyastasyādhiṣṭhāne svarūpeṇa niṣedhe anyatra tasya svarūpeṇa niṣedhaḥ svataḥ siddha iti tasya sarvadeśakālasambandhiniṣedhapratiyogitvāpattyā asattvaṃ durvāram| `sarvadeśakālasambandhiniṣedhapratiyogitvamasattvam' ityevāsattvanirvacanād, vidhāntareṇa tannirvacanāyogādeti vācyam| asataḥ sarvadeśakālasambandhiniṣedhapratiyogitvamupagacchatā, tasya tathātve pratyakṣasya sarvadeśakālayoḥ pratyakṣīkaraṇāyogena, āgamasya tādṛśāgamānupalambhena ca pramāṇayitumaśakyatayā'numānameva pramāṇayitavyamiti tadanumāne yat savdyāvṛttaṃ liṅgaṃ vācyam, tasyaiva prathamapratītasyāsattvanirvacanatvopapatterityāhuḥ|| aparetu "neha nānāsti" iti śruteḥ satyatvena prapañcaniṣedhe eva tātparyam, na svarūpeṇa| niṣedhasya svarūpāpratikṣepakatve tasya tanniṣedhatvāyogāt| tatpratikṣepakatve pratyakṣavirodhāt| na ca satyatvasyāpi `san ghaṭaḥ' ityādipratyakṣasiddhatvād na tenāpi rūpeṇa niṣedho yukta iti vācyam| pratyakṣasya śrutyavirodhāya satyatvābhāsarūpavyāvahārikasatyatvāviṣayatvopapatteḥ| ne caivaṃ sati parrimākhathakasatyatvasya brahmagatasya prapañce prasaktyabhāvāt tena rūpeṇa prapañcaniṣedhānupapattiḥ| yathā śuktau rajatābhāsapratītireva satyarajataprasaktiriti tanniṣedhaḥ, ata eva `nedaṃ rajatam, kiṃ tu tat,' `neyaṃ madīyā gauḥ' kiṃ tu saiva,' `nātra vartamānaścaitraḥ, kiṃ tvapavarake' iti niṣidhyamānasyānyatra sattvamavagamyate, evaṃ satyatvābhāsapratītireva satyatvaprasaktiriti tanniṣedhopapatteḥ| ato varṇapadayogyatādisvarūpopamardaśaṅkābhāvānnopajīvyavirodha ityāhuḥ|| anye tu brahmaṇi pāramārthikasatyatvam, prapañce vyavahārikasatyatvaṃ satyatvābhāsarūpam, śuktirajatādau prātibhāsikasatyatvaṃ tato'pi nikṛṣṭamiti sattātraividhyaṃ nopeyate, adhiṣṭhānabrahmagatapāramārthikasattā'nuvedhādeva ghaṭādau śuktirajatādau ca sattvābhimānopapattyā satyatvābhāsakalpanasya niṣpramāṇakatvāt| evaṃ ca prapañce satyatvapratītyabhāvāt, tattādātmyāpanne brahmaṇi tatpratīterevāvivekena prapañce tatprasaktyupapatteśca satyatvena prapañcaniṣedhe nopajīvyavirodhaḥ, na vā aprasaktaniṣedhanam| na ca brahmagatapāramārthikasattā'tirekeṇa prapañce sattvābhāsānupagame vyavahitasatyarajatātirekeṇa śuktau rajatābhāsotpattiḥ kimanarthamupeyata iti vācyam| vyavahitasyāsannikṛṣṭasyāparokṣyāsambhavāt tannirvāhāya tadupagamāt||3|| nanvevaṃ pratibimbabhramasthale'pi grīvāsthamukhātirekeṇa darpaṇe mukhābhāsotpattirūpeyā syāt| svakīye grīvāsthamukhe nāsādyavacchinnapradeśāparokṣyasambhave'pi nayanagolakalalāṭādipradeśāparokṣyāyogāt| pratibimbabhrame nayanagolakādipradeśāparokṣyadarśanācca| na ca bimbātiriktapratibimbābhyupagame iṣṭāpattiḥ| brahmapratibimbajīvasyāpi tato bhedena mithyātvāpatteḥ| atra vivaraṇānusāriṇaḥ prāhuḥ grīvāstha eva mukhe darpaṇopādhisannidhānadoṣād darpaṇasthatvapratyaṅmukhātvabimbabhedānāmadhyāsasambhavena na darpaṇe mukhasyādhyāsaḥ kalpanīyaḥ| gauravād| `darpaṇe mukhaṃ nāsti' iti saṃsargamātrabādhāt| mithyāvastvantaratve `nedaṃ mukham' iti svarūpabādhāpatteḥ| `darpaṇe mama mukhaṃ bhāti' iti svamukhābhedapratyabhijñānācca| na ca grīvāsthamukhasyādhiṣṭhānasyāparokṣyāsambhavaḥ| upādhipratihatanayanaraśmīnāṃ parāvṛtya bimbagrāhitvaniyamābhyupagamāllatādivad| tanniyamānabhyupagame paramāṇoḥ, kuhyādivyavahitasthūlasyāpicākṣuṣapratibimbabhramaprasaṅgāt| naca `avyavahitasthūlodbhūtarūpavata eva cākṣuṣapratibimbabhramaḥ, nānyasya' iti niyama iti vācyam| bimbasthaulyodbhūtarūpayoḥ klṛptena cākṣuṣajñānajananena upayogasambhave vidhāntareṇopayogakalpanānupapatteḥ| kuḍyādivyavadhānasya pratihatanayanaraśmisambandhavighaṭanaṃ vinaiveha pratibandhakatve tathaiva ghaṭapratyakṣādisthale'pi tasya pratibandhakatvasambhavena cakṣuḥsannikarṣamātrasya kāraṇatvavilopaprasaṅgācca| darpaṇe mithyāmukhādhyāsavādinā'pi kāraṇatrayāntargatasaṃskārasiddhyarthaṃ nayanaraśmīnāṃ kadācit parāvṛtya svamukhagrāhakatvakalpanayaiva pūrvānubhavasya samarthanīyatvācca| na ca nāsādipradeśāvacchinnapūrvānubhavādeva saṃskāropapattiḥ| tāvatā nayanagolakādipratibimbādhyāsānupapatteḥ taṭākasalile taṭaviṭapisamārūḍhāṣṭacarapuruṣapratibimbādhyāsasthale kathamapi pūrvānubhavasya durvacatvācca| evaṃ copādhipratihatanayanaraśmīnā bimbaṃ prāpya tadgrāhakatve 'vaśyaṃ vaktavya phalabalāddarpaṇādyabhihatānāmeva bimbaṃ prāpya tadgrāhakatvam, na śilādipratihatānām| anatisvacchatāmrādipratihatānāṃ malinopādhisambandhadoṣād mukhādisaṃsthānaviśeṣāgrāhakatvaṃ sākṣātsūryaṃ prepsūnāmiva upādhiṃ prāpya nivṛttānāṃ na tathā sauratejasā pratihatiriti na pratibimbasūryāvalokane sākṣāttadavalokane ivāśkyatvam| jalādyupādisannikarṣe keṣā cidupādhipratihatānāṃ bimbaprāptāvapikeṣāṃ cittadantargamanenāntarasikatādigrahaṇamityādikalpanānna kaściddoṣa iti|| advaitavidyākṛtastu pratibimbasy mithyātvamabhyupagacchatāṃ trividhajīvavādināṃ vidyāraṇyaguruprabhṛtīnāmabhiprāyamevamāhuḥ caitramukhād bhedena tatsadṛśatvena ca pārśvasthaiḥ spaṣṭaṃ nirīkṣyamāṇaṃ darpaṇe tatpratibimbaṃ tato bhinnaṃ svarūpato mithyaiva, svakaragatādiva rajatācchuktirajatam| na ca `darpaṇe mama mukhaṃ bhāti' iti bimbābhedajñānavirodhaḥ| spaṣṭabhedvitvapratyaṅmukhatvādijñānavirodhenābhedajñānāsambhavād| `darpaṇe mama mukham' iti vyapadeśasya svacchāyāmukhe svamukhavyapadeśavad gauṇatvācca| na cābhedajñānavirodhād bhedavyapadeśa eva gauṇaḥ ki na syāditi śaṅkyam| bālānāṃ pratibimbe, ruruṣāntarabhramasya hānopādtsādyarthakriyāparyantasyāpalapitumaśakyatvāt| na ca prekṣāvatāmapi svamukhaviśeṣaparijñānāya darpaṇādyupādānadarśanād abhedajñānamapyarthakriyāparyantamiti vācyam| bhede'pi pratibimbasya bimbasamānākāratvaniyamaviśeṣaparijñānādeva tadupādānopapatteḥ| yattu `nātra mukham' iti darpaṇe mukhasaṃsargamātrasya bādhaḥ, na mukhasyeti| tanna| `nedaṃ rajatam' ityatrāpi idamarthe rajatatādātmyamātrasya bādho, na rajatasyetyāpatteḥ| yadi ca idamaṃśe rajatasya tādātmyenādhyāsād `nedaṃ rajatam' iti tādātmyena rajatasyaiva bādhaḥ, na tādātmyamātrasya, tadā darpaṇe mukhasya saṃsargitayā'dhyāsād `nātra mukham' iti saṃsargitayā mukhasyaiva bādhaḥ, na saṃsargamātrasyeti tulyam| yattu dharmiṇo'pyadhyāsakalpane gauravamiti, tad rajatābhāsakalpanāgauravavat prāmāṇikatvānna doṣaḥ| svanetragolakādipratibimbabhramasthale bimbāparokṣyakalpanopāyābhāvāt| nayanaraśmīnāmupādhipratihatānāṃ bimbaprāptikalpane hi dṛṣṭaviruddhaṃ bahvāpadyate| kathaṃ hi jalasannikarṣe keṣucinnayanaraśmiṣu pratihatamantargacchatsu anye jalasambandhenāpi pratihanyamānā nitāntamṛdavaḥ sakalanayanaraśmipratighātinaṃ kiraṇasamūhaṃ nirjitya tanmadhyagataṃ sūryamaṇḍalaṃ praviśeṣuḥ| kathaṃ ca candrāvalokana iva tatpratibimbāvalokane'pi amṛtaśītalaṃ tadvimbasannikarṣaviśeṣe locanayoḥ śaityābhivyaktyā āpyāyanaṃ na syāt| kathaṃ ca jalasambandhenāpi pratihanyamānāḥ śilādisambandhena na pratihanyeran| tatpratihatyā parāvṛttau vā nayanagolakādibhirna saṃsṛjyeran| tatsaṃsarge vā saṃsṛṣṭaṃ na sākṣātkārayeyuḥ| doṣeṇāpi hi viśeṣāṃśagrahaṇamātraṃ pratibadhyamānaṃ dṛśyate, na tu sannikṛṣṭadharmisvarūpagrahaṇamapi| pratimukhādhyāsapakṣe tu na kañcid dṛṣṭaviruddhaṃ kalpanīyam| tathāhi avyavahitasthūlodbhūtarūpasyeva cākṣuṣādhyāsadarśanādbimbagatasthaulyodbhūtarūpayoḥ svāśrayasākṣātkārakāraṇatvena klṛptayoḥ svāśrayapratibimbādhyāse'rapi kāraṇātvam, kuḍyādyāvaraṇadravyasya tvagindriyādinyāyena prāpyakāritayā'vagatanayanasannikarṣavighaṭanadvārā vyavalahitavastusākṣātkārapratibandhakatvena klṛptasya vyavahitapratibimbādhyāse'pi vinaiva dvārāntaraṃ pratibandhakatvaṃ ca kalpanīyam| tatra ko virodhaḥ kkacit kāraṇatvādinā klṛptasya phalabalādanyatrāpi kāraṇatvādikalpane| etenopādhipratihatanayanaraśmīnāṃ bimbaprāptyanupagame vyavahitasyodbhūtarūpādirahitasya ca cākṣuṣapratibimbabhramaprasaṅga iti nirastam| kiṃ ca tadupagame eva iktadūṣaṇaprasaṅgaḥ| katham?| sākṣāt sūryāvalokana iva vinā cakṣurvikṣepamavanatamaulinā nirīkṣyamāṇe salile tataḥ pratihatānāṃ nayanaraśmīnāmūrdhvamutplutya pabimbasūryagrāhakatvavat niryakcakṣurvikṣepaṃ vinā ṛjucakṣuṣā darpaṇe vilokyamāne tatpratihatānāṃ pārśvasthamukhagrāhakatvavacca vadanasācīkaraṇābhāve'pyupādhipratihatānāṃ pṛṣṭhābhāgavyavahitagralāhakatvaṃ tāvaddurvāram| upādhipratihatanayanaraśmīnāṃ pratinivṛttiniyamaṃ vihāya yatra bimbaṃ tatraiva gamanopagamāt| tathā malinadarpaṇe śyāmatayā gauramukhapratibimbasthale bidyamānasyāpi bimbagatagaurarūpasya cākṣuṣajñāne'nupayogitayā pītaśaṅkhabhramanyāyenāropyarūpavaiśiṣṭyenaiva bimbamukhasya cākṣuṣatvaṃ nirvāhyamiti, tathaiva nīrūpasyāpi darpaṇopādhiśyāmatvavaiśiṣṭyena cākṣuṣapratibimbabhramaviṣayatvamapi durvāram| svato nīrūpasyāpi nabhaso'dhyastanailyavaiśiṣṭyena cākṣuṣatvasaṃpratipatteḥ| tasmāt svarūpataḥ pratimukhādhyāsapakṣa eva śreyān| na ca tatrāpi pūrvānubhavasaṃskāradaurghaṭyam| puruṣasāmānyānubhavasaṃskāramātreṇa svapneṣvadṛṣṭacarapuruṣādhyāsavanmukhasāmānyānubhavasaṃskāramātreṇa darpaṇeṣu mukhaviśeṣādhyāsopapatteḥ| iyāṃstu bhedaḥ svapneṣu śubhāśubhahetvaladṛṣṭānurodhena puruṣākṛtiviśeṣādhyāsaḥ, iha tu bimbasannidhānānurodhena mukhākṛkativiśeṣādhyāsa iti| na ca pratibimbasya svarūpato mithyātve brahmapratibimbajīvasyāpi mithyātvāpattirdoṣaḥ| pratibimbajīvasya tathātve'pyavacchinnajīvasya satyatayā muktibhāktvopapatteriti|| yattu pratibimbaṃ darpaṇādiṣu mukhācchāyāviśeṣarūpatayā satyameveti kasyācinmatam, tanna| chāyā hi nāma śarīrādestattadavayavairāloke kiyaddeśavyāpini niruddhe tatra deśe labdhātmakaṃ tama eva| na ca mauktikamāṇikyādipratibimbasya tamoviruddhasitalohitādirūpavatastamorūpacchāyātvaṃ yuktam| na vā tamorūpacchāyārahitatapanādipratibimbasya tathātvamupapannam| nanu tarhi pratibimbarūpacchāyāyāstamorūpatvāsambhave dravyāntaratvamastu, klṛptadravyānantarbhāve tamovad dravyāntaratvakalpanopapatteriti cet| tat kiṃ dravyāntare pratīyamānarūpaparimāṇasaṃsthānaviśeṣapratyaṅmukhatvādidharmayuktam, tadrahitaṃ vā syāt?| antye na tena dravyāntareṇa rūpaviśeṣādighaṭitapratibimbopalambhanirvāha iti vyarthaṃ tatkalpanam| prathame tu kathamekasminnalpaparimāṇe yugapadasaṃkīrṇatayā pratīyamānānāṃ mahāparimāṇānāmanekamukhapratibimbānāṃ satyatānirvāhaḥ?| kathaṃ ca nibiḍāvayavānusyūte darpaṇe tathaivāvatiṣṭhamāne tadantarhanunāsikādyanekanimnonnatapradeśavato dravyāntarasyotpattiḥ?| kiṃ ca sitapītaraktādyanekavarṇādimataḥ pratibimbasyotpattau darpaṇamadhye sthitaṃ tatsannihitaṃ na tādṛśaṃ kāraṇamasti| yadyucyeta`upādhimadhyaviśrantiyogyaparimāṇānāmeva pratibimbānāṃ mahāparimāṇajñānaṃ tādṛśanimnonnatādijñānaṃ ca bhrama eva| yathāpūrvaṃ darpaṇatadavayavāvasthānāvirodhena tādṛkpratibimbotpādanasamarthaṃ ca kiñcayit kāraṇaṃ kalpyam' iti| tarhi śuktirajatamapi satyamastu| tatrāpi śuktau yathāpūrvaṃ sthitāyāmeva tattādātmyāpannarajatotpādanasamarthaṃ kiñcitkāraṇaṃ parikalpya tasya rajatasya doṣatvābhimatakāraṇasahakṛtendriyagrāhyatvaniyamavarṇanopapatteḥ kiṃ `śuktirajatamasatyam, pratibimbaḥ satyaḥ' ityardhajastīyanyāyena| na ca tathāsati `rajatam' iti dṛśyamānāyāḥ śukteragnau prakṣepe rajatavad dravībhāvāpattiḥ| analakastūrikādipratibimbasyauṣṇyasaurabhādirāhityavacchuktirajatasya dravībhāvalayogyatārāhityo papatteḥ| athocyeta "nedaṃ rajatam", `mithyaiva rajatamabhād' iti sarvasaṃpratipannabādhānna śuktirajataṃ satyam iti| tarhi `darpaṇe mukhaṃ nāsti, mithyaivātra darpaṇe mukhamabhād' ityādisarvasiddhabādhāt pratibimbamapyasatyamityeva yuktam| tasmādasaṅgataḥ pratibimbasatyatvavādaḥ|| nanu tanmithyātvavādo'pyayuktaḥ| śuktirajata iva kasya cidanvayavyatirekaśālinaḥ kāraṇasyājñānasya nivartakasya ca jñānasya cānirūpaṇāt|| atra kecit yadyapi sarvātmanā'dhiṣṭhānajñānānantaramapi jāyamāne pratibimbādhyāse nādhiṣṭhānāvaraṇamajñānamupādānam, na vā'dhiṣṭhānaviśeṣāṃśajñānaṃ nivartakam, tathā'pyadhiṣṭhānājñānasyāvaraṇaśaktyaṃśena nivṛttāvapi vikṣepaśaktyaṃśaṃnānuvṛttisambhavāt tadevopādānam| bimbopādhisannidhinivṛttisacivaṃ cādhiṣṭhānajñānaṃ sopādānasya tasya nivartakamiti|| anye tu jñānasya vikṣepaśaktyaṃśaṃ vihāyāvaraṇaśaktyaṃśamātranivartakatvaṃ na svābhāvikam| brahmajñānena mūlajñānasya śuktyādijñānenā'vasthā'jñānasya cāvaraṇaśaktyaṃśamātranivṛttau tasya vikṣepaśaktyā sarvadā'nuvṛttiprasaṅgāt| na ca bimbopādhisannidhirūpavikṣepaśaktyaṃśanivṛttipratibandhakaprayuktaṃ tat| bimbopādhisannidhānāt prāgeva bimbe caitramukhe darpaṇasaṃsargādyabhāve darpaṇe caitramukhābhāve vā pratyakṣato'vagamyamāne vikṣepaśaktyaṃśasyāpi nivṛttyavaśyambhāvena tatkāle tayossnnidhāne sati upādānābhāvena pratibimbabhramābhāvaprasaṅgāt| ato mūlājñānameva pratibimbādhyāsasyopādānam| na cātrāpyuktadoṣataulyam| parāgviṣayavṛttipariṇāmānā svasvaviṣayāvacchinnacaitanyapradeśe mūlajñānāvaraṇaśaktyaṃśābhibhāvakatve'pi tadīyavikṣepaśaktyaṃśānivartakatvāt| anyathā tatpradeśasthitavyāvahārikavikṣepāṇāmapi vilayāpatteḥ| na ca pratibimbasya mūlājñānakāryatve vyāvahārikatvāpattiḥ| avidyātiriktadoṣājanyatvasya vyāvahārikatvaprayojakatvāt| prakṛte ca tadatiriktābimbopādhisannidhānadoṣasadbhāvena prātibhāsikatvopapatteḥ| na caivaṃ sati bimbopādhisannidhinivṛttisahakṛtasyāpyadhiṣṭhānajñānasya pratibimbādhyāsānivartakatvaprasaṅgaḥ, tanmūlājñānanivartakatvābhāvāditi vācyam| virodhābhāvāt| brahmājñānānivartakatve'pi tadupādānakapratibimbādhyāsavirodhiviṣayakatayā'dhiṣṭhānayāthātmyajñānasya pratibandhakavirahasacivasya tannivartakatvopapatteḥ| avasthā'jñānopādānatvapakṣe'pi tasya prācīnādhiṣṭhānajñānanivartitāvaraṇaśaktikasya samānaviṣayatvabhaṅgena pratibandhakābhāvakālīnādhiṣṭhānajñānena nivartayitumaśakyatayā pratibimbādhyāsamātrasyaiva tannivartyatvasyopeyatvāt| athavā svopādānājñānanivartakabrahmajñānanivartya evāyamadhyāso'stu| vyāvahārikatvāpttistu avidyātiriktadoṣajanyatvena pratyuktetyāhuḥ||4|| evaṃ svapnādhyāsasyāpyanavacchinnacaitanye ahaṅkāropahitacaitanye vā'vasthārūpajñānaśūnye'dhyāsāt, `sūṣuptyākhyaṃ tamo'jñānaṃ yad būjaṃ svapnabodhayoḥ'| iti ācāryāṇāṃ svapnajāgratprapañcayorekājñānakāryatvokteśca mūlājñānakāryatayā svopādānanivartakabrahmajñānaikabādhyasya avidyā'tiriktanidrādidoṣajanyatayaiva prātibhāsikatvāmiti kecidāhuḥ|| anye tu `bādhyante caite rathādayaḥ svapnadṛṣṭāḥ prabodhe' iti bhāṣyokteḥ, `avidyātmakabandhapratyanīkatvād jāgradbodhavad' iti vivaraṇadarśanād, utthitasya svapnamithyātvānubhavācca jāgradbodhassvāpnādhyāsanivartaka iti brahmajñānetarajñānabādhyatayaiva tasya prātibhāsikatvam| na cādhiṣṭhānayāthātmyāgocaraṃ svopādānājñānānivartakaṃ jñānaṃ kathamadhyāsanivartakaṃ syāditi vācyam| rajjusarpādhyāsasya svopādānājñānanivartakādhiṣṭhānayāthātmyajñāneneva tatraiva svānantarotpannadaṇḍabhrameṇāpi nivṛttidarśanādityāhuḥ| apare tu jāgradbhogapradamarmoparame sati jāgratprapañcadraṣṭāraṃ pratibimbarūpaṃ vyāvahārikaṃ jīvaṃ taddṛśyaṃ jāgratprapañcamapyāvṛtya jāyamāno nidrārūpo mūlājñānasyāvasthābhedaḥ svāpnaprapañcādhyāsopādānam, na mūlājñānam| na ca nidrāyā avasthājñānarūpatve mānābhāvaḥ| mūlājñānenāvṛtasya jāgratprapañcadraṣṭuḥ pyāvahārikajīvasya `manuṣyo'ham, brāhmaṇo'ham, devadattaputro'ham' ityādinā svātmānamasandigdhāviparyastamabhimanyamānasya tadīyaciraparicayona taṃ prati sarvadā anāvṛtaikarūpasyānubhūtasvapitāmahātyayādijāgratprapañcavṛttāntasya ca svapnasamaye kenaci ṇābhāve jāgaraṇa iva svapne'pi `vyāghro'ham, śūdro'ham, ttaputro'ham' ityādibhramasya svapitāmahajīvadṛśādibhramasya cābhāvaprasaṅgena nidrāyā eva tatkālotpannavyāvahārikajagajjīvāvārakājñānāvasthābhedarūpatvasiddheḥ| na caivaṃ jīvasyāpyāvṛtatvāt svapnaprapañcasya draṣṭbhāvaprasaṅgaḥ| svapnaprapañcena saha draṣṭurjīvasyāpi prātibhāsikādhyāsāt| evaṃ ca punarjāgradbhogapradakarmodbhūte bodhe vyāvahārikajīvasvarūpajñānāt svopādānanidrārūpājñānanivartakādeva svāpnaprapañcabādhaḥ| na caivaṃ taddraṣṭuḥ prātibhāsikajīvasyāpi tato bādhe `svapne kariṇamanvabhūvam' ityānusandhānaṃ na syāditi vācyam| vyāvahārikajīve prātibhāsikajīvasyādhyastatayā tadanubhavāvdyāvahārikajīvasyānusandhānopagame'pyatiprasaṅgābhāvādityāhuḥ| nanvanavacchinnacaitanye ahaṅkāropahitacaitanye vā svāpnaprapañcādhyāsi iti prāguktaṃ pakṣadvayamapyayuktam| ādye svāpnagajāderahaṅkāropahitaskṣiṇo vicchinnadeśatvena sukhādivadantaḥ paraṇavṛttisaṃsargamanapekṣya tena prakāśanasya, cakṣurādīnāmuparatatayā vṛttyudayāsambhavena tatsaṃsargamapekṣya tena prakāśanasya cāyogāt| dvitīye `idaṃ rajatam' itivad `ahaṃ gajaḥ' iti vā `ahaṃ sukhī'itivad `ahaṃ gajavān' iti vā'dhyāsaprasaṅgāt|| atra kecidādyapakṣaṃ samarthayante ahaṅkārānavacchinnacaitanyaṃ na dehādbahiḥ svāpnaprapañcasyādhiṣṭhānamupeyate, kiṃ tu tadantareva| ata eva dṛśyamānaparimāṇocitadeśasampattyabhāvāt svāpnagajādīnā māyāmayatvamucyate| evaṃ cāntaḥkaraṇasya dehādbahirasvātantryājjāgaraṇe bāhyaśuktīdamaṃśādigocaravṛttyutpādāya cakṣurādyapekṣāyāmapi dehāntarantaḥkaraṇasya svatantrasya svayameva vṛttisambhavāddehāntarantaḥkaraṇavṛttyabhivyaktasyānavacchinnacaitanyasyādhiṣṭhānatve na kācidanupapattiḥ| ata eva yathā jāgaraṇe samprayogajanyavṛttyabhivyaktaśuktīdamaṃśāvacchinnacaitanyāsthitā'vidyā rūpyākāreṇa vivartate, tathā svapne'pi dehasyāntarantaḥkaraṇavṛttau nidrādidoṣopahitāyāmabhivyaktacaitanyasthāvidyā adṛṣṭodbodhitanānāviṣayasaṃskārasahitā prapañcākāreṇa vivartatāmiti vivaraṇopanyāse bhāratītīrthavacanamiti|| anye tvanavacchinnacaitanyaṃ na vṛttyabhivyaktaṃ sat svāpnaprapañcasyādhiṣṭhānam| aśabdamūlakānavacchinnacaitanyagocaravṛttyudayāsambhavād ahaṅkārādyavacchinnacaitanya evāhamākāravṛttyudayadarśanāt| tasmāt svato'parokṣamahaṅkārādyanavacchinanacaitanyaṃ tadadhiṣṭhānam| ata eva saṃkṣepaśārīrake `aparokṣarūpaviṣayabhramadhīraparokṣamāspadamapekṣya bhavet|' manasā svatonayanato yadi vā svapanabhramādiṣu tathā prathiteḥ|| iti ślokenāparokṣādhyāsāpekṣitamidhiṣṭhānāparokṣyaṃ kvacit svataḥ, kvacinmānasavṛttyā, kvacid bahirindriyavṛttyetyabhidhāya, `svato'parokṣā citistra vibhramastathā'pi rūpākṛtireva jāyate| manonimittaṃ svapena muhurmuhurvinā'pi cakṣurviṣayaṃ svamāspadam|| mano'vagamye'pyaparokṣatābalāttathā'mbare rūpamupollikhan bhramaḥ| sitādibhedairbahudhā samīkṣyate yathā'kṣagamye rajatādivibhrame'|| ityādyanantaraślokena svapnādhyāse svato'dhiṣṭhānāparokṣyamudāhṛtam| na cāhaṅkārānavicchinna caitanyamātramāvṛtamiti vṛttimantareṇa na tadabhivyaktiriti vācyam| brahmacaitanyamevāvṛtamavidyāpratibimbajīvacaitanyamahaṅkārānavacchinnamapyanāvṛtamityupagamād| evaṃ cāhaṅkārānavacchinnacaitanye'dhyasyamāne svāpnagajādau tatsamaniyatādhiṣṭānagocyarāntaḥkaraṇādivṛttikṛtābhedābhivyaktyā pramātṛcaitanyasyāpi `idaṃ paśyāmi' iti vyavahāra ityāhuḥ|| apare tu samarthayante ahaṅkārāvacchinnacātanyamadhiṣṭhānamityahaṅkārasya viśeṣaṇabhāvenādhiṣṭhānakoṭipraveśo nopeyate, kiṃ tvaṅkahāropahitaṃ tatpratibimbarūpacaitanyamātramadhiṣṭhānamiti| ato `nāhaṃ gajaḥ' ityādyanubhavaprasaṅga iti| evaṃ śuktirajatamapi śuktīdamaṃśāvacchicaitanyapratibimbe vṛttimatadantaḥkaraṇagate'dhyasyate| śuktidamaṃśāvacchinnabimbacaitanye sarvasādhāraṇare tasyādhyāse sukhādivadananyavedyatvābhāvaprasaṅgāditi kecit|| kecittu bimbacaitanya eva tadadhyāsamupetya `yadīyājñānopādānakaṃ yat, tattasyaiva pratyakṣam, na jīvāntarasya' ityananyavedyatvamupapādayanti||5|| nanu śuktirajatādhyāse cākṣuṣatvānubhavaḥ sākṣādvā'dhiṣṭhānajñānadvārā tadapekṣaṇādvā kathsaryate| svāpnagajādicākṣuṣatvānubhavaḥ kathaṃ samarthanīyaḥ| ucyate| na tāvat tatsamarthanāya svāpnadehavadviṣayavacca indriyāṇāmapi prātibhāsiko vivartaḥ śakyate vaktum| prātibhāsikasyājñātasattvābhāvāt| indriyāṇāṃ cātīndriyāṇāṃ sattve'jñātasattvasya vācyatvāt| nāpi vyāvahārikāṇamevendriyāṇāṃ svasvagolakebhyo niṣkramya svāpnadehamāśritya svasvaviṣayagrāhakatvaṃ vaktuṃ śakyate| svapnasamaye teṣāṃ vyāpārarāhityarūpoparatiśravaṇāt| vyāvahikasya sparśanendriyasya svocitavyāvahārikadeśasampattividhurāntaḥśarīre svādhikaparimāṇakṛtsnasvāpnaśarīravyāpitvāyogacca| tadekadeśāśrayatve ca tasya svāpnajalāvagāhanajanyasarvāṅgīṇaśītasparśānirvāhāt| ata eva `svapne jāgradindriyāṇāmuparatāvapi taijasavyavahāropayuktāni sūkṣmaśarīrāvayavabhūtāni śūkṣmendriyāṇi santīti taissvāpnapadārthanāmaindriyakatvam, ityupapādanaśaṅkā'pi nirastā| jāgradindriyavyatiriktasūkṣmendriyāprasiddheḥ| kiñca `atrāyaṃ puruṣaḥ svayañjyotiḥ' iti jāgare ādityādijyotirvyatikarāccakṣarurādivṛttisañcārācca durvivekamātmanaḥ svayaṃjyotiṣṭvamiti svapnāvasthāmadhikṛtya tatrātmanaḥsvayañjyotiṣṭvaṃ pratipādayati| anyathā tasya sarvadā svayañjyotiṣṭvenātreti vaiyarthyāt| tatra yadi svapne'pi cakṣurādivṛttisañcāraḥ kalpyeta, tadā tatrāpi jāgara iva tasya svayañjyotiṣṭvaṃ durvivecaṃ syādityutadāhṛtā śrutiḥ pīḍyeta| nanu svapne cakṣurādyuparamakalpane'pi antaḥkaraṇamanuparatamāsta iti pariśeṣāsiddherna svayañjyotiṣṭvavivekaḥ| maivam| `kartā śāstrārthavattvād' ityadhikaraṇe nyāyanirṇayoktarītyā'ntaḥkaraṇasya cakṣurādikaraṇāntaranirapekṣasya jñānasādhanatvābhāvādvā, tattvapradīpikoktarītyā svapne tasyaiva gajādyākāreṇa pariṇāmena jñānakarmatayā'vasthitatvena tadānīṃ jñānasādhanatvāyogādvā pariśeṣopapatteḥ| na ca svapne'ntaḥkaraṇavṛttyabhāve utthitasya svapnadṛṣṭagajādyanusandhānānupapattiḥ| suṣuptiklṛptayā avidyāvṛttyā tadupapatteḥ| suṣuptau tadavasthopahitameva svarūpacaitanyamajñānasukhādiprakāśaḥ utthitasyānusandhānamupādhibhūtāvasthāvināśajanyasaṃskāreṇeti vedāntakaumudyabhimate suṣuptāvavidyāvṛttyabhāvapakṣe ihāpi svāpnagajādibhāsakacaitanyopādhibhūtasvapnāvasthāvināśajanyasaṃskārādanusandhānopapatteśca| athavā "tadetat sattvaṃ yena svapnaṃ paśyati" ityādiśruterastu svapne'pi kalpatarūktarītyā svāpnagajādigocarāntaḥkaraṇavṛttiḥ| na ca tāvatā pariśeṣāsiddhiḥ| antaḥkaraṇasya `aham'itigṛhyamāṇasya sarvātmanā jīvaikyenādhyastatayā lokadṛṣṭyā tasya tavdyatirekāprasiddheḥ pariśeṣārthaṃ cakṣurādivyāpārābharāvamātrasyaivāpekṣitatvāt| `prasiddhadṛśyamātraṃ dṛgavabhāsayogyam' iti niścayasattena pariśeṣārthamanyānapekṣaṇāt| tasmāt sarvathā'pi svapne cakṣurādivyāpārāsambhavāt svāpnagajādau cākṣuṣatvādyanubhavo brama eva| nanu svapne'pi cakṣurunmīlane gajādyanubhavaḥ, tannimīlane neti jāgara iva gajādyanubhavasya cakṣurunmīlanādyanuvidhānaṃ pratīyate iti cet| `cakṣuṣā rajatādikaṃ paśyāmi' ityanubhavavadayamapi kaścit svapnabhramo bhaviṣyati yat kevalasākṣirūpe svāpnagajādyanubhave cakṣugadyanuvidhānaṃ tadanuvidhāyinī vṛttirvā'dhyasyate| kimiva hi durghaṭamapi bhramaṃ māyā na karoti viśeṣato nidrārūpeṇa pariṇatā, yasyā māhātmyāt svapne rathaḥ pratītaḥ kṣaṇena manuṣyaḥ pratīyate, sa ca kṣaṇena mārjāraḥ| svapnadraṣṭuśca na pūrvāparavirodhānusandhānam| tasmādanvayādyanuvidhānapratītitaulye'pi jāgradgajādyanubhava eva cakṣulādijanyaḥ, na svāpnagajādyanubhavaḥ|| dṛṣṭisṛṣṭivādinastu kalpitasyājñātasattvamanupapannamiti kṛtsnasya jāgratprapañcasya dṛṣṭisamasamayāṃ mṛṣṭimupetya ghaṭādidṛṣṭeścakṣuḥsannikarṣānuvidhānapratītiṃ dṛṣṭeḥ pūrvaṃ ghaṭādyabhāvenāsaṅgacchamānāṃ svapnavadeva samarthayamānāḥ jāgradgajādyanubhavo'pi na cākṣuṣa ityāhuḥ|| nanu, dṛṣṭisṛṣṭimavalambaya kṛtsnasya jāgratprapañcasya kalpitatvopagame kastasya kalpakaḥ nirupādhirātmā vā, avidyopahito vā?| nādyaḥ| mokṣe'pi sādhanāntaranirapekṣasya kalpakasya sattvena prapañcānuvṛttyā saṃsārāviśeṣaprasaṅgāt| na dvitīyaḥ| avidyāyā api kalpanīyatvena tatkalpanātprāgeva kalpakasiddhervaktavyatvāt| atra kecidāhuḥ pūrvapūrvakalpitāvidyopahita uttarottarāvidyākalpakaḥ| anidaṃprathamatvācca kalpakakalpanāpravāhasya nānavasthādoṣaḥ| na cāvidyāyā anāditvopagamācchuktirajatavatū kalpitatvaṃ na yujyate, anyathā sādyanādivibhāgānupapatteriti vācyam| yathā svapne kalpyamānaṃ gopurādi kiñcit pūrvasiddhatvena kalpyate, kiñacittadānīmutpādyamānatvena, evaṃ jāgare'pi kiñcit kalpyamānaṃ sāditvena kalpyate, kiñcidanyatheti tāvatā sādyanādivibhāgopapatteḥ| etena kāryakāraṇavibhāgo'pi vyākhyāta iti| anye tu vastuto'nādyevāvidyā''di| tatra dṛṣṭisṛṣṭirnopeyate, kiṃ tu tato'nyatra prapañcamātre ityāhuḥ|| nanvevamapi śrutimātrapratītasya viyadādisargatatkramādaḥ kaḥ kalpakaḥ?| na ko'pi| kimālambanā tarhi "ātmana ākāśaḥ sambhūtaḥ" ityādiśrutiḥ?|niṣprapañcabrahmātmaikyāvalambanetyavehi| adhyāropāpavādābhyāṃ niṣprapañcabrahmapratipattirbhavatīti tatpratipattyupāyatayā śrutiṣu sṛṣṭipralayopanyāsaḥ, na tātparyeṇeti bhāṣyādyuddhoṣaḥ| vyarthastarhi tātparyābhāve viyatprāṇapādayorviyadādisargatatkramādiviṣayaśrutīnāṃ parasparavirodhaparihārāya yatnaḥ?| na vyarthaḥ| nyāyavyutpattyarthamabhyupetya tātparyaṃ tatpravṛtteḥ| uktaṃ hi śāstradarpaṇe `śrutīnāṃ sṛṣṭitātparyaṃ svīkṛtyedamiheritam| vrahmātmaikyaparatvāttu tāsāṃ tannaiva vidyate||'iti| jyotiṣṭomādiśrutibodhitānuṣṭhānāt phalasiddhiḥ svāpna śrutibodhitānuṣṭhānaprayuktaphalasaṃvādatulyā| jyotiṣṭomādiśrutīnā ca sattvaśuddhidvārā brahmaṇi tātparyānnāprāmāṇyamityādidṛṣṭisṛṣṭivyutpādanaprakriyāprapañcastvākaragrantheṣu draṣṭavyaḥ| ayameko dṛṣṭisamasamayā viśvasṛṣṭiriti dṛṣṭisṛṣṭivādaḥ| anyastu dṛṣṭireva viśvasṛṣṭiḥ| dṛśyasya dṛṣṭibhede pramāṇābhāvāt| `jñānasvarūpamevāhurjagadetadvicakṣaṇāḥ| arthasvarūpaṃ bhrāmyantaḥ paśyantyante kudūṣṭyaḥ||' iti smṛteśceti siddhāntamuktāvalyādidarśino dṛṣṭisṛṣṭivādaḥ| dvividhe'pi dṛṣṭisṛṣṭivāde manaḥpratyayamalabhamānāḥ ke cidācāryāḥ sṛṣṭadṛṣṭivādaṃ rocayante| śrutidarśitena krameṇa parameśvarasṛṣṭamajñātasattāyuktameva viśvaṃ tattadviṣayapramāṇāvataraṇe tasya tasya dṛṣṭisiddhiriti| na caivaṃ prapañcasya kalpitatvābhāve śrutyādipratipannasya sṛṣṭipralayādimataḥ pratyakṣādipratipannārthākriyākāriṇascha tasya satyatadvamevābhyupagataṃ syāditi vācyam| śuktirajatādivat samprayogasaṃskāradoṣarūpeṇa, adhiṣṭhānajñānasaṃskāradoṣarūpeṇa vo kāraṇatrayeṇājanyatayā kalpanāsamasamayatvābhāve'pi jñānaikanivartyatvarūpasya, sadasadvilakṣaṇatvarūpasya, pratipannopādhigatatraikālikaniṣedhapratiyogitvarūpasya vā mithyātvasyābhyupagamāt| satyatvapakṣe prapañce uktarūpamithyātvābhāvena tato bhedāt|| nanvevamahaṅkārataddharmāṇāmapi uktarūpamithyātvaṃ viyadādivat kalpitatvābhāve'pi sidhyatīti bhāṣyaṭīkāvivaraṇeṣu tadadhyāse kāraṇatritayasampādanādiyatno vyartha iti ced| ahaṅkārādīnāmapi kevalasākṣivedyatayā śuktirajatavat prātibhāsikatvamabhimatamiti citsukhācāryāḥ|| abhyupetyavādamātraṃ tat| `advitīyādhiṣṭhānabrahmātmapramāṇasya caitanyasya' ityāditatratyakāraṇatritayasampādanagranthasya caitanyasya pramākaraṇatve vedāntakaraṇatvādikalpanābhaṅgaprasaṅgena prauḍhivādatvasya sphuṭatvāditi rāmādvyācāryāḥ||7|| nanu dṛṣṭisṛṣṭivāde, sṛṣṭidṛṣṭivāde ca mithyātvasampratipatteḥ kathaṃ mithyābhūtasyārthakriyākāritvam?| svapnavāditi brūmaḥ| nanu svāpnajalādisādhyāvagāhanādirūpā'rthakriyā asatyaiva, kiṃ tu jāgrajjalādisādhyā sā satyā? aviśiṣṭamubhayatrāpi svasamānasttākārthakriyākāritvamiti kecit|| advaitavidyācāryāstvāhuḥ svāpnapadārthānāṃ na kevalaṃ prabodhabādhyārthakriyāmātrakāritvam| svāpnāṅganābhujaṅgamādīnāṃ tadabādhyasukhabhayādijanakatvasyāpi darśanāt| svāpnaviṣayajanyasyāpi hi sukhabhayādeḥ prabodhānantaraṃ na bādho'nubhūyate, pratyuta prabodhānantaramapi manaḥprasādaśarīrakampanādinā saha tadanuvṛttidarśanāt prāgapi sattvamevāvasīyate| ata eva prāṇināṃ punarapi sukhajanakaviṣayagocarasvapne vāñchā, atādṛśe ca svapne pradvaiṣaḥ| sambhavati ca svapne'pi jñānavad antaḥkaraṇavṛttirūpasya sukhabhayāderudayaḥ| na ca svāpnāṅganādijñānameva sukhādijanakam, tacca sadeveti vācyam| tasyāpi darśanasparśanādivṛttirūpasya svapnaprapañcasākṣiṇyadhyastasya kalpanāmātrasiddhatvāt| na hyuparatendriyasya cakṣurādivṛttayaḥ satyāḥ sambhavanti| na ca tadviṣayāparokṣyamātraṃ sukhajanakam, tacca sākṣirūpaṃ sadeveti vācyam| darśanāt sparśane kāminyāḥ, padā sparśanātpāṇinā sparśane; bhujaṅgasyāmarmasthale sparśanād marmasthale sparśane sukhaviśeṣasya bhayaviśeṣasya cānubhavasiddhatvena svapne'pi tattatsukhabhayādiviśeṣasya kalpitadarśanasparśanādivṛttiviśeṣajanyatvasya vaktavyatvāditi| tathā jāgare ghaṭādiprakāśanakṣamatatrātyupuruṣāntaranirīkṣyamāṇālokavatyapavarake sadyaḥ praviṣṭena puṃsā kalpitasya santamasasya prasiddhasantamasocitārthakriyākāritvaṃ dṛṣṭam| tena taṃ prati ghaṭādyāvaraṇam, dīpādyānayane tadapasaraṇam, tannayane punarāvaraṇamityāderdarśanādityapi kecit|| anye tu pānāvagāhanādyarthakriyāyāṃ jalādisvarūpamātramupayogi, ta tadgataṃ satyatvam| tasya kāraṇatvatadavacchedakatvayorabhāvāditi kiṃ tena| na caivaṃsati marumarīcikodakaśuktirajatāderapi prasiddhodakādyucitārthakriyākāritvaprasaṅgaḥ| `marīcikodakādāvudakatvādijātirnāstīti tadviṣayakabhramasya udakaśabdollekhitvaṃ tadullekhipūrvānubhavasaṃskārajanyatvaprayuktam' iti tattvaśuddhikārādimate tattadarthakriyāprayojakodakatvādijātyabhāvādeva tadaprasaṅgāt| tatrāpyudaktvādijātirasti| anyathā tadvaiśiṣṭyollekhibhramavirodhād, udakādyarthinastatra pravṛttyabhāvaprasaṅgācceti prātibhāsike pūrvadṛṣṭasajātīyatvavyavahārānurodhināṃ mate kvacidadhiṣṭhānaviśeṣajñānena samūlādhyāsanāśāt, kvacidadhiṣṭhānasāmānyajñānoparameṇa kevalādhyāsanāśāt, kkacit guñjāpuñjādau cakṣuṣā vahnyādyadhyāsasthale dāhapākādiprayojakasyoṣṇasparśāderanadhyāsācca tatra tatrārthakriyābhāvopapatteḥ| kvacit kāsāṃ cidarthakriyāṇāmiṣyamāṇatvācca| marīcikodakādivyāvartakasyārthakriyopayogirūpasya vaktavyatva ca śrutiviruddhaṃ pratyakṣādinā durgrahaṃ trikālābādhyatvaṃ vihāya doṣaviśeṣājanyarajatatvādereva rajatādyucitārthakriyopayogirūpasya vaktuṃ śakyatvācca| tasmānmithyātve'pyarthakriyākāritvasambhavānmithyaiva prapañcaḥ, na satya iti||8|| nanu mithyātvasya prapañcadharmasya satyatve brahmādvaitakṣatestadapi mityaiva vaktavyamiti kutaḥ prapañcasya satyatvakṣatiḥ?| mithyābhūtaṃ brahmaṇaḥ saprapañcatvaṃ na niṣprapañcatvavirodhīti tvaduktarītyā mithyābhūtamithyātvasya satyatvāvirodhāt|| atroktamadvaitadīpikāyām viyadādiprapañcasamānasvabhāvaṃ mithyātvam| tacca dharmiṇaḥ satyatvapratikṣepakam| dharmasya svaviruddhadharmapratikṣepakatve hi ubhayavādisiddhaṃ dharmisamasattvaṃ tantram, na pāramārthikatvam| aghaṭatvādipratikṣepake paṭatvādāvasmākaṃ pāramārthikātvāsampratipatteḥ| brahmaṇaḥ saprapañcatvaṃ na dharmisamasattākamiti na niṣprapañcatvapratikṣepakam| ata eva mikhathyātvasya vyāvahārikatve tadvirodhino'prātibhāsikasya prapañcasatyatvasya pāramārthikatvaṃ syāditi nirastam| dharmisamasattākasya mithyātvasya vyāvahārikatve dharmiṇo'pi vyāvahārikatvaniyamāt| athavā yo yasya svaviṣayasākṣātkāranivartyo dharmaḥ, sa tatra svaviruddhadharmapratikṣepakaḥ| śuktau śuktitādātmyaṃ tadviṣayasākṣātkārānivartyam aśuktitvavirodhi, tatraiva rajatatādātmyaṃ tannivartyarajatatvāvirodhīti vyavasthādarśanāt| evaṃ ca prapañcamithyātvaṃ kalpitamapi prapañcasākṣātkārānivartyamiti satyatvapratikṣepakameva| brahmaṇaḥ saprapañcatvaṃ tu brahmasākṣātkāranivartyamiti na niṣprapañcatvapratikṣepakamiti| etena śabdagamyasya brahmaṇaḥ satyatve śapabdayogyatāyāḥ, śābdadhīprāmāṇyasya ca satyatvaṃ vaktavyam| prātibhāsikayogyatāvatā'nāptavākyena vyāvahārikārthasya vyāvahārikayogyatāvatā'gnihotrādivākyena tāttvikārthasya vā siddhayabhāvena yogyatāsamānasattākasyaiva śabdārthasya siddhiniyamāt| arthābādharūpaprāmāṇyasyāsatyatve arthasya satyatvāyogācca| tathā ca brahmātiriktasatyavastusattvena dvaitāvaśyambhāva iti viyadādiprapañco'pi satyo'sviti nirastam| vyāvahārikasyārthakriyākāritvasya vyavasthāpitatvena vyāvahārika,yogyatāyā api satyabrahmasiddhisambhavāt| brahmapare vedānte satyādipadasattvād brahmasatyatvasiddheḥ| agnihotrādivākye tādṛśapadābhāvāt, tatsattve'pi prabalabrahmādvaitaśrutivirodhāt tadasiddhirityeva vaiṣamyopapatteḥ| śabdārthayogyatayoḥsamānasattākatvāniyamasya niṣpramāṇakatvāt| ghaṭajñānaprāmāṇyasyāghaṭatvavat satyabhūtabrahmajñānaprāmāṇyasyāpi tadatiriktaghaṭitatvena mithyātvopapatteśca| tasmād ārambhaṇādhikaraṇoktanyāyena kṛtsnasya viyadādiprapañcasya mithyātvaṃ vajralepāyate||9|| nanu ārambhaṇaśabdādibhiracetanasya viyadādiprapañcasya mithyātvasiddhāvapi cetanānāmapavargabhājāṃ mithyātvāyogād advitīye brahmaṇi samanvayo na yuktaḥ| na ca teṣāṃ brahmābhedaḥ prāgukto yuktaḥ| parasparabhinnānāṃ teṣām ekena brahmaṇā 'bhedāsambhavāt| na ca tadbhedāsiddhiḥ| sukhaduḥkhādivyavasthayā tatsiddheriti ced, na| teṣāmabhede'pi upādhibhedādeva tavdyavasthopapatteḥ||10|| nanu upādhibhede'pi tadabhedānapāyāt kathaṃ vyavasthā| na hyāśrayabhedenopapādanīyo viruddhadharmāsaṅkarastadatiriktasya kasyacidbhedopagamena sidhyati| atra kecidāhuḥ sidhyatyevāntaḥkaraṇopādhibhedena sukhaduḥkhādivyavasthā| "kāmassaṃkalpo vicikitsā śraddhā'śraddhā dhṛtiradhṛtirhīrdhīrbhīrityetatsarvaṃ mana eva" "vijñānaṃ yajñaṃ tanute" ityādiśrutibhistasyaiva nikhilānarthāśrayatvapratipādanāt|"asaṅgo hyayaṃ puruṣaḥ" "asaṅgo na hi sajjate" ityādiśrutibhiḥ cetanasya sarvātmanaudāsīnyapratipādanācca| na caivaṃ sati kartṛtvādibandhasya caitanyasāmānārdhikaraṇyānubhavavirodhaḥ| antaḥkaraṇasya cetanatādātmyenādhyastatayā taddharmāṇāṃ caitanyasāmānādhikaraṇyānubhavopapatteḥ| na cāntaḥkaraṇasya kartṛtvādibandhāśrayatve cetanaḥ saṃsārī na syāditi vācyam| `kartṛtvādibandhāśrayāhaṅkāragranthitādātmyādhyāsādhiṣṭhānabhāva eva tasya saṃsāraḥ' ityupagamāt| tāvataiva bhūṣaṇatvāśrayasarpatādātmyādhyāsādhiṣṭhāne rajjvādau "ayaṃ bhūṣaṇaḥ" ityabhimānavad ātmano'narthāśrayatvābhimānopapatteḥ| etadabhiprāyeṇaiva "dhyāyatīva lelāyatīva" "ahaṅkārāvimūḍhātmā kartā'hamiti manyate" ityādiśrutismṛtidarśanācca| na caikasminnevātni vicitrasukhaduḥkhāśrayatattadantaḥkaraṇānāmadhyāsād ātmanyābhimānikasukhaduḥkhādivyavasthaivamapi na sidhyatīti vācyam| ādhyāsikatādātmyāpannāntaḥkaraṇagatānarthajātasyeva tadgataparasparabhedasyāpi abhimānata ātmīyatayā ātmano yādṛśamanarthabhāktvam, tādṛśena bhedena tavdyavasthopapatteḥ| etena sukhaduḥkhādīnāmanta;karaṇadharmatve'pi tadanubhavaḥ sākṣirūpa iti tasyaikatvāt sukhaduḥkhānubhavarūpabhogavyavasthā na sidhyatīti nirastam| tattadantaḥkaraṇatādātmyāpattyā tattadantaḥkaraṇabhedena bhedavata eva sākṣiṇastattadantaḥkaraṇasukhaduḥkhādyanubhavarūpatvena tavdyavasthāyā apyupapatteriti|| anye tu jaḍasya kartṛtvādibandhāśrayatvānupapatteḥ "kartā śāstrārthavattavāda" iti cetanasyaiva tadāśrayatvapratipādakasūtreṇāntaḥ karaṇe cidābhāso bandhāśrayaḥ| tasya cāsatyasya bimbādbhinnasya pratyantaḥkaraṇabhedādvidvadavidvatsukhiduḥkhikartrādivyavasthā| na caivamadhyastasya bandhāśrayatve bandhamokṣayorvaiyadhikaraṇyāpattiḥ| asya cidābhāsasyāntaḥkaraṇāvacchinne svarūpaṃtasstyatayā muktyanvayini paramārthajīve'dhyastatayā kartṛtvāśrayacidābhāsatādātmyādhyāsādhiṣṭhānabhāvastasya bandha ityabhyupagamādityāhuḥ|| apare tu `ātmendriyamanoyuktaṃ bhoktetyāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ'| iti sahakāritvena dehendriyaistādātmyena manasā ca yuktasya cetanasya bhoktṛtvaśravaṇādantaḥkaraṇabhedena tadviśiṣṭabhedāvdyavasthā| na caivaṃ viśiṣṭasya bandhaḥ, śuddhasya mokṣa iti vaiyadhikaraṇyam| viśiṣṭagatasya bandhasya viśeṣye'nanvayābhāvād viśiṣṭasyānatirekādityāhuḥ|| itare tu astu kevalaścetanaḥ kartṛtvādibandhāśrayaḥ| sphāṭikalaihityanyāyenāntaḥkaraṇasya, tadviśiṣṭasya vā kartṛtvādyāśrayasya sannidhānāccetane'pi kartṛtvādyantarasyādhyāsopagamāt| na ca tasyaikatvāvdyavasthā'nupapattiḥ| upādhibhedādeva tadupapattiḥ| nacānyabhedādanyatra viruddhadharmavyavasthā na yujyate iti vācyam| mūlāgrarūpopādhibhedamātreṇa vṛkṣe saṃyogatadabhāvavyavasthādarśanāt| tattatpuruṣakarṇapuṭopādhibhedena śrotrabhāvamupagatasyākāśasya tatra tatra śbodapalambhakatvānupalambhakatvatāramandreṣṭāniṣṭaśabdopalambhakatvādivaicitryadarśanāccetyāhuḥ|| eke tu yadyāśrayabhedādeva viruddhadharmavyavasthopapādananiyamaḥ, tadā cetanee niṣkṛṣṭe evopādhivaśād bhedakalpanā 'stu| akalpitāśrayabheda eva vyavasthāprayojaka iti kkāpyasampratipatteḥ| maṇimukurakṛpāṇādyupādhikalpitena bhedena mukhe śyāmāvadātavartuladīrghabhāvādidharmāṇāmaṅgulyupaṣṭambhopādhikalpatena bhedena dīpe pāścāttyapaurastyādidharmāṇāṃ ca vyavasthāsampratipatterityāhuḥ||11|| evamupādhipaśāvdyavasthepapādane sambhāvite jīvānāṃ parasparasukhādyananusandhānaprayojaka upādhiḥ ka iti nirūpaṇīyam|| atra kecidāhuḥ bhogāyatanābhedatadbhedāvanusandhānānanusandhānaprayojakopādhī| śarīrāvacchinnavedanāyāstadavacchinnenānusandhānāt caraṇāvacchinnavedanāyā hastavacchinnenānanusandhānācca| `hastavacchinno'haṃ pādāvacchinnavedanāmanubhavāmi' ityapratyayāt| kathaṃ tarhi caraṇalagnakaṇṭakoddhārāya hastavyāpāraḥ| nāyaṃ hastavyāpāraḥ hastāvacchinnānusandhānāt, kiṃ tvavayavāvayavinoścaraṇaśarīrayorbhedāsattvena caraṇāvacchinnavedanā śarīrāvacchinnena `ahaṃ caraṇe vedānāvān' ityanusandhīyate iti tadanusandhānāt| evaṃ caitramaitraśarīrayorabhedābhāvāt caitraśarīrāvacchinnavedanā na maitraśarīrāvacchinnejānusandhīyate| nāpyubhayaśarīrānusyūtāvayavyantarāvacchinnenānutandhīyate| ubhayānusyūtasyāvayavino bhogāyatanasyaivābhāvāditi na caitraśarīralagnakaṇṭakoddhārāya maitraśarīravyāpāraprasaṅga iti|| anye tu viśliṣṭopādhibhedo'nanusandhānaprayojakaḥ| tathā ca hastāvacchinnasya caraṇavacchinnavedanānusandhānābhyupagame'pi na doṣaḥ| na caivaṃ sati garbhasthasya mātṛsukhānusandhānaprasaṅgaḥ| ekasminnavayavinyavayavabhāvenānanupraviṣṭayorviśliṣṭaśabdena vivakṣitatvād mātṛgarbhaśarīrayostathātvādityāhuḥ|| na ca `udyatāyudhadordaṇḍāḥ patitasvaśiro'kṣibhiḥ|' paśyantaḥ pātayanti sma kabandhā apyarīniha|| iti bhāratoktyā viśleṣe'pyanusandhānamavagatamiti vācyam| tatrāpi śiraḥkabandhayorekasmin avayavinyavayavabhāvenānupraviṣṭacaratvāt śiraśchedanānantaraṃ mūrchāmaraṇayoranyatarāvaśyaṃbhāvena dṛṣṭaviruddhārthasya tādṛśavacanasya kaimutyanyāyena yodhotsāhātiśayapraśaṃsāparatvāt| tādṛkprabhāvayuktapuruṣaviśeṣaviṣayatadvena bhūtārthavādatve'pi niruktasyotsargato'nanusandhānatantratvāvighātācca| ata evoktavakṣyamāṇapakṣeṣu yogināṃ jātismarāṇā ca śarīrāntavṛttāntānusandhāne na doṣaprasaktiḥ| apare tu śarīraikyabhedāvanusandhānatadabhāvaprayojakopādhī| bālyabhavāntarānubhūtayoranusandhānatadabhāvadṛṣṭeḥ| na ca bālyayauvanayorapi śarīrabhedaḥ śahkanīyaḥ| pratyabhijñānāt| na ca parimāṇabhedena tadbhedāvagamaḥ| ekasmin vṛkṣe mūlāgrabhedeneva kālabhedenaikasminnanekaparimāṇānvayopapatteḥ| nanvavayavopacayamantareṇa na parimāṇabhedaḥ| avayavāśca paścādāpatanto na pūrvasiddhaṃ śarīraṃ pariyujyante iti parimāṇabhede śarīrabheda āvaśyaka iti cet, na| pradīpāropaṇasamasamayasaudhodaravyāpiprabhāmaṇḍalavikāsatātpidhānasamasamayatatsaṅkocādyananurodhinaḥ paramāṇuprakriyayorasambhavādasyānabhyupagamāt| vivartāvāde caitandrajālikadarśitaśarīravad vinaivāvayavopacayaṃ māyayā śarīrasya vṛddhyupapatterityāhuḥ|| itare tvantaḥkaraṇābhedatadbhedābhyāmanusandhānānanusandhānavyavasthāmāhuḥ|| ayaṃ ca pakṣaḥ prāgupapāditaḥ|| kecittu `ajñānāni jīvabhedopādhibhūtāni nānā' iti svīkṛtya tadbhedābhedābhyām anusandhānānanusandhānavyavasthāptāhuḥ||12|| atra kecid "aṃśo nānāvyapadeśād" ityadhikaraṇe "adṛṣṭāniyamāt" "abhisandhyādiṣvapi caivam" "pradeśāditi cainnāntarbhāvād" itisūtratadgatabhāṣyarītimanusṛtya ekasminnātmanyupādhibhedena vyavasthānupagame kaṇabugādirītyā''tmabhedavāde'pi vyavasthā'nupapattitaulyamāhuḥ| tathā hi caitracaraṇalagnakaṇṭakena caitrasya vedanotpādanasamaye anyeṣāmapyātmanāṃ kuto vedanā na jāyate| sarvātmanā sarvagatatvena caitraśarīrāntarbhāvāviśeṣāt| na ca `yasya śarīre kaṇṭakavedhādi, tasyaiva vedanā, nānyeṣām' iti vyavasthā| sarvātmasannidhāvutpadyamānaṃ śarīraṃ kasyacideva, nānyeṣāmiti niyantumaśakyatvāt| na ca `yadadṛṣṭotpāditaṃ yaccharīraṃ, tattadīyam' iti niyamaḥ| adṛṣṭasyāpi niyamāsiddheḥ| yadā hi tadadṛṣṭotpādanāya kena cidātmanā saṃyujyate manaḥ, saṃyujyata eva tadā'nyairapi| kathaṃ kāraṇasādhāraṇye kvacideva tadadṛṣṭamutpadyeta| nanu manassaṃyogāmātrasādhāraṇye'pi `ahamidaṃ phalaṃ prāpnavāni' iti abhisandhiradṛṣṭotpādakakarmānukūlakṛtirityevamādi vyavasthatamiti tata evādṛṣṭaniyamo bhaviṣyatīti cet, na| abhisandhyādīnāmapi sādhāraṇamanassaṃyogādniṣpādyatayā vyavasthityasiddheḥ| nanu svakīyamanassaṃyogo'bhisandhyādikāraṇamiti manassaṃyoga evāsādhāraṇo bhaviṣyatīti, na| nityaṃ sarvātmasaṃyuktaṃ manaḥ kasyacideva svamiti niyantumaśakyatvāt| na cādṛṣṭaviśeṣādātmaviśeṣāṇāṃ manasassvasvāmibhāvasiddhiḥ| tasyāpyadṛṣṭasya pūrvavavdyavasthityasiddheḥ| nanvātmanāṃ vibhutve'pi teṣāṃ pradeśaviśeṣā eva bandhabhāja iti ātmā'ntarāṇāṃ caitraśarīre tatpradeśaviśeṣābhāvāt sukhaduḥkhādivyavasthā bhaviṣyatīti, na| yasmin pradeśe caitraḥ sukhādyanubhūya tasmāt pradeśādapakrāntastasminneva maitre samāgate tasyāpi tatra sukhaduḥkhādidarśanena śarīrāntare ātmāntarapradeśaviśeṣasyāpyantarbhāvāt| tasmādātmabhede'pi vyavasthā durupapādaiva| kathaṃcittadupapādane ca śrutyanurodhāllaghavāccaikātmyamaṅgīkṛtya tatraiva tadupapādanaṃ kartuṃ yuktamiti||13|| santu tarhyaṇava evātmānaḥ| yadi vibhutve vyavasthā na suvacā| mevam| ātmanāmaṇutve kadācit sarvāṅgīṇasukhodayasya karaśiraścaraṇādhiṣṭhānasya cānupapatteḥ| yadatrārvācīnakalpanam utkrāntigatyāgatiśravaṇānyathānupapattyā "aṇurhyevaiṣa ātmā yaṃ vā ete sinītaḥ puṇyaṃ ca pāpaṃ ca" "vālāgraśatabhāgasya" ityādiśrutiṣu sākṣādaṇutvaśravaṇena ca aṇava iva jīvaḥ| teṣāmaṇutve'pi jñānasukhādīnāṃ pradīpaprabhānyāyena āśrayātiriktapradeśaviśeṣavyāpiguṇatayā na savāṃṅgāṇasukhānupalabdhiḥ| `droṇaṃ bṛhaspaterbhāgam' ityādismṛtyanurodhena jīvānāmaṃśasattvāt| karaśiraścaraṇādyanugateṣu sukhaduḥkhādayaugapadyaṃ kāyavyūhagateṣu yogināṃ bhogavaicitryaṃ caiti na kācidanupapattiḥ| evaṃ ca jīvānumaṇutvenāsaṅkarāt sukhaduḥkhādivyavasthā vibhorīśvarād bhedaśceti| atroktamadvaitadīpikāyām evamapi kathaṃ vyavasthāsiddhiḥ| caitrasya `pāde vedanā śirasi sukham' iti svāṃśabhedagatasukhadiḥkhānusandhānavad maitragatasukhaduḥkhānusandhānasyāpi durvāratvāt| aviśeṣo hi caitrajīvāttadaṃśayoḥ maitrasya ca bhedaḥ| kāyavyūha sthale viyujyānyatra prasaraṇasamarthānāmaṃśānāṃ jīvādbhedāvaśyaṃbhāvād aṃśāṃśinostvayā bhedābhedābhyupagamācca| na ca śuddhabhedo'nanusandhānaprayojaka iti vācyam| śuddhatvaṃ hi bhedasyāṃśāṃśibhāvāsahacaritatvaṃ vā abhedāsahacaritatvaṃ vā syāt?| nādyaḥ| "aṃśo hyeṣa paramasya" "mamaivāṃśo jīvaloke" "aṃśo nānāvyapadeśāt" iti śrutismṛtisūtrairjīvasya brahmāśatvapratipādanena brahmajīvayorbhogasāṃkaryaprasgāt| nanu jīvāṃśānāṃ jīvaṃ pratīva jīvasya brahma prati nāśatvam, kiṃ tu `candrabimbasya gurubimbaḥ śatāṃśaḥ' itivat `sadṛśatve sati tato nyūnatvamātram' aupacārikāṃśatvamiti cet| kiṃtadatirekeṇa mukhyamaṃśatvaṃ jīvāṃśānāṃ jīvaṃ prati, yadatrānanusandhānaprayojakaśarīre niveśyate?| na tāvat paṭaṃ prati tantūnāmivārambhakatvam| jīvasyānāditvāt| nāpi mahākāśaṃ prati ghaṭākāśādīnāmiva pradeśatvam, ṭaṅkacchinnapāṣāṇaśakalādīnāmiva khaṇḍatvaṃ vā| aṇutvena niṣpradeśatvādacchedyatvācca| bhinnābhinnadravyatvamaṃśatvamabhimatamiti ced, na| tathā sati jīveśvarayorjīvānāṃ ca bhogasāṅkaryaprasaṅgāt| svato bhinnānāṃ teṣāṃ cetanatvādinā abhedasyāpi tvayā'ṅgīkārāt, samūhasamūhinorbhedābhedavādinastava mate ekasamūhāntargatjīvānāṃ parasparamapyabhedasattvācca svābhinnasamūhābhinnena svasyāpyabhedasya durvāratvāt| yadi saṃyogādīnāṃ jāteścānekāśritatvaṃ syāt, tadā guṇaguṇyāderabhedād ghaṭābhinnasaṃyogābhinnapaṭoderapi ghaṭābhedaḥ prasajyetetyādi vadanā tvayā tadabhinnābhinnasya tadedaniyamābhyupagamāt| na ca jīvāntarasādhāraṇacetanatvādidharmaikarūpyaikasamūhānrgatatvādiprayuktābhedavilakṣaṇamabhedāntaramaṃśāṃśinorasti bhede'peyanusandhathānaprayojakam, yadatrānatiprasaṅgāya vivakṣyata| tathā sati tasyaiva viśiṣya nirvaktavyatvāpatteḥ| dharmaikarūpyādyaprayuktatvamaṃśāṃśinorabhede viśeṣa iti cet, na| jīvatadaṃśayoścetanatvādidharmaikarūpyasattvena ekaśarīrāvacchede kāyavyūhamelane ca samūhatvena ca tayorabhede dharmaikarūpyādiprayuktatvasyāpi sadbhāvāt| dharmaikarūpyādi prayuktābhedāntarasattve'pi jīvatadaṃśayoraṃśāṃśibhāvaprayojakābhedo na tatprayukta iti ced, na| tayorabhededvayābhāvāt tvanmate'dhikaraṇaikye sati bhedasyābhedasya vā pratiyogibhedena tadākārabhedena vā anekatvānabhyupagamāt| tasmādādyapakṣe sustho'tiprasaṅgaḥ| etenaiva dvitīyapakṣo'pi nirastaḥ| abhedāsahacaritabhedasyānanusandhānaprayojakatve uktarītyā tvanmate jīvabrahmaṇorjīvānāṃ cābhedasyāpi sattvenātiprasaṅgasya durvāratvāt| nanu `abhedapratyakṣamanusandhāne prayojakam' iti tadabhāve'nanusandhānam| svasya svābhedaḥ svāśābhedaśca pratyakṣa iti taddraṣṭurduḥkhādyanusandhānam, jīvāntareṇābhedasattva'pi tasyāpratyakṣatvānna taduduḥkhādyanusandhānam| jātismarasya prāgbhavīyātmanā'pi abhedasya pratyakṣasattvāt tadvṛttāntānusandhānam, anyeṣāṃ tadabhāvād netyādi sarvaṃ saṅgacchate iti cet, tarhyaikātm‌yavāde'pi sarvātmatāvarakājñānāvaraṇāccaitrasya na maitrātmādyabhedapratyakṣamiti tata eva sarvavyavasthopapattervyarthaḥ śrutiviruddha ātmabhedābhyupagamaḥ| na cetthamapi prapañcatattvavapādinastava vyavasthānirvāhaḥ| sarvajñasyeśvarasya vastusajjīvāntarābhedapratyakṣāvaśyaṃbhāvena jīveṣu duḥkhavatsu `ahaṃ duḥkhī' ityanubhavāpatteḥ| asmanmate tvīśvaraḥ svābhinne jīve saṃsāraṃ pratibimbamukhe mālinyamiva paścannapi mithyātvaniścayānna śocatīti naiṣa prasaṅgaḥ| syādetat mā bhūdaṃśabhedaḥ karaśiraścaraṇādīnāṃ kāyavyūhasya cādhiṣṭhānam, ātmadīpasyānapāyinī jñānaprabhā'sti vyāpinīti saiva sarvādhiṣṭhānaṃ bhaviṣyatīti ced, na| jñānavad ātmadharmasya sukhaduḥkhabhogasya jñānamāśritya utpattyasambhavena karacaraṇādyavayavabhedenāvayavinaḥ, kāyavyūhavataḥ kāyabhedena ca bhogavaiciñyābhāvaprasaṅgāt| `sukhaduḥkhabhogādi jñānadharma eva, nātmadharmaḥ' ityabhyupagame tadvaicitryeṇa ātmaguṇasya jñāmasya bhedasiddhāvapyātmano bhedāsiddhathā bhogavaicitryādinā'|ḍatmābhedapratikṣepāyogāt| `bhogādyāśrayasyātmano'ṇutvena pratiśarīraṃ vicchinnatayā tavdyāpitvavāda iva tadabhedavāda iva ca na sarvadharmasaṅkarāpattiḥ' iti matahāneśca| tasmājjīvasyāṇutvopagamena vyavasthopapādanaṃ na yuktamiti| nāpi te natasyeśvarād bhedasādhanaṃ yuktam| utkrāntyādiśravaṇāt, sākṣādaṇutvaśravaṇācca `aṇurjīvaḥ' iti vadataḥ tava mate "tat sṛṣṭvā tadevānuparāviśat" "antaḥ praviṣṭaśśāstā janānām" "guhāṃ praviṣṭau parame parārdhye" ityādiśrutiṣu praveśādiśravaṇāt, "sa eṣo'ṇimā eṣa ma ātmā'ntarhṛdaye'ṇīyān vrīhervā yavādvā" iti śrutau sākṣādaṇutvaśravaṇācca paro'pyaṇureva sidhyediti kutaḥ parajīvayorvibhutvāṇutvābhyāṃ bhedasiddhiḥ| nanu "ākāśavat sarvagataśca nityaḥ" "jyāyān divo jyāyānantarikṣād" ityādiśravaṇāt, sarvaprapañcopādānatvācca parasya sarvagatatvasiddheḥ tadaṇutvaśrutayaḥ upāsanārthāḥ, durgrahatvābhiprāyā vā unneyāḥ| praveśaśrutayaśca śarīrādyupādhinā nirvāhyāḥ| na ca jīvotkrāntyādiśrutayo'pi buddhyā upādhinā nirvoḍhuṃ śakyā iti śaṅkyam| "tamukrāmantaṃ prāṇo'nūtkrāmati" iti prāṇākhyabuddhyutkrānteḥ prāgeva jīvotkrāntivacanāt| tathā "vidvānnāmarūpādvimuktaḥ parātparaṃ puruṣamupaiti divyam" iti nāmarūpavimokṣānantaramapi gatiśravaṇācca| "tadyathā'nassusamāhitamutsarjan yāyādevamevāyaṃ śarīra ātmā prājñenātmanā'nvārūḍha utsarjan yāti" iti svābhāvikagatyāśrayaśakaṭadṛṣṭāntokteśceti ced, naitatsāram| "sa vā eṣa mahānaja ātmā yo'yaṃ vijñānamayaḥ|" `ghaṭasaṃvṛtamākāśaṃ nīyamāne ghaṭe yathā| ghaṭo nīyeta nākāṃśaṃ tadvajjīvo nabhepamaḥ'|| ityādiśrutiṣu jīvasyāpi vubhutvaśravaṇāt| tvanmate prakṛtereva jagadupādānatvena brahmaṇo jagadupādānatvābhāvājjīvasya kāyavyūhagatavicitrasukhaduḥkhopādānatvavadaṇutve'pi jagadupādānatvasambhavācca, tatastasya sarvagatatvāsiddheḥ| tatpraveśaśrutīnāṃ śarīropādhikatvakalpane jīvotkrāntyādiśrutīnāmapi buddhyupādhikatvopagamasambhavāt| `pañcavṛttirmanovavdyapadiśyate' itisūtrabhāṣye buddhiprāṇayoḥ kāryabhedādbhedasya pratipāditatvena buddhyupādhike jīve prathamamutkrāmati prāṇasyānūtkramaṇopapatteḥ| nāmarūpavimokṣānantaraṃ brahmaprāptiśravaṇasya prāptari jīva iva prāptavye brahmaṇyapi vibhutvavirodhitvāt| prākṛtanāmarūpavimokṣānantaramapi aprākṛtalokavigrahādyupadhānena brahmaṇaḥ prāptavyatvavādimate prāpturjīvasyāpyaprākṛtadehendriyādisattvena tadupadhānena brahmaprāptiśravaṇāvirodhāt svābhāvikagatyāśrayaśakaṭadṛṣṭāntaśravaṇamātrād jīvasya svābhāvikagatisiddhau "guhāṃ praviṣṭau" iti svābhāvikapraveśāśrayajīvasamabhivyāhāreṇa brahmaṇo'pi svābhāvikapraveśasiddhisambhavād| brahmajīvobhayānvayina ekasya praviṣṭapadasya ekarūpapraveśaparatvasya vaktavyatvāt| tasmāt paramate brahmajīvayorvibhutvāṇutavavyavasthityasiddherna tato bhedasiddhiṃ pratyāśā| asmanmate brahmātamaikyaparamahāvākyānurodhenāvāntaravākyānāṃ neyatvātsvarūpeṇa jīvasya vibhutvam, aupādhikarūpeṇa pariccheda ityādiprakāreṇa jīvabrahmabhedaprāpakaśrutīnāmupapādanaṃ bhāṣyādiṣuvyaktam| tasmādacetanasya prapañcasya mithyātvāt cetanaprapañcasya brahmabhedācca na vedāntānāmadvitīye brahmaṇi vidyaikaprāpyesamanvayasya kaścidvirodha iti|| iti śāstrasiddhāntaleśasaṅgrahe dvitīyaḥ paricchedaḥ| <3> tṛtīyaḥ paricchedaḥ| nanu kathaṃ vidyayaiva brahmaprāptiḥ| yāvatā karmaṇāmapi tatprāptihetutvaṃ smaryate `tatprāptiheturvijñānaṃ karma coktaṃ mahāmune' iti| satyam| "nānyaḥ panthā vidyate'yanāya" itiśruteḥ, nityasiddhabrahmāvāptau kaṇṭhagatavismṛtakanakamālā'vāptitulyāyaṃ vidyā'tiriktasya sādhanatvāsambhavācca| brahmāvāptau paramparayā karmāpekṣāmātraparā tādṛśī smṛtiḥ| kva tarhi karmaṇāmupayogaḥ?| atra bhāmatīmatānuvartina āhuḥ "tametaṃ vedānuvacanena brāhmaṇā vividiṣanti yajñena dānena tapasā'nāśakena" iti śrutervidyāsampādanadvārā brahmāvāptyupāyabhūtāyāṃ vividiṣāyāmupayogaḥ| nanu iṣyamāṇavidyāyāmevopayogaḥ kiṃ na syāt?| na syād| pratyayārthasya prādhānyāt| "vidyāsaprayogāt pratyāsannāni vidyāsādhanāni śamadamādīni, vividiṣāsaṃyogāttu brahmatarāṇi yajñādini" iti sarvapekṣādhikaraṇabhāṣyācca | nanu vividiṣārthaṃ yajñādyanuṣṭhāturvedanagocarecchāvattve vividiṣāyāṃ siddhatvena tadabhāve vedanopāyavividiṣāyāṃ kāmanā'sambhavena ca vividiṣārthaṃ yajñadyanuṣṭhānāyogād na yajñādīnāṃ vividiṣāyāṃ viniyogo yukta iti ced, na| annadveṣeṇa kārśyaṃ prāptasya tatparihārāyānnaviṣayautkaṇṭhyalakṣaṇāyāmicchāyāṃ satyāmapyutakaṭājīrgādiprayuktadhātuvaiṣamyadoṣāt tatra pravṛttiparyantā rucirna jāyate iti tadrocakauṣadhavidhivad niratiśayānandarūpaṃ brahma tatprāptau vidyā sādhanamityarthe prācīnabahujanmānuṣṭhitānabhisaṃhitaphalakanityanaimittikakarmopasañjātacittaprasādamihimnā sampannaviśvāsasya puruṣasya brahmāvāptau vidyāyāṃ ca tadaunmukhyalakṣaṇāyāmicchāyāṃ satyāmapyanādibhavasañcitānekaduritadoṣeṇāstikakāmukasya heyakarmaṇīva viṣayabhoge prāvaṇyaṃ sampādayacatā pratibandhādvidyāsādhane śravaṇādau pravṛttiparyantā rucirna jāyata iti pratibandhanirāsapūrvaṃ tatsampādakayajñādividhānopapattereti|| vivaraṇānusāriṇastvāhuḥ "prakṛti pratyayārthayoḥ pratyayārthasya prādhānyam"iti sāmānyanyāyād `icchāviṣayatayā śabdabodhye eva śābdasādhanatānvayaḥ' iti svargakāmādivākye klṛptaviśeṣanyāyasya balavattvāt| `aśvena jigamiṣati' `asinā jighāṃsati' ityādilaukikaprayoge aśvādirūpasādhanasya, `tadanveṣṭavyaṃ tadvāva vijijñāsitavyaṃ' mantavyo nididhyāsitavya ityādivaidikaprayoge tavyārthabhūtavidheśca sanpratyayābhihitechchāviṣaye eva gamanādāvanvayasya vyutpannatvācca prakṛtyabhihitāyāṃ vidyāyāṃ yajñādīnāṃ viniyogaḥ| nanu tathā sati yāvādvidyodayaṃ karmānuṣṭhānāpattyā "tyajataiva hi tajjñeyam" ityādiśrutiprasiddhaṃ karmatyāgarūpasya sannyāsasya vidyārthatvaṃ pīḍyeteti ced, na| prāg bījāvāpāt karṣaṇam, tadanantaramakaṣarṇamiti karṣaṇākarṣaṇābhyāṃ vrīhyādiniṣpattivada `arurukṣormuneryogaṃ karma kāraṇamucyate| yogārūḍhasya tasyaiva śamaḥ kāraṇamucyate||' ityādivacanānusāreṇa cetasaḥ śuddhau vivadiṣādirūpapratyakprāvaṇyodayaparyantaṃ karmānuṣṭhānam, tataḥ sannyāsa iti karmatatsannyāsābhyāṃ vidyāniṣpattyabhyupagamāt| uktaṃ hi naiṣkarmyasiddhau `pratyakpravaṇatāṃ buddheḥ karmāṇyāpādya śuddhitaḥ| kṛtārthānyastamāyānti prāvṛḍante ghanā iva||' iti || karṇaṇāṃ vidyārthatvapakṣe'pi vividiṣāparyantameva karmānuṣṭhāne vividiṣārthatvapakṣāt ko bheda iti ced, ayaṃ bhedaḥ karmaṇā vidyārthatvapakṣe dvārabhūtavividiṣāsiddhyanantaramuparatāvapi phalaparyantāni viśiṣṭagurulābhānnirvaghnaśravaṇamananādisādhanāni nivṛttipramukhāni sampādya vidyotpādakatvaniyamo'sti| vividiṣārthatvapakṣe tu śravaṇādipravṛttijananasamarthotkaṭecchāsampādanamātreṇa kṛtārthateti nāvaśyaṃ vidyotpādakatvaniyamaḥ| `yasyaite catvāriṃśat saṃskārāḥ' iti smṛtimūle karmaṇāmātmajñānayogyatāpādakamalāpakarṣaṇaguṇādhānalakṣaṇasaṃskārārthatvapakṣe iveti vadanti||1|| nanu keṣāṃ karmaṇāmudāhṛtaśrutyā viniyogo vodhyate?| atra kaiściduktam `vedānuvacanena'iti brahmacāridharmāṇām, `yakṣena dānena' iti gṛhasthadharmāṇām, `tapasā'nāśakena' iti vānaprasthadharmāṇāṃ ca upalakṣaṇamityāśramadharmāṇāmeva vidyopayogaḥ| ata eva "vihitatvāccāśramakarmāpi" iti śārīrakasūtre vidyārthakarmasvāśramakarmapadaprayoga iti|| kalpatarau tu nāśramadharmāṇāmeva vidyopayogaḥ| "antarācāpi tu tad‌dṛṣṭeḥ" ityadhikaraṇe āśramarahitavidhurādyanuṣṭhitakarmaṇāmapi vidyopayoganirūpaṇāt| na ca vidhurādīnāmanāśramiṇā prāgjanmānuṣṭhitayajñādyutpāditavividiṣāṇāṃ vidyāsādhanaśravaṇādāvadhikāranirūpaṇamātraparaṃ tadadhikaraṇam, na tu tadanuṣṭhitakarmaṇāṃ vidyopayoganirūpaṇaparamiti śaṅkyam| "viśeṣānugrahaśca" iti tadadhikaraṇasūtratadbhāṣyayostadanuṣṭhitānāṃ japādirūpavarṇamātradharmaṇāmapi vidyopayogasya kaṇṭhata ukteḥ| "vihitatvāccāśramakarmāpi" iti sūtre āśramakarmapadasya varṇadharmāṇāmapyupalakṣaṇatvādityabhiprāyeṇoktam| āśramadhacharmavyatiriktānāmapyasti vidyopayogaḥ kiṃ tu nityānāmeva| teṣāṃ hi phalaṃ duritakṣayaṃ vidyā'pekṣate, na kāmyānāṃma phalaṃ svargādi| tatra yathā prakṛtau klṛptopakārāṇāmaṅgānāmatideśe sati na prākṛtopakārātiriktopakārakalpanam, evaṃ jñāne viniyuktānāṃ yajñādīnāṃ klṛptanityaphalapāpakṣayātirekeṇa na nityakāmyasādhāraṇavidyopayogyupakātkalpanamiti|| saṃkṣepaśarīrake tu nityānāṃ kāmyānā ca karmaṇāṃ viniyoga uktaḥ, yajñādiśabdāviśeṣāt| prakṛtau klṛptopakārāṇāṃ padārthānāṃ klṛptaprākṛtopakārātideśamukhenaiva vikṛtiṣvatideśena sambandhaḥ, na tu padārthānāmatideśānantaramupakārakalpaneti na tatra prākṛtopakārātiriktopakārakalpanāprasaktiḥ| iha tu pratyakṣaśrutyā prathamameva viniyuktānāṃ yajñādīnāmupadiṣṭānāmaṅgānāmiva paścāt kalpanīya upakāraḥ prathamāvagataviniyoganirvāhāya klṛpto'pi sāmānyaśabdopāttasakalanityakāmyasādhāraṇaḥ kathaṃ na kalpyaḥ| adhvareṣu adhvaramīmāṃsakairapi hi `upakāramukhena padārthānvaye eva klṛptopakāraniyamaḥ| padārthānvayānantaram upakārakalpane tvaklṛpto'pi viniyuktapadārthānuguṇa eva upakāraḥ kalpanīyaḥ' iti sampratipadyaiva bādhalakṣaṇārambhasidhdyarthamupakāramukhena vikṛtiṣu prākṛtānvayo daśamādye samarthitaḥ| kiṃ ca `klṛptopakārālābhānnityānāmevāyaṃ viniyogaḥ' ityabhyupagame nityebhyo duritakṣayasya tasmācca jñānotpatteranyataḥ siddhau vyartho'yaṃ viniyogaḥ| anyatastadasiddhau jñānāpekṣitopakārajanakatvaṃ teṣvaklṛptamityaviśeṣād nityakāmyasādhāraṇo viniyogo durvāraḥ| nanu nityānāṃ duritakṣayamātrahetutvasyānyataḥ siddhāvapi viśiṣya jñānotpattipratibandhakaduritanirvāhakatvaṃ na siddham, kiṃ tu asmin viniyoge sati jñānoddeśena nityānyanutiṣṭhato'vaśyaṃ jñānaṃ bhavati| itarathā śuddhimātram, na niyatā jñānotpattiriti sārthako'yaṃ viniyoga iti cet, tarhi nityānāmapi aklṛptameva jñānotpattipratibandhakaduritanibarhaṇatvam| jñānasādhana viśiṣṭagurulābhaśravaṇamananādisampādakāpūrvaṃ ca dvāraṃ klpanīyamityaklṛptopakārakalpanā'viśeṣānna sāmānyaśrutyāpādito nityakāmyasādhāraṇo viniyogo bhañjanīya iti||2| nanvevamapi katham `karmaṇaiva hi saṃsiddhimāsthitā janakādayaḥ|' ityādismaraṇanirvāhaḥ?| na ca tasya vidyārthakarmānuṣṭhānaparatvam| vividiṣāvākye brāhmaṇagrahaṇena brāhmaṇānāmeva vidyārthakarmaṇyadhikārapratīteḥ| ato janakādyanuṣṭhitakarmaṇāṃ sākṣādeva muktyupayogo vaktvyaḥ| maivam| vividiṣāvākye brāhmaṇagrahaṇasya traivarṇikopalakṣaṇatvāt| yathā''huratrabhavanto vārtikakārāḥ `brāhmaṇagrahaṇaṃ cātra dvijānāmupalakṣaṇam| aviśiṣṭādhikāritvātsarveṣāmātmabodhane||'iti|| na hi `vidyākāmo yajñādīnanutiṣṭhed' iti vipariṇamite vidyākāmādhikāravidhau brāhmaṇapadasyādhikāriviśeṣasamarpakatvaṃ yujyate| uddeśye viśeṣaṇāyogāt| nāpi "rājā svārājyakāmo rājasūyena yajeta" iti svārājyakāmādhikāre rājasūyavidhau `svārājyakāmo rājakartṛkeṇa rājasūyena yajeta'iti kartṛtayā yāgaviśeṣaṇatvena vidheyasya rājño rājakartṛkarājasūyasyārājñā sampādayitumaśakyatvād arthādadhikārikoṭiniveśavad, iha yajñādikartṛtayā vidheyasya brāhmaṇasyārthadadhikārikoṭiniveśa iti yujyate| "sarvathā'pi ta evobhayaliṅgād" iti sūtre `anyatra vihitānāmeva yajñādīnāṃ vividaṣāvākye phalaviśeṣasambandhavidhiḥ, nāpūrvayajñāditridhiḥ' iti vyavasthāpitatvena prāptayajñādyanuvādena ekasmin vākye `kartṛrūpaguṇavidhiḥ, phalasambandhavidhiśca' ityubhayavidhānādvākyabhedāptteḥ| nāpi rājasūyavākye rājñaḥ kartṛtayā vidheyatvābhāvapakṣe rājapadasamabhivyāhāramātrādviśiṣṭakartṛtvalābhavad iha vākyābhedāya kartṛtayā brāhmaṇāvidhāne'pi brāhmaṇapadasamabhivyāhāramātreṇa brāhmaṇakartṛkatvālābhāt tadadhikāraparyavasānamityupapadyate| anyatra traivarṇikādhikārikatvena klṛptānāmihāpi traivarṇikādhikārātmavidyārthatvena vidhīyamānānāṃ yajñādīnāṃ traivarṇikādhikārātmavidyārthatvena vidhisaṃsargahīnabrāhmaṇapadasamabhivyāhāramātrādadhikārasaṃkocāsambhavena brāhmaṇapadasya yathāprāptavidyādhikārimātropalakṣaṇatvaucityāt||3|| nanu vidyādhikārimātropalakṣaṇatve śūdrasyāpi vidyāyāmarthitvādisambhavena tasyāpi vidyārthakarmādhikāraprasaṅga iti ced, na| `adhyayanagṛhītasvādhyāyajanyatadarthajñānavata eva vaidikeṣvadhikāraḥ' ityapaśūdrādhikaraṇe adhyayanavedavākyaśravaṇādividhurasya śūdrasya vidyādhikāraniṣedhāt| `na śūdrāya matiṃ dadyād' iti smṛterāpātato'pi tasya vidyāmahimnā'vagatyupāyāsambhavena tadarthitvānupapatteśca tasya vidyāyāmanadhikārāditi kecit|| anye tvāhuḥ śūdrasyāpyastyeva vidyārthakarmādhikāraḥ| tasya vedānuvacanāgnihotrādyasambhave'pi kaṇṭhoktasarvavarṇādhikāraśrīpañcākṣaramantrarājavidyādijapapāpakṣayahetutapodānapākayajñādisambhavād `vedānuvacanena yajñena dānena' ityādipṛthakkārakavibhaktiśruteḥ vidhurādīnāṃ vidyārthajapadānādimātrānuṣṭhānānumateśca `vedānuvacanādisamuccayānapekṣaṇāt| na ca śūdrasya vidyāyāmarthitvāsambhavaḥ| śrāvayeccaturo varṇān kṛtvā brāhmaṇamagrataḥ'| itītihāsapurāṇaśravaṇe cāturvarṇyādhikārasmaraṇena pusaṇādyavagatavidyāmāhātmyasya tasyāpi tadarthitvasambhavāt| `na śūdrāya matiṃ yadyād' iti smṛteśca
