tadanuṣṭhānānupayogyagnihotrādikarmajñānadānaniṣedhaparatvāt| anyathā tasya svavarṇadharmasyāpyavagatyupāyāsambhave `śūdraścaturtho varṇa ekajātistasyāpi satyamakrodhaśśaucamācamanārthe pāṇipādakṣālanamevaike śrāddhakarma bhṛtyabharaṇaṃ svadāratuṣṭiḥ paricaryā cottareṣām' ityāditaddharmavibhājakavacanānāmananuṣṭhānalakṣaṇāprāmāṇyāpatteḥ| nacaivaṃ satyapaśūdrādhikaraṇasya nirviṣayatvam| tasya `na śūdre pātakaṃ kiṃcit na ca saṃskāramarhati| ityādismṛtergurūpasadanākhyavidyāṅgopanayanasaṃskāravidhurasya śūdrasya saguṇavidyāsu nirguṇavidyāsādhanavedāntaśravaṇādiṣu cādhikāraniṣedhaparatvād nirguṇavidyāyāṃ śūdrasyāpi viṣayasaundaryaprayuktārthitvasya niṣeddhumaśakyatvāt| avidheyāyāṃ ca tasyāṃ tadatiriktādhikārāprasaktyā tanniṣedhāyogācca| na ca tasya vedāntaśravaṇāsambhave vidyārthakarmānuṣṭhānasambhave'pi vidyānutpattestasya tadarthakarmānuṣṭhānaṃ vyarthamiti vācyam| tasya vedāntaśravaṇādhikārābhāve'pi bhagavatpādaiḥ "śrāvayeccaturo varṇān" iti cetihāsapurāṇādhigame cāturvarṇyādhikārasmaraṇād vedapūrvastu nāstyadhikāraḥ śūdrāṇāmiti sthitam' iti apaśūdrādhikaraṇopasaṃhārabhāṣye brahmātmaikyaparapurāṇādiśravaṇe vidyāsādhane'dhikārasya darśitatvād| vidyotpattiyogyavimaladevaśarīraniṣpādanadvārā muktyarthatvaṃ bhaviṣyatīti traivarṇikānāṃ kramamuktiphalakasaguṇavidyārthakarmānuṣṭhānavad vedāntaśravaṇayogyatraivarṇikaśarīraniṣpādanadvārā vidyotpattyarthatvaṃ bhaviṣyatīti śūdrasya vidyārthakarmānuṣṭhānāvirodhācca| tasmādvividiṣāvākye brāhmaṇapadasya yathāprāptavidyā'dhikārimātraviṣayatvena śūdrasyāpi vidyārthakarmādhikāraḥ sidhyatyeveti|| 4 || nanvastu karmaṇāṃ cittaśuddhidvārā vidyopayogaḥ| sannyāsasya kiṃdvārā tadupayogaḥ?| kecidāhuḥ vidyotpattipratibandhakaduritānāmanantatvāt kiñcid yajñādyanuṣṭhānanivartyam, kiñcit sannyāsāpūrvanivartyamiti karmavāccittaśuddhidvāraiva sannyāsasyāpi tadupayogaḥ| tathā ca gṛhasthādīnāṃ karmacchidreṣu śravaṇādyanutiṣṭatāṃ na tasmin janmani vidyāvāptiḥ, kiṃ tu janmāntare mannyāsaṃ labdhvaiva| yeṣāṃ tu gṛhasthānāmeva satāṃ janakādīnāṃ vidyā vidyate, teṣāṃ pūrvajanmani sannyāsādvidyā'vāptiḥ| ato na vidyāyāṃ sannyāsāpūrvavyabhicāraśaṅkā'pīti| anye tu "śānte dānta uparataḥ" ityādiśrutau uparataśabdagṛhītatayā sannpāsasasya sādhanacatuṣṭayāntargatatvāt, "sahakāryantaravidhiḥ" iti sūtrabhāṣye "tadvato vidyāvataḥ sannyāsino bālyapāṇḍityāpekṣayā tṛtīyamidaṃ maunaṃ vidhīyate| "tasmāt brāhmaṇaḥ pāṇḍityam" ityādiśrutau tataḥ prāg "bhikṣācaryaṃ caranti" iti sannyāsādhikārād" iti pratiprādanāt, `tyaktāśeṣakriyasyaiva saṃsāraṃ prajihāsataḥ| jijñāsereva caikātmyaṃ trayyanteṣvadhikāritā||' iti vārtikokteśca sannyāsāpūrvasya jñānasādhanavedāntaśravaṇādyadhikāriviśeṣaṇatvamiti tasya vidyopayogamāhuḥ|| apare tu `śravaṇādyaṅgatayā''tmajñānaphalatā sannyāsasya siddhā' iti vivaraṇokterananyavyāpāratayā śravaṇādiniṣpādanaṃ kurvatasyasya vidyāyāmupayogaḥ| dṛṣṭadvāre sambhavati adṛṣṭakalpanā'yogāt| yadi tvanalasasya dhīmataḥ puruṣadhaureyasyāśramāntarasthasyāpi karmācchidreṣu śravaṇādi sampadyate, tadā `caturṣvāśrameṣu sannyāsāśramaparigraheṇaiva śravaṇādi nirvartanīyam' iti niyamo'bhyupeya iti || 5|| nanvasmin pakṣadvaye kṣāttriyavaiśyayo kathaṃ vedāntaśravaṇādyanuṣṭhānam| sannyāsasya brāhmaṇādhikaritvād "brāhmaṇonirvedabhāyād" "brāhmaṇo vyutthāya" "brāhmaṇaḥ pravrajed" iti sannyāsavidhiṣu brāhmaṇagrahaṇāt| `adhikāriviśeṣasya jñānāya brāhmaṇagrahaḥ| na sannyāsavidhiryasmācchutau kṣatriyavaiśyayoḥ||' iti vārtikokteśceti cet, atra kecit "yadi vetarathā brahmacaryādeva pravrajed, gṛhādvā, vanādvā" ityādyaviśeṣaśrutyā brahmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vā'pi vaiśyo vā pravrajed gṛhāt| trayāṇāmapi varṇānāmamī cātvāra āśramāḥ||' itismṛtyanugṛhītatā kṣatriyavaiśyayorapi sannyāsādhikārasiddheḥ śrutyantareṣu brāhmaṇagrahaṇaṃ trayāṇāmupalakṣaṇam| ata eva vārtike'pi "adhikāriviśeṣasya" iti ślokena bhāṣyābhiprāyamuktvā `trayāṇāmaviśeṣeṇa sannyāsaḥ śrūyate śrutau| yadopalakṣaṇārthaṃ syād brāhmaṇagrahaṇaṃ tadā||' ityanantaraślokena svabhate kṣatriyavaiśyayorapi sannyāsādhikāro darśita iti tayoḥ śravaṇādyanuṣṭhānasiddhiṃ samarthayante|| anye tvanekeṣu sannyāsāvidhivākyeṣu brāhmaṇagrahaṇād udāhṛtajābālaśrutau sannyāsavidhivākye brāhmaṇagrahaṇābhāve'pi śrutyantarasiddhaṃ brāhmaṇādhikārameva siddhaṃ brāhmaṇādhikārameva siddhaṃ kṛtvā "sannyāsāvasthāyāmayakṣopavītī kathaṃ brāhmaṇaḥ" iti brāhmaṇaparāmarśācca brāhmaṇasyaiva sannyāsādhikāraḥ| virodhādhikaraṇanyāyena śrutyaviruddhasyaiva smṛtyarthasya saṅgāhyatvāt| yattu sannyāsasya sarvādhikaritvena vārtikavacanaṃ tad vidvatsannyāsaviṣayam, na tu āturavividiṣāsannyāse bhāṣyābhiprāyaviruddhasarvādhikārapratipādanaparam| `sarvādhikāravicchedi vijñānaṃ cedupeyate|| kuto'dhikāraniyamo vyutthāne kriyate balāt||' ityanantaraślokena brahmajñānodayānantaraṃ jīvanmuktikāle vidvatsannyāsa evādhikāraniyamanirākaraṇāt| evaṃ ca brāhmaṇānāmeva śravaṇādyanuṣṭhāne sannyāso'ṅgam| kṣatriyavaiśyayostannirapekṣaḥ śravaṇadyadhikāra iti tayoḥ śravaṇādyanuṣṭhānanirvāhaḥ| na hi sannyāsasya śravaṇapekṣitatvapakṣe śravaṇamātrasya tadapekṣā niyantuṃ śakyate| kramamuktiphalakasaguṇopāsanayā devabhāvaṃ prāptasya śravaṇādau sannyāsanairapekṣyasyāvaśyaṃ vaktavyatvād devānāṃ karmānuṣṭhānāprasaktyā tattyāgarūpasya sannyāsasya teṣvasambhavādityāhuḥ|| apare tu "brahmasaṃstho'mṛtatvameti" itiśrutyuditā yasya brahmaṇi saṃsthā samāptiḥ, ananyavyāpāratvarūpaṃ tanniṣṭhatvaṃ tasya śravamādiṣu mukhyādhikāraḥ| `gacchatastiṣṭhato vā'pi jāgrataḥ svapato'pi vā| na vicāraparaṃ ceto yasyāsau mṛta ucyate|| āsupterāmṛteḥ kālaṃ nayedvedāntacintayā| ityādismṛtiṣu sarvadā vicāravidhānāt| sā ca brahmaṇi saṃsthā vinā sannyāsamāśramāntarasthasya na sambhavati| svasvāśramavihitakarmānuṣṭhānavaiyagyāditi sannyāsarahitayoḥ kṣatriyavaiśyayorna mukyaḥ śravaṇādyadhikāraḥ| kiṃ tu "dṛṣṭārthā ca vidyā pratiṣedhābhāvamātreṇāpyarthinamadhikaroti śravaṇādiṣu" iti "antarācāpi tu tad‌dṛṣṭeḥ" ityādhikaraṇabhāṣyoktanyāyena śūdravadapratiṣiddhayostayorvidhurādīnāmiva dehāntare vidyāprāpakeṇāmukhyādhikāramātreṇa śravaṇādyanumatiḥ| na hi "antarā cāpi tu tad‌dṛṣṭeḥ" ityadhikaraṇe vidhurādīnāmaṅgīkṛtaśśravaṇādyadhikāro mukhya iti vaktuṃ śakyate| "atastvitarajjyāyo liṅgācca" iti sūtrakāreṇaiva teṣāmamukhyādhikārasphuṭīkaraṇāt| na ca tatra teṣāṃ śravaṇādyadhikāra eva noktaḥ, kiṃ tu tadīyakarmaṇāṃ vidyā'nugrāhakatvamiti śaṅkyām| "dṛṣṭārthā ca vidyā" ityudāhṛtatadādhikaraṇabhāṣyavirodhāt| na ca kṣatriyavaiśyayoḥ sannyāsābhāvād amukhyādhikāre tata eva devānāmapi śravaṇādiṣvamukhya evādhikāraḥ syāt| tathā ca kramamuktiphalakasaguṇavidyayā devadehaṃ prāpya śravaṇādyanutiṣṭhatā vidyāprāptyarthaṃ sannyāsārhaṃ punarbrāhmaṇajanma vaktavyamiti "brahmalokamabhisampadyate" "na ca punarāvartate" "anāvṛttiśśabdād" ityādiśrutisūtrāvirodha iti vācyam| devānāmanuṣṭheyakarmavaiyagtyābhāvāt svata evānanyavyāpāratvaṃ sambhavatīti kramamuktiphalakasaguṇavidyābhidhāyiśāstraprāmāṇyādvinā'pi sannyāsaṃ teṣāṃ mukhyādhikārābhyupagamādityāhuḥ || 6 || nanvamukhyādhikāriṇā dṛṣṭaphalabhūtavākyārthāvagatyarthamavihitaśāstrāntaravicāravat kriyamāṇo vedāntavicāraḥ kathaṃ janmāntaravidyā'vāptāvupayujyate| na khaluvicārasya dināntarīyavicāryāvagatihetutvamapi yujyate| dūre janmāntarīyataddhetutvam| na ca vācyaṃ mukhyādhikāriṇā parivrājakena kriyamāṇamapi śravaṇaṃ dṛṣṭārthameva| avagaterdṛṣṭārthatvāt| tasya yathā prārabdhakarmaviśeṣarūpapratibandhadiha janmani phalamajanayato janmānto pratibandhakāpagamena phalajanakatvam "aihikamapyaprastutapratibandhe taddarśanād" ityadhikaraṇe tathā nirṇayād, evamamukhyādhikārikṛtasyāpi syāditi| yataśśāstrīyāṅgavidhuraṃ śravaṇaṃ nādṛṣṭotpādakamiti kutastasya janmāntarīyavidyopayogitvamupapadyate| ghaṭakādṛṣṭaṃ vinā janmāntarīyapramāṇavyāpārasya janmāntarīyāvagatihetutvopagame atiprasaṅgāt| ucyate amukhyādhikāriṇā'pi utpannavividiṣeṇa kriyamāṇaṃ śravaṇaṃ dvārabhūtavividiṣotpādakaprācīnavidyārthayajñādyanuṣṭhānajanyāpūrvaprayuktamiti tadevāpūrvaṃ vidyārūpaphalaparyantaṃ vyāpriyamāṇaṃ janmāntarīyāyāmapi vidyāyāṃ svakāritaśravaṇasya upakārakatāṃ ghaṭayatīti nānupapattiḥ| śravaṇādau vidhyabāvapakṣe tu sannyāsapūrvakaṃ kṛtasyāpi śravaṇasyādṛṣṭānutpādaktavāt sati pratibandhe tasya janmāntarīyavidyāhetutvamitthameva nirvāhyam|| ācāryāstu niyamavidhipakṣe'pi ayameva nirvāhaḥ| śravaṇamabhyasyataḥ phalaprāpterarvāk prāyeṇa tanniyamādṛṣṭānutpatteḥ| tasya phalaparyantāvṛttiguṇakaśravaṇānuṣṭhānanuyamasādhyatvāt| na hi niyamādṛṣṭajanakaśśravaṇaniyamaḥ phalaparyantamāvartanīyasya śravaṇasyopakramamātreṇa nirvartito bhavati| yena tajjanyaniyamādṛṣṭasyāpi phalaparyantaśravaṇāvṛtteḥ prāgevotpattiḥ sambhāvyeta| avaghātavadāvṛttiguṇakasyaiva śravaṇasya phalasādhanatvena phalasādhanapadārthaniṣpatteḥ prāk tanniyamanirvartivacanasya nirālambanatvāt, śravaṇāvaghātādyupakramamātreṇa niyamaniṣpattau tāvatraiva niyamaśāstrānuṣ‌ṭhānaṃ siddhamiti tadanāvṛttāvapyavaikalyaprasaṅgāccetyāhuḥ|| kecittu dṛṣṭārthasyaiva vedāntaśravaṇasya `dine dine tu vedāntaśravaṇād bhaktisaṃyutāt| guruśuśrūṣayā labdhāt kṛchrāśītiphalaṃ labhed'|| ityādivacanaprāmāṇyāt svatantrādṛṣṭotpādakatvāmapyasti| yathā agnisaṃskārārthasyādhānasya puruṣasaṃskāreṣu parigaṇanāt tadarthatvamapi, evaṃ vacanabalādubhayārthatvopapatteḥ| tathā ca pratidinaśravaṇajanitādṛṣṭamahimnaivāmuṣmikavidyopayogitvaṃ śravaṇamananādisādhanānāmityāhuḥ||7|| evaṃ `śravaṇamananādisādhanānuṣṭhānapraṇālyā vidyā'vāptiḥ' ityasminnarthe sarvasampratipanne sthite bhāratītīrthāḥ dhyānadīpe vidyā'vāptau upāyāntaramapyāhuḥ| "tat kāraṇaṃ sāṅkhyayogābhipannam", `yatsāṅkhyaiḥ prāpyate sthānaṃ tadyegairapi gamyate|' itiśrutismṛtidarśanād yathā sāṅkhyaṃ nāma vedāntavicāraḥ śravaṇaśabdito mananādisahakṛto vidyā'vāptyupāyaḥ, evaṃ yogaśabditaṃ nirguṇabrahmopāsanamapi| na ca nirguṇasyopāsanameva nāstīti śaṅkyam| praśnopaniṣādi śaibyapraśne "yaḥ punaretaṃ trimātreṇoṅkāreṇa paraṃ puruṣamabhidhyāyīti" iti nirguṇasyaivopāsanapratipādanāt| tadanantaram "sa etasmājjīvaghanāt parāt paraṃ puriśayaṃ puruṣamīkṣate" iti upāsanāphalavākye "īkṣatikarmatvena nirdiṣṭaṃ yannirguṇaṃ brahma, tadevopāsanāvākye'pi dhyāyatikarma, nānyat| īkṣatidhyānayoḥ kāryakāraṇabhūtayorekaviṣayatvaniyamād" ityasyārthasya īkṣātikarmādhikaraṇe bhāṣyakāradibhiraṅgīkṛtatvāt| anyatrāpi tāpanīyakaṭhavallayādiśrutyantare nirguṇopāsteḥ prapañcitatvāt| sūtrakṛtā'pyupāsyaguṇaparicchedārthamārabdhe guṇopasaṃhārapāde nirguṇe'pi "ānandādayaḥ pradhānasya" iti sūtreṇa bhāvarūpāṇāṃ jñānānandādiguṇānām, "akṣaradhiyāṃ tvavarodhaḥ" ityādi sūtreṇa abhāvarūpāṇāmasthūlatvādiguṇānāṃ copasaṃhārasya darśitatvācca| nanu ānandādiguṇopasaṃhāre upāsyaṃ nirguṇameva na syāditi ced, na| ānandādibhirasthūlatvādibhiśtacopalakṣitamakhaṇḍaikarasaṃ brahmāsmīti nirguṇatvānupamardena upāsanāsambhavāt| nanu "tadeva brahma tvaṃ biddhi nedaṃ yadidamupāsate" itiśruteḥ na paraṃ brahmopāsyamiti cet, "anyadeva tadviditād" iti śrutestasya vedyatvasyāpyasidhdyāpātāt| śrutyantareṣu brahmavedanaprasiddheravedyatvaśrutirvāstavāvedyatvaparā ced, ātharvaṇādau tadupāsanāprasiddhestadanupāsyatvaśrutirapi vastuvṛttaparā'stu| evaṃ ca "śravaṇāyāpi bahubhiryo na labhyaḥ" iti śravaṇād yeṣāṃ buddhimāndyada, nyāyavyutpādanakuśalaviśiṣṭagurvalābhādvā śravaṇādi na sambhavati, teṣāmadhyayanagṛhītaiḥ vedāntairāpātato'dhigamitabrahmātmabhāvānāṃ tadvicāraṃ vinaiva praśnopaniṣadādyuktamārṣagrantheṣu brāhmavāsiṣṭhādikalpeṣu pañcīkaraṇādiṣu cānekaśākhāviprakīrṇasarvārthopasaṃhāreṇa kalpasūtreṣvagnihotrādivannirdhāritānuṣṭhānaprakāraṃ nirguṇopāsanaṃ sampradāyamātravidbhayo gurubhyo'vadhārya tadanuṣṭhānāt krameṇopāsyabhūtanirguṇabrahmasākṣātkāraḥ sampadyate| avisaṃvādibhramanyāyena upāsterapi kkacit phalakāle pramāparyavasānasambhavāt| pāṇau pañca varāṭakāḥ pidhāya kenacit "kare kati varāṭakāḥ?" iti pṛṣṭe "pañca varāṭakāḥ" iti taduttaravakturvākyaprayogamūlabhūtasaṅkhyāviśeṣajñānasya mūlapramāṇaśūnyasyāhāryāroparūpasyāpi yathārthatvavannirguṇabrahmopāsanasyārthatathātvavivecakanirvicikitsamūlapramāṇanirapekṣasya daharādyupāsanavadupāsanāśāstramātramavalambya kriyamāṇasyāpi vastuto yathārthatvena taharādyupāsaneneva nirguṇopāsanena janyasya svaviṣaya sākṣātkārasya śravaṇādipraṇālījanyasākṣātkāravadevava tattvārthaviṣayatvāvaśyaṃbhāvācca| iyāṃstu viśeṣaḥ pratibandharahitasya puṃsaḥ śravaṇādipraṇāḍyā brahmasākṣātkāro jhaṭiti sidhyatīti sāṅkhyamārgo mukhyaḥ kalpaḥ, upāstyā tu vilambeneti yogamārgo'nukalpa iti || 8 || nanvasmin pakṣadvaye'pi brahmasākṣātkāre kiṃ karaṇam?| ke cidāhuḥ pratyayābhyāsarūpaṃ prasaṅkhyānameva| yegamārge ādita ārabhyāpāsanarūpasya sāṅkhyamārge mananānantaranididhyāsanarūpasya ca tasya sattvāt| na ca tasya brahmasākṣarātkārakāraṇatvaṃ mānābhāvaḥ| "tatastu taṃ paśyate niṣkalaṃ dhyāyamānaḥ" iti śravaṇāt| kāmāturasya vyavahitakāminīsākṣātkāre prasaṅkhyānasya kāraṇatvaklṛpteśca| "ā prāyaṇāt tatrāpi hi dṛṣṭam" ityadhikaraṇe, "vikalpo'viśiṣṭaphalatvād" ityadhikaraṇe ca daharādyahaṃgrahopāsakānāṃ prasaṅkhyānādupāsyasaguṇabrahmasākṣātkārāṅgīkārācca| nanu ca prasaṅkhyānasya pramāṇaparigaṇaneṣvaparigaṇanāt tajjānyo brahmasākṣātkāraḥ pramā na syāt| na ca kākatālīyasaṃvādivarāṭakasaṅkhyāviśeṣāhāryajñānavad arthābādhena pramātvopapattiḥ| pramāṇāmūlakasya pramātvāyogāt| āhāryavṛtteśca upāsanāvṛttivaj jñānabhinnamānasākriyārūpatayā icchādivad abādhitārthaviṣayatve'pi pramāṇatvānabhyupagamāt| maivam| klṛptapramākaraṇāmūlakatve'pīśvaramāyāvṛttivat pramātvopapatteḥ| viṣayābādhataulyāt| mārgadvaye'pi prasaṅkhyānasya vicāritādavicāritādvā vedāntādbrahmātmyaikyāvagatimūlakatayā prasaṅkhyānajanyasya brahmasākṣātkārasya pramāṇamūlakatvācca| uktaṃ ca kalpatarukāraiḥ `vedāntavākyajajñānabhāvanājā'parokṣadhīḥ| mūlapramāṇadārḍhyena na bhramatvaṃ prapadyate|| na ca prāmāṇyaparatastvāpāttisti prasajyate| apavādanirāsāya mūlaśuddhyanurodhanād||iti|' anye tu "eṣo'ṇurātmā cetasā viditavyaḥ", "dṛśyate tvagtyayā buddhyā" ityādiśrutermana eva brahmasākṣātkāre karaṇam| tasya sopādhikātmani ahaṃvṛttirūpapramākaraṇatvaklṛpteḥ| `svapnaprapañcaviparītapramātrādijñānasādhanasyāntaḥkaraṇasya' ityādipañcapādikāvivaraṇagranthairapi tathā pratipādanāt| "ahamevedaṃ sarvaṃ sarvo'smīti manyate so'sya paramo lokaḥ" itiśrutyukte svāpne brahmasākṣarātkāre eva manasaḥ karaṇatvasampratipatteśca| tadā karaṇāntarābhāvāt| prasaṅkhyānaṃ tu manasshakāribhāvenāpi upayujyate| `vākyārthabhāvanāparipākasahitamantaḥkaraṇaṃ tvaṃpadārthasyāparokṣasya tattadupādhyākāraniṣedhena tatpadārthatāmāvirbhavayati'iti bhāmatīvacanāt| "jñānaprasādena viśuddhasattvastatastu taṃ paśyate niṣkala dhyāyamānaḥ" iti śrutāvapi jñānaprasādaśabditacittaikāgtyahetutayaiva dhyānopādānāt| na tu prasaṅkhyānaṃ svayaṃ karaṇam| tasya kkacidapi jñānakaraṇatvāklṛpteḥ| kāmāturakāminīsākṣātkārādāvapi prasaṅkhyānasahakṛtasya manasa eva karaṇatvopapattyā 'klṛptajñānakaraṇāntarakalpanāyogādityāhuḥ|| apare tu "taddhāsya vijājñau" "tamasaḥ pāraṃ darśayati ācāryavān puruṣo veda tasya tāvadeva ciram" ityādiśrutiṣu ācāryopadeśānantarameva brahmasākṣātkārodaye jīvanmuktiśravaṇād "vedāntavijñānasuniścitārthāḥ" iti jñānāntaranairākāṅkṣyaśravaṇāt "taṃ tvaupaniṣadaṃ puruṣam" iti brahmaṇa upaniṣadekagamyatvaśravaṇācca aupaniṣadaṃ mahāvākyameva brahmasākṣātkāre karaṇam, na manaḥ| "yanmanasā na manute" iti tasya brahmasākṣātkārakaraṇatvaniṣedhāt| na cāpakkamanoviṣayamidam| "yenāhurmano matam" itivākyaśeṣe manomātragrahaṇāt| na caivaṃ "yadvācā'nabhyuditam" iti śabdasyāpi tatkaraṇatvaṃ niṣidhyate iti śaṅkyam| manaḥkaraṇatvavādināmapi śabdasya nirviśeṣaparokṣajñānakaramatvasyābhyupagatatvena tasya "yato vāco nivartatante aprāpya manasā saha" iti śrutyanurodhena śabdārthaprāptirūpaśaktimukhena śabdasya tatkaraṇatvaniṣedhe tātparyasya vaktavyatayā śakyasambandharūpalakṣaṇāmukhena tasya tatkaraṇatvāvirodhāt| na ca "manasaivānudraṣṭavyam" iti śrutisiddhaṃ manaso'pi tatkaraṇatvaṃ na parākartuṃ śakyamiti vācyam| śābdasākṣātkārajanane'pi tadaikāgtyasyāpekṣitatvena hetutvamātreṇa tṛtīyopapatteḥ| "manasā hyeṣa paśyati manasā śṛṇoti" ityādau tathā darśanāt| gītavivaraṇe bhāṣyakārīyamanaḥkaraṇatvavacanasya matāntarābhiprāyeṇa pravṛtterityāhuḥ || 9 || nanu tathā'pi śabdasya parokṣajñānajanakatvasvabhāvasyāparokṣajñānajanakatvaṃ na saṅgacchate iti cet| atra kecit svato'samartho'pi śabdaḥ śāstraśravaṇamananapūrvakapratyapābhyāsajanitasaṃskārapracayalabdhabrahmaikāgtyacittadarpaṇānugṛhīto'parokṣajñānamutpādayati śāstrīyasaṃskārasaṃskṛtāgnyadhikaraṇaka iva homo'pūrvamiti kalpyate|| "tarati śokamātmavid" iti śāstraprāmāṇyād| aparokṣasya kartṛtvādhyāsasyāparokṣādhiṣṭhānajñānaṃ vinā nivṛttyayogād aupaniṣade brahmaṇi mānāntarāpravṛtteḥ śabdādapyaparokṣajñānānutpattau anirmokṣaprasaṅgādityāhuḥ|| anye tu bhāvanāpracayasāhitye sati bahirasamarthasyāpi manaso naṣṭavanitāsākṣātkārajanakatvadarśanād nididhyāsanasāhityena śabdasyāpyaparokṣajñānajanakatvaṃ yuktamiti dṛṣyaṭānugedhena samarthayante|| apare tu aparokṣārthaviṣayatvaṃ jñānasyāparokṣatvaṃ nāma| anyānirukteḥ arthāparokṣatvaṃ tu nāparokṣajñānaviṣayatvam, yenānyonyāśrayo bhavet| kiṃ tu tattatpuruṣīyacaitanyābhedaḥ| antaḥkaraṇataddharmāṇāṃ sākṣiṇi kalpitatayā tadabhedasattvād| bāhmacaitanye kalpitānāṃ ghaṭādīnāṃ bāhyacaitanye vṛttikṛtatattatpuruṣīyacaitanyābhedābhivyaktyā tadabhedasattvācca na kkāpyavyāptiḥ| na cāntaḥkaraṇataddharmāṇāṃ jñānadīnāmiva dharmādharmasaṃskārāṇāmapi sākṣiṇi kalpitatvāviśeṣād āparokṣyapattiḥ| teṣāmanudbhūtatvād udbhūtasyaiva jaḍasya caitanyābheda āparokṣyamityabhyupagamāt| evaṃ ca sarvadā sarvapuruṣacaitanyābhinnatvād "yatsākṣādaparokṣād brahma" iti śrutyā svata evāparokṣaṃ brahmeti aparokṣārthaviṣayatvāt śābdasyāpi brahmajñānasyāparokṣatvavācoyuktiryuktetyāhuḥ|| advaitavidyācāryāstu nāparokṣārthaviṣayatvaṃ jñānasyāparokṣyam| svarūpasukhāparokṣarūpasvarūpajñānāvyāpanāt svaviṣayatvalakṣaṇasvaprakāśatvaniṣedhāt| kiṃ tu yathā tattadarthasya svavyavahārānukūlacaitanyābhedo'rthāparokṣyam, evaṃ tattavdyavahārānukūlacaitanyasya tattadarthābhedo jñānāparokṣyam| tathā ca caitanyadharma evāparokṣyam, na tvanumititvādivad antaḥkaraṇavṛttidharmaḥ| ata eva sukhādiprakāśarūpe sākṣiṇi, svarūpasukhaprakāśarūpe caitanye cāparokṣyam| na ca ghaṭādyaindriyakavṛttau tadanubhavavirodhaḥ| anubhavasya vṛttyavacchinnacaitanyagatāparokṣyaviṣayatvopapatteḥ| nanūktaṃ jñānārthayorāparokṣyaṃ hṛdayādigocaraśābdavṛttiśābdaviṣayayoratiprasaktam| tatra daivāt tadācit vṛttiviṣayasaṃsarge sati vṛttyavacchinnacaitanyasya viṣayāvacchinnacaitanyasya cābhedābhivyakteravarjanīyatvāditi ced na| parokṣavṛtterviṣayāvacchinnacaitanyagatājñānanivartanākṣamatayā tatrājñānenāvṛtasya viṣayacaitanyasyānāvṛtena vṛttyavacchinnasākṣicaitanyenābhedābhivyakterabhāvādāparokṣyāprasakteḥ| ata eva jīvasya saṃsāradaśāyāṃ vastutassatyapi brahmābhede na tadāparokṣyam| ajñānāvaraṇakṛtabhedasattvāt| na caivaṃ brahmaṇo jīvāparokṣyāsambhavādasarvajñatvāpattiḥ| ajñānasya īśvaraṃ pratyanāvārakatayā taṃ prati jīvabhedānāpādanāt| yad ajñānaṃ yaṃ pratyāvarakam, tasya taṃ pratyeva svāśrayabhedāpādakatvāt| ata eva caitrajñānena tasya ghaṭājñāne nivṛtte anivṛttaṃ maitrājñānaṃ maitraṃ pratyeva viṣayacaitanyasya bhedāpādakamiti na caitrasya ghaṭāparokṣyānubhavānupapattirapi| nanvevaṃ vṛttiviṣayacaitanyābhedābhivyaktilakṣaṇasyāparokṣyasya svaviṣayacaitanyagatājñānanivṛttiprayojyatve tasyājñānanivṛttiprayojakatvāyogād jñānamātramajñānanivartakaṃ bhavediti ced, na| "yad jñānamutpadyamānaṃ svakāraṇamahimnā viṣayasaṃsṛṣṭamevotpadyate, tadevājñānanivartakam" iti viśeṣaṇād, aindriyakajñānānāṃ tathātvāt| evaṃ ca śabdādutpadyamānamapi brahmajñānaṃ sarvopādānabhūtasvaviṣayabrahmasaṃsṛṣṭameva utpadyata iti tasyājñānanivartakatvamajñānanivṛttau tanmūlabhedapravilayādāparokṣyaṃ cetyupapadyatetarām| nanvevamadhyayanagṛhītavedāntajanyenāpi tajjñānena mūlājñānanivṛttyā āparokṣyaṃ kiṃ na syāt| na ca tatsattāniścayarūpatvābhāvād nājñānanivartakamiti vācyam| tathā'pi kṛtaśravaṇasya nirvicikitsaśābdajñānena tannivṛttyā mananādivaiyarthyāpattiriti ced, na| satyapi śravaṇād nirvicikitsajñāne cittavikṣepadoṣeṇa pratibandhād ajñānānivṛttyā tannirākaraṇe manananididhyāsananiyamavidhyarthānuṣṭhānasyārthavattvād bhavāntarīya mananādyanuṣṭhānanirastacittavikṣepasya upadeśamātrād brahmāparokṣyasya iṣyamāṇatvāccetyāhuḥ || 10 || athaivamapi kṛtanididhyāsanasya vedāntajanyabrahmajñāneneva ghaṭādijñānenāpi brahmājñānanivṛttiḥ kiṃ na syāt| na ca tasya brahmāviṣayatvād na tato brahmājñānanivṛttiriti vācyam| `ghaṭassan' ityādibuddhivṛtteḥ sadrūpabrahmaviṣayatvopagamāt| na ca tatra ghaṭādyākāravṛttyā tadajñānanivṛttau svataḥ sphuraṇādeva tadavacchinnaṃ caitanyaṃ saditi prakāśate, na tasya ghaṭādyākāravṛttiviṣayatvamiti vācyam| tadabhāve ghaṭaviṣayaṃ jñānaṃ tadavacchinnacaitanyaviṣayamajñānamiti bhinnaviṣayeṇa jñānena tadajñānanivṛtterayogād jaḍe āvaraṇakṛtyābhāvena ghaṭasyājñānāviṣayatvāt| na ca ghaṭādivṛttestadavacchinnacaitanyaviṣayatve'pi akhaḍānandākāratvābhāvād na tato mūlājñānanivṛttiriti vācyam| vedāntajanyasākṣarātkāre'pi tadabhāvāt| na hi tatrākhaṇḍatvamānandatvaṃ vā kaścidasti prakāraḥ| vedāntānāṃ saṃsargagocarapramājanakatvalakṣaṇākhaṇḍārthatvahānāptteḥ| na ca vedāntajanyajñānādeva tannivṛttiniyama iti vācyam| klṛptājñānanivartakatvaprayojakasya rūpasya jñānāntare'pi sadbhāve tathā niyantumaśakyatvāt| naca ghaṭādyākāravṛttiviṣayasyāvacchinnacaitanyasyāpi kalpitatvena yanmūlājñānaviṣayabhūtaṃ satyamanavacchinnaṃ caitanyam, tadviṣayatvābhāvād ghaṭādivṛttīnāṃ nivartyatvābhimatājñānasamānaviṣayatvalakṣaṇaṃ klṛptaṃ prayojakameva nāstīti vācyam| tatrāvacchedakāṃśasya kalpitatve'pyavacchedyāṃśasyākalpitamūlājñānaviṣayacaitanyarūpatvāt tasya kalpitatve ghaṭavajjaḍatayā avasthā'jñānaṃ pratyapi viṣayatvāyogenāvasthā'jñānasya mūlājñānaviṣayākalpitacaitanyaviṣayatvasya vaktavyatayā tannivartakaghaṭādijñānasyāpi tadviśaṣayatvāvaśyambhāvena tatpakṣe'pi tato mūlājñānanivṛttiprasaṅgasyāparihārāt| atrāhurācāryāḥ na caitanyaṃ cakṣurādijanyavṛttiviṣayaḥ| "na sandṛśe tiṣṭhati rūpamasya na cakṣuṣā paśyati kaścanainam| parāñci khāni vyatṛṇatsvayaṃbhūstasmātparāṅ paśyati nāntarātman"|| ityādiśrutyā tasya paramāṇvādivat cakṣurādyayogyatvopadeśād, `aupaniṣadam' itiviśeṣaṇācca| na ca `sarvapratyayavedye vā brahmarūpe vyavasthite'| ityādivārtikaviredhaḥ| tasya ghaṭādyākāravṛttyudaye sati āvaraṇābhibhavāt svaprabhaṃ sadrūpaṃ brahma `ghaṭassan'iti ghaṭavad vyavahāryaṃ bhavatītyaupacārikaghaṭādivṛttivedyatvaparatvāt| āvaraṇābhibhāvakatvaṃ ca ghaṭādijñānasya ghaṭādiviṣayatvādeva upapannam| ghaṭāderapyajñānaviṣayatvād `ghaṭaṃ na jānāmi' `ghaṭajñānena ghaṭājñānena ghaṭājñānaṃ naṣṭam'iti avasthā'jñānasya ghaṭādiviṣayatvānubhavāt| na ca tatrāvaraṇakṛtyābhāvādajñānāṅgīkāro na yuktaḥ, tadbhāsakasya yatadavacchinnacaitanyasyāvaraṇādeva tadaprakāśopapatteriti vācyam| uktabhaṅgyā jaḍasya sākṣādajñānaviṣayatvapratikṣepe'pi jaḍāvacchinnacaitanyaprakāśasyājñānenāvaraṇam, tato nityacaitanyaprakāśasaṃsarge'pi jaḍaspa `nāsti', `na prakāśate' ityādivyavahārayokagyatvamiti paramparayā ajñānaviṣayatvamiti paramparayā ajñānaviṣayatvābhyupagamāt sākṣātparamparayā vā yadajñānāvaraṇīyam, tadviṣayatvasyaiva jñānasya tadajñānanivartakatvaprayojakaśarīre niveśāt| na caivaṃ ghaṭādīnāmuktarītyā mūlājñānaviṣayatvamapīti ghaṭādisākṣātkārādeva mūlājñānanivṛttyāpātaḥ| phalabalāttadajñānakāryātiriktatadviṣayaviṣayakatvasyaiva tannivartakatve tantratvāt|| athavā mūlājñānasyaiva jaḍaṃ na viṣayaḥ| avasthā'jñānānāṃ tvavacchinnacaitanyāśritānāṃ tattjjaḍameva viṣayaḥ| anyathā cākṣuṣavṛttyā candanakhaṇḍacaitanyābhivyaktau tatsaṃsargiṇau gandhasyāpyāparokṣyāpatteḥ| tadanābhivyaktau candanatadrūpayorapyaprakāśāpatteḥ| na ca cākṣuṣavṛttyā candanatadrūpāvacchinnacaitanyayorabhivyaktyā tayoḥ prakāśaḥ, gandhākāravṛttyabhāvena gandhāvacchinnacaitanyasyānabhivyaktyā tasyāprakāśaśceti vācyam| caitanyasya dviguṇīkṛtya vṛttyayogena ekadravyaguṇānāṃ svāśraye sarvatra vyāpya vartamānānāṃ pṛthak pṛthag gaganāvacchedakatvasyeva caitanyāvacchedakatvasyāpyasambhavāt| teṣāṃ svāśrayadravyāvacchinnacaitanyenaiva śuktīdamaṃśāvacchinnacaitanyena śuktirajatavata prakāśyatayā tasyābhivyaktau gandhasyāpi prakāśasya, anabhivyaktau rajatāderapyaprakāśasya cāpatteḥ| na ca gandhāṃkāravṛkattyuparakte eva caitanye gandhaḥ prakāśate iti niyamaḥ, prakāśasaṃsargasyaiva prakāśamānaśabdārthatvenāsatyāmapi tadākāravṛttāvanāvṛtaprakāśasaṃsarge aprakāśamānatvakalpanasya viruddhatvāt| abhivyaktasya gandhopādānacaitanyasya gandhāsaṃsargoktyasambhavāt| tasmād yathā caitrasya ghaṭavṛttau taṃ pratyāvarakasyaivājñānasya nivṛttiriti tasyaiva viṣayaprakāśo, nānyasya, tathā tattadviṣayākāravṛttyā tattadāvarakājñānasyaiva nivṛtterna viṣayāntarasyāparokṣyam, `anāvṛtārthasyaiva saṃvidabhedāda āparokṣyam' ityabhyupagamāditi| pramātṛbhedeneva viṣayabhedenāpyaketra caitanye avasthā'jñānabhedasya vaktavyatayā avasthā'jñānānāṃ tattajjaḍaviṣayakatvamiti ghaṭādivṛttīnāṃ nāvasthā'jñānanivartakatve kā cidanupapattiḥ| na vā mūlājñānanivartakatvāpattiḥ| na caivamapi jīvaviṣayāyā ahamākāravṛttermūlājñānanivartakatvāpattiḥ| tasyāḥ svayaṃprakāśamānacitsaṃvalitācidaṃśamātra viṣayatvāt| `so'ham' iti pratyabhijñāyā api svayamprakāśacaitanye antaḥkaraṇavaiśiṣṭyena saha pūrvāparakālavaiśiṣṭyamātraviṣayatvena caitanyaviṣayatvābhāvāditi|| kecittu ghaṭādivṛttīnāṃ tattadavacchinnacaitanyaviṣayatvamabhyupagamya `sarvamānaprasaktau ca sarvamānaphalāśrayāt| śrotavyetivacaḥ prāha vedāntāvarurutsayā'|| iti vāterkīkteḥ śrotavyavākyārthavedāntaniyamavidhyanusāreṇa vedāntajanyameva niyamādṛṣṭasahitaṃ brahmajñānapratibaddhaṃ brahmājñānanivartakamiti ghaṭādijñānānna tannivṛttiprasaṅga ityāhuḥ|| anye tu tattvamasyādivākyajanyaṃ jīvabrahmābhedagocarameva jñānaṃ ṇūlājñānanivartakam, mūlājñānasya tadabhedagocaratvāditi na caitanyasvarūpamātragocarād ghaṭādijñānāttannivṛttiprasaṅgaḥ| na cābhedasya tattvāvedakapramāṇabodhyasya caitanyātireke dvaitāpatteḥ `caitanyamātramabhedaḥ' iti tadgocaraṃ ghaṭādijñānamapyabhedagocaramiti vācyam| na hyabhedajñānamiti viṣayato viśeṣaṃ brūmaḥ, kiṃ tu tattvaṃpadavācpārthadharmidvayaparāmarśādirūpakāraṇaviśeṣādhīnena svarūpasaṃbandhaviśeṣeṇa caitanyaviṣayatvameva tadabhedajñānatvam| yathā hi viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyatatsambandhagācaratvāviśeṣe'pi viśiṣṭajñānasya viśeṣaṇajñānādikāraṇaviśeṣādhīnasvarūpasambandhaviśeṣeṇa tattritayagocaratvabheva samūhālambanavyāvṛttaṃ viśiṣṭajñānatvam, yathā vā `sthāṇutvapuruṣatvavān' iti āhāryavṛttivyāvṛttaṃ saṃśayatvaṃ viṣayato triśeṣānirūpaṇāt, tathā ghaṭādāvapi `so'yaṃ ghaṭaḥ' ityādijñānasya svarūpasambandhaviśeṣeṇa ghaṭādiviṣayatvameva kevalaghaṭaśabdādijanyajñānavyāvṛttaṃ tadabhedajñānatvam| atiriktābhedānirūpaṇāt abhāvasādṛśyādīnāmadhikaraṇapratiyogyādibhiḥ svarūpasambandhayuktānāmadhikaraṇenādhārādheyabhāvarūpaḥ svarūpasambandhaviśeṣaḥ, pratiyoginā pratiyogyanuyogibhāvarūpa ityādiprakāreṇa svarūpasambandhe avāntaraviśeṣakalpanāvad vṛttīnāṃ viṣaye'pi saṃyogadādātmyayoratiprasaktyā viṣayairviṣayaviṣayibhāvarūpasvarūpasambandhavatīnāṃ viṣayaviśeṣanirūpaṇāsambhave klṛpte eva svarūpasambandhe avāntaraviśeṣakalpanenābhedajñānatvādiparasparavailakṣaṇyanirvāhācca| evaṃ brahmajñānasyābhedākhyakiñcitsaṃsargagocaratvānabhyupagamād na vedāntānāmakhaṇḍārthatvahānirapītyāhuḥ|| nanu ghaṭādijñānavad brahmājñānasyāpi na mūlājñānānivartakatvaṃ yuktam| nivartakatve tadavasthānāsahiṣṇutvarūpasya virodhasya tantratvāt, kāryasya copādanena saha tādṛśavirodhābhāvāditi cenna| kāryakāraṇayoranyatra tādṛśavirodhādarśane'pi ekaviṣayajñānājñānaprayuktasya tādṛgvirodhasyātra sattvāt kāryakāraṇayorapyagnisaṃyogapaṭayostādṛśavirodhasya dṛṣṭeśca| na cāgnisaṃyogādavayavavibhāgaprakriyayā asamavayikāraṇasaṃyoganāśādeva paṭanāśaḥ, nāgnisaṃyogāditi vācyam| dagdhapaṭe'pi pūrvasaṃsthānānuvṛttidarśanena mudgaracūrṇīkṛtaghaṭavad avayavavibhāgādarśanāt tatrāvayavibhāgādikalpanāyā aprāmāṇikatvāt| nāpi tatra tantūnāmapi dāhena samavāyikāraṇanāśāt paṭanāśa iti yuktam| aṃśutantvādibhissaha yugapadeva paṭasya dāhadarśanena kramakalpanāyogāt| yato'dhastānnāvayavanāśaḥ, tatrāvayave agnisaṃyogādeva nāśasya vācyatvāt||11|| nanvastvetadevam, tathā'pi savilāsājñānanāśakamidaṃ brahmajñānaṃ kathaṃ naśyed, nāśakāntarasyābhāvāditi ced, yathā katakarajaḥ salilena saṃyujya pūrvayuktarajo'ntaraviśleṣaṃ janayat svaviśleṣamapi janayati, tathā'|ḍatmanyadhyasyamānaṃ brahmajñānaṃ pūrvādhyastasarvaprapañcaṃ nivartayat svātmānamapi nivartayatīti kecit|| anye tu anyannivartya svayamapi nivṛttau dagdhalohapītāmbunyāyamudāharanti|| apare tvatra dagdhatṛṇakūṭadahanodāharaṇamāhuḥ| na ca dhvaṃsasya pratiyogyatiriktajanyatvaniyamaḥ| aprayojakatvāt| nirindhanadahanādidhvaṃse vyabhicārācca| na ca dhvaṃsasya pratiyogimātrajanyatve'tiprasaṅgāt kāraṇāntaramavaśyaṃ vācyam, nirindhanadahanādidhvaṃse'pi kālādṛṣṭeśvarecchādikāraṇāntaramastīti vācyam| atiprasaṅgāparijñānāt| na ca ghaṭādidhvaṃsasyāpi kāraṇāntaranirapekṣatvaṃ syādityatiprasaṅgaḥ. dhvaṃsamātre kāraṇāntaranairapekṣyānabhidhānāt| na ca ghaṭadhvaṃsadṛṣṭāntena brahmajñānadhvaṃsasya kāraṇāntarāpekṣāsādhanam| taddṛṣṭāntena mudgarapatanāpekṣāyā api sādhanāpatteḥ| nāpi jñānadhvaṃsatvasāmyād ghaṭajñānādidhvaṃsasyāpi kāraṇāntaranairapekṣyaṃ syādityatiprasaṅgaḥ| sendhanānaladhvaṃsasya jalasekādidṛṣṭakāraṇāpekṣatve'pi nirindhanānaladhvaṃsasya tadanapekṣatvavad, jāgrajjñānadhvaṃsasya viredhiviśeṣaguṇāntarāpekṣatve'pi suṣuptipūrvajñānadhvaṃsasya tadanapekṣatve'pi tannivartakajñānadhvaṃsasya tadanapekṣatvopapatteḥ| nāpi kāraṇāntaranairapekṣye svotpattyuttarakṣaṇe taeva brahmādhyastanikhilaprapañcadāhena tadantargatasya tasyāpi tadeva dāhābhyupagamāt| nirindhanadahanadhvaṃsanyāyena brahmajñānadhvaṃsasyāpi kāladṛṣṭeśvarecchādikāraṇāntarajanyatve'pyavirodhācca| sarvaprapañcanivṛttyanantaramekaśeṣasya brahmajñānasya nivṛttirityanabhyupagamena yugapat sarvadāhe pūrvakṣaṇe cidavidyāsambandharūpasya dravyāntararūpasya vā kālasya, īśvaraprasādarūpasyāntaḥkaraṇaguṇaviśeṣasya vā'dṛṣṭasya, anyeṣāṃ ca sattvāt| na ca tatrajñānātiriktakāraṇāpekṣaṇe brahmajñānasyāmithyātvaprasaṅgaḥ, jñānaikanivartyatvaṃ mithyātvamityabhyupagamāditi vācyam| jñānāghaṭitasāmagtyanivartyatve sati jñānanivartyatvasya tadarthatvāt| "nānyaḥ panthāḥ" itiśruterapi tatraiva tātparyāt| ato yukta eva dagdhadāhyadahanādinyāyaḥ|| kecittu vṛttirūpaṃ brahmajñānaṃ nājñānatanmūlaprapañcanibarhakam| ajñānasya prakāśanivartyatvaniyamena jaḍarūpavṛttinivartyatvāyogāt| kiṃ tu tadārūḍhacaitanyaprakāśastannivartakaḥ| svarūpeṇa tasyājñānādisākṣitayā tadanivartakatve'pyakhaṇḍākāravṛttyupārūḍhasya tasya tannivartakatvopapatteḥ| `tṛṇaderbhāsikā'pyeṣā sūryadīptistṛṇaṃ dahet| sūryakāntamupāruhya tannyāyaṃ tatra yojayet||' ityabhiyuktokteḥ| evaṃ ca yathā kiñcit kāṣṭhamupāruhya grāmanagarādikaṃ dahan vahnirdahatyeva tadapi kāṣṭham, tathā caramavṛttimupāruhya nikhilaprapañcamunmūlayannakhaṇcaitanyaprakāśastannivartane'pi prakalpate iti na tannāśe kā cidanupapattirityāhuḥ|| anye tu brahmajñānamajñānasyaiva nivartakam| jñānājñānayoreva sākṣādvirodhāt| prapañcasya tūpādānanāśānnāśa iti prapañcāntargatasya brahmajñānasyāpi tata eva nāśaḥ| na ca prapañcasya jñānānivartyatve mithyātvānupapattiḥ| prapañcanivṛttessākṣād jñānajanyatvābhāve'pi jñānajanyājñānanāśajanyatvāt| `sākṣarāt paramparāyā vā jñānaikanivartyatvaṃ mithyātvam' ityaṅgīkārāt| evaṃ ca tattvasākṣātkārodaye'pi jīvanmuktasya dehādipratibhāsa upapadyate| prārabdhakarmaṇā pratibandhena tattvasākṣātkārodaye'pi prārabdhakarmatatkāryadehādipratibhāsānuvṛttyopādānāvidyāleśānuvṛttyupapatteḥ| ajñānavat prapañcasyāpi sākṣād brahmasākṣātkāranivartyatve nāyamupapadyate| virodhini brahmasākṣātkāre sati prārabdhakarmaṇaḥ svayamevāvasthānāsambhavenāvidyāleśanivṛttipratibandhakatvāyogādityāhuḥ|| <4> caturthaḥ paricchedaḥ| atha ko'yamavidyāleśaḥ, yadanuvṛttyā jīvanmuktiḥ?| āvaraṇavikṣepaśaktimatyā mūlāvidyāyāḥ prārabdhakarmavartamānadehādyanuvṛttiprayojako vikṣepaśaktyaṃśa iti kecit|| kṣālitalaśunabhāṇḍānuvṛttalaśunavāsanākalpo 'vidyāsaṃskāra ityanye|| dagdhapaṭanyāyenānuvṛttā mūlāvidyaivetyapare|| sarvajñātmaguravastuvirodhisākṣātkārodaye leśato'pyavidyā'nuvṛttyasambhavāj jīvanmuktiśāstraṃ śravaṇādividhyarthavādamātram| śāstrasya jīvanmuktipratipādane prayojanābhāvāt| ataḥ kṛtanididhyāsanasya brahmasākṣātkārodayamātreṇa savilāsavāsanā'vidyānivṛttirityapi kañcit pakṣamāhuḥ||1|| atha kecamavidyānivṛttiḥ?| ātmaiveti brahmariddhikārāḥ| na ca tasya nityasiddhatvād jñānavaiyarthyam| asati jñāne'narthahetvavidyāyā vidyamānatayā anarthamapi tiṣṭhediti tadanveṣaṇād| `yasmin satyagrimakṣaṇe yasya sattvam, yadvyatireke cābhāvaḥ, tat tatsādhyam'iti lakṣaṇānurodhenātmarūpāyā apyavidyānivṛtteḥ jñānasādhyatvācca| jñāne satyagrimakṣaṇe ātmarūpāvidyānivṛttisattvam, tadvyatireke tatpratiyogyavidyārūpastadabhāva iti uktalakṣaṇasattvāt|| ātmānyaivāvidyānivṛttiḥ| sā ca na satī, advaitahāneḥ| nāpyasatī, jñānasādhyatvāyogāt| nāpi sadasadrūpā, virodhāt| nāpyanirvācyā, anirvācyasya sāderajñānepādanakatvaniyamane muktāvapi tadupādānājñānānuvṛttyāpatteḥ, jñānanivartyatvāpatteśca| kiṃ tu uktaprakāracatuṣṭayottīrṇā pañcamaprakāretyānandabodhācāryāḥ|| avidyāvattannivṛttirapyanirvācyaiva| na ca tadanuvṛttau tadupādānājñānasyāpyanuvṛttiniyamād anirmokṣaprasaṅgaḥ| tadanuvṛttau pramāṇābhāvāt| utpatteḥ prathamasamayamātrasaṃsargibhāvavikāratvavad nivṛtterapi caramasamayamātrasaṃsargibhāvavikāratvopapatteḥ| ata eva yathā pūrvaṃ paścācca `nivartiṣyate, nivṛttaḥ' iti bhāvibhūtabhāvena vyavahriyamāṇāyā nivṛtteścaramasamayamātre `nivartate, naśyati, dhvaṃsate' iti vartamānavyapadeśaḥ| nivṛtteranuvṛttau tu ciraśakalita'pi ghaṭe `idānīṃ nivartate' ityādivyavahāraḥ syāt| ākhyātānāṃ prakṛtyarthagatavartamānatvādyarthābhidhāyitvāt| nanu ca teṣāṃ svābhihitasaṅkhyāśrayaprakṛtyarthakartṛkarmagatavartamānatvādyarthābhidhāyakatvam, svābhihitaprakṛtyarthānukūlavyāpāragatavartamānatvādyarthābhidhāyakatvaṃ vā'stu| tathā ca nivṛttikiyākartuściracūrṇitasya ghaṭasya, tadgatanivṛttyanukūlavyāpārasya cāvartamānatvād noktātiprasaṅga iti ced, na| ādye utpanne'pi ghaṭe `utpadyate' iti vyavahārāpatteḥ| utapattikriyākarturghaṭasya vartamānatvāt| dvitīye āmavātajaḍīkṛtakalevare utthānānukūlayatnavati utthānānudaye'pi `uttiṣṭhati'iti vyavahārāpatteḥ| ākhyātārthasya prakṛtyarthabhūtotthānānukūlasya yatnarūpavyāpārasya vartamānatvāt| tasmāt prakṛtyarthagatameva vartamānatvādi ākhyātārtha iti dhvaṃsasya sthāyitve ciranivṛtte'pi ghaṭe `nivartate' iti vyavahāro durvāraḥ| yadi ca mudgarādiśakalite ghaṭe dhvaṃso nāma kaścidabhāvastatpratiyogikaḥ sthāyī bhūtalādyāśrita upeyate, tadā kapālamālāpasaraṇaṃ tadanapasaraṇe'pi maṇikaśarāvādikapālavyāvṛttakapālasaṃsthānaviśeṣādarśane na kimiti sa pratyakṣo na syāt. kapālasaṃsthānaviśeṣādinā'numeyo ghaṭādidhvaṃso na pratyakṣa iti cet, tarhi tena mudgarapātakālīnasya utapattivad bhāvavikārarūpatayā pratiyogyāśritadhvaṃsasyānumānaṃ sambhavatīti na tataḥ paścādanuvartamānapratiyogyadhikaraṇāśritābhāvarūpadhvaṃsasiddhiḥ| `iha bhūtale ghaṭadhvaṃsaḥ' iti bhūtale dhvaṃsādhikaraṇatvavyavahārasya `iha bhūtale ghaṭa utapannaḥ' itivat bhāvavikārayuktapratiyogyadhikaraṇatvaviṣayatvopapatteḥ| ghaṭadhvaṃsānantaraṃ bhūtale ghaṭābhāvavyavahārasya ghaṭāpasaraṇānantaraṃ tadabhāvavyavahāravat samayaviśeṣasaṃsargyatyantābhāvālambanatopapattyā dhvaṃsaviṣayatvasyākalpanīyatvācca| evaṃ sati ghaṭotpatteḥ pūrvaṃ tadabharāvavyavahāro'pyatyantābhāvena caritārtha iti prāgabhāvo'pi na syāditi cet, so'pi mā bhūt| nanvevaṃ `prāgabhāvādhārakālaḥ pūrvakālaḥ, dhvaṃsādhāra uttarakālaḥ' iti nirvacanāsambhavāt kāle pūrvottarādivyavahāraḥ kimālambanassyāt| ghaṭādiṣu pratiyogitvādivyavahāravadakhaṇ‍ḍakiñciddharmagocaro'stu| abhāvarūpasthāyidhvaṃsābhyupagame'pi teṣu dhvaṃsatvāderakhaṇḍasya vaktavyatvāt| na ca janyābhāvatvarūpaṃ sakhaṇḍameva dhvaṃsatvam| dhvaṃsaprāgabhāvarūpasya ghaṭasya tad‌dhvaṃsatvāpatteḥ| na ca saptamapadārtharūpābhāvatvaṃ vivakṣitam| ghaṭasya prāgabhāvaṃ pratyapi dhvaṃsatvābhāvaprasaṅgena ghaṭakāle prāgabhāvottarakālatvavyavahārasya nirālambanatvāpatteḥ| na ca pratiyogyatiriktaḥ prāgabhāvadhvaṃsaḥ| tathā sati tulyanyāyatayā dhvaṃsaprāgabhāvo'pi pratiyogyatiriktaḥ syāditi prāgabhāvadhvaṃsasyāpi prāgabhāvo'nyaḥ, tasyāpi kaścid, dhvaṃsaḥ, tasyāpi prāgabhāvo'nya ityaprāmāṇikānavadhikadhvaṃsaprāgabhāvakalpanāpatteḥ| na cānyad dhvasatvamātmāśrayādiśūnyaṃ nirvaktuṃ śakyam| evaṃ prāgabhāvatvamapītyanyatra vistaraḥ| tasmānna pūrvaṃ prāgabhāvaḥ, na ca paścāt dhvaṃsābhāvaḥ| madhye paraṃ kiyatkālamanirvacanīyotpattisthitidhvaṃsarūpabhāvavikāravān ghaṭādyadhyāsaḥ. evaṃ cāvidyānivṛttirapi brahmasākṣātkārodayānantarakṣaṇavartī kaścidbhāvavikāra iti tasyā muktāvanuvṛttyabhāvānna tadanirvācyatve kaściddoṣa ityadvaitavidyācāryāḥ || 2 || nanvevamavidyānivṛtteḥ kṣaṇikatvaṃ mokṣaḥ sthirapuruṣārtho na syāditi ced, bhrānto'si| na hyavidyānivṛttiḥ svayameva puruṣārtha iti tasyā jñānasādhyatvamupeyate| tasyāḥ sukhaduḥkhābhāvetaratvāt| kiṃ tvakhaṇḍānandāvarakasaṃsāraduḥkhahetvavidyocchede akhaṇḍānandasphuraṇam, saṃsāraduḥkhocchedaśca bhavatīti tadupayogitayā tasyāstattvajñānasādhyatvamupeyate|| citsukhācāryāstu duḥkhābhāvo'pi muktau na svataḥpuruṣārthaḥ| sarvatra duḥkhābhāvasya svarūpasukhābhivyaktipratibandhakābharāvatayā sukhaśeṣatvāt sukhasyaiva svataḥpuruṣārthatvam| anyeṣāṃ sarveṣāmapi taccheṣatvamiti sukhasādhanatājñānasyaiva pravartakatve sambhavati duḥkhābhāvasyāpi svataḥparuṣārthatvaṃ parikalpya tatsādhanaprarvatakasaṅgrahāya iṣṭasādhanatājñānasya icchāviṣayatvapraveśena gurughaṭitasya pravartakatvakalpanāyogāt| na ca duḥkhābhāva eva svataḥpuruṣārthaḥ| taccheṣatayā sukhaṃ kāmyamiti vaiparītyāpattiḥ| bahukāladuḥkhasādhye'pi kṣaṇikasukhajanake ninditagrāmyadharmādau pravṛttidarśanāt| tatra kṣaṇikasukhakālīnaduḥkhābhāvasya puruṣārthatve tadarthaṃ bahukāladuḥkhānubhavāyogāt| na ca tatra kṣaṇikasukhasya puruṣārthatve'pi doṣataulyam| bhāvarūpe sukhe utkarṣapakarṣayoranubhavasiddhatvena kṣaṇamapyatyutkṛṣṭasukhārthaṃ bahukāladuḥkhānubhavopapatteḥ| duḥkhābhāve cotkarṣāpakarṣāsambhavāt| tasmānmuktau saṃsāraduḥkhanivṛttirapyavidyānivṛttivat sukhaśeṣa ityanavacchinnānandaprāptireva svataḥpuruṣārtha ityāhuḥ || 3 || nanvanavacchinnānandaḥ pratyagrūpatayā nityameva prāptaḥ| satyam| nityaprāpto'pi anavacchinnānandastamāvṛtya nīta ityakṛtārthatā'bhūt| nivartitāyāṃ ca tasyāṃ nirastanikhilānarthavikṣepe svakaṇṭhagatavismṛtakanakābharaṇavat prāpyate ivetyaupacārikī tasya prāptavyateti kecit|| anye tu saṃsāradaśāyāṃ `nāsti na prakāśate' iti vyavahārayogyatvarūpājñānāvaraṇaprayuktasya `mama niratiśayānando nāsti' iti pratyayasya sarvāsiddhatvāt tadālambanabhūtaḥ kaścid brahmānandasyābhāvaḥ kālpaniko yāvadavidyamanuvartate| avidyānivṛttau ca tanmūlatvānnivartate iti `yasmin satyagrimakṣaṇe' ityādilakṣaṇānurodhena mukhyameva tasya prāpyatvamityāhuḥ|| apare tu avedyasyāpuruṣārthatvātsaṃsāradaśāyāṃ sadapyanavacchinnasukhamāparokṣyābhāvānna puruṣārthaḥ| na ca svarūpajñānenāparokṣyaṃ tadā'pyasti, tasya sarvadā svarūpasukhābhinnatvāt| vṛttijñānenāparokṣyaṃ tu na muktāvapīti vācyam| na hi svavyavahārānukūlacaitanyābhedamātramāparokṣyam| ghaṭāvacchinnacaitanyābhivyaktau tadabhinnasya ghaṭagandhasyāpi āparokṣyāpatteḥ| kiṃ tvanāvṛtārthasya tadabhedaḥ. tathā cānāvṛtatvāṃśastattvasākṣātkāre satyeveti niratiśayasukhāparokṣyasya puruṣārthasya vidyāprāpyatvaṃ yuktamityāhuḥ|| itare tu astu vyavahārānukūlacaitanyābhedamātramāparokṣyam| tathā'pyajñānamahimnā jīvabhedavaccidānandabhedo'pi adhayasta iti saṃsāradaśāyāṃ puruṣāntarasya puruṣāntaracaitanyāparokṣyavad anavacchinnasukhāparokṣyamapi nāsti| ajñānanivṛttau tu cidānandabhedupravilayāttadāparokṣyamiti tasya vidyāsādhyatvamityāhuḥ||4|| atha vidyodaye satyupādhivilayādapetajīvabhāvasya kim īśvarabhāvāpattirbhavati, uta śuddhacaitanyamātrarūpeṇāvasthānam? iti vivecanīyam| ucyate ekajīvavāde tadekājñānakalpitasya jīveśvaravibhāgādikṛtsnabhedaprapañcasya tadvidyodayo vilayānnirviśeṣacaitanyarūpeṇaivāvasthānam| anekajīvavādamabhyupagamya baddhabhuktavyavasthā'ṅgīkāre'pi yadyapi kasyacidvidyodaye tadavidyākṛtaprapañca'nuvartate, tathā'pi `jīva iveśvaro'pi pratibimbaviśeṣaḥ' itipakṣe muktasya bimbabhūtaśuddhacaitanyarūpeṇaivāvasthānam| anekopādhiṣvekasya pratibimbesati ekopādhivilaye tatpratibimbasya bimbabhāvenaivāvasthānaucityena pratibimbāntaratvāpatterapi durvāratvenāvacchedapakṣa iva muktasya punarbandhāpatteḥ| ata evānekajīvavāde avacchedapakṣo nādriyate| yadavacchedena muktistadavacchedenāntaḥkaraṇāntarasaṃsarge punarapi bandhāpatteḥ| `pratibimbo jīvaḥ, bimbasthānīya īśvaraḥ, ubhayānusyūtaṃ śuddhacaitanyam' iti pakṣe tu muktasya yāvatsarvamukti sarvajñatvasarvakartṛtvasarveśvaratvasatyakāmatvādiguṇaparameśvarabhāvāpattiriṣyate| yathā anekeṣu darpaṇeṣu ekasya mukhasya pratibimbe sati ekadarpaṇāpanaye tatpratibimbo bimbabhāvenāvatiṣṭhate, na tu mukhamātrarūpeṇa, tadānīmapi darpaṇāntarasannidhānaprayuktasya mukhe bimbatvasyānapāyāt, tathaikasya brahmacaitanyasyānekeṣūpādhiṣu pratibimbe sati e smin pratibimbe vidyodaye tena tadupādhivilaye tatpratibimbasya bimbabhāvenāvasthānāvaśyambhāvāt| na ca muktasyāvidyā'bhāvāt satyakāmatvādiguṇaviśiṣṭasarveśvaratvānupapattiḥ| tadavidyā'bhāve'pi tadānīṃ baddhapuruṣāntarāvidyāsattvāt| na hīśvarasyeśvaratvaṃ satyakāmādiguṇavaiśiṣṭyaṃ ca svāvidyākṛtam, tasya nirañjanatvāt, kiṃ tu baddhapuruṣāvidyākṛtameva tatsarvameṣṭavyam| na ca "yathākraturasmin loke puruṣo bhavati tathetaḥ pretya bhavati" "taṃ yathāyathopāsate" ityādiśrutiṣu saguṇopāsakānāmapīśvarasāyujyaśravaṇād mukteḥ saguṇavidyāphalāviśeṣapattiḥ| saguṇopāsakānāmakhaṇḍasākṣātkārābhāvād nāvidyānivṛttiḥ, na vā tanmūlāhaṅkārādervilayaḥ| āvaraṇānivṛtternākhaṇḍānandasphuraṇam| `jagadvyāpāravarjaṃ prakaraṇādasannihitatvācca' `bhogamātrasamyāliṅgācca' ityādisūtroktanyāyena teṣāṃ parameśvareṇa bhogasamye'pi saṅkalpamātrāt svabhogopayuktadivyadehendriyavanitādisṛṣṭisāmarthye'pi sakalajagatsṛṣṭisaṃhārādisvātantryalakṣaṇaṃ na niravagrahamaiśvaryam| muktānāṃ tu nissādhibandhamīśvarabhāvaṃ prāptānāṃ tatsarvamiti mahato viśeṣasya sadbhāvāt| na ca parameśvarasya raghunāthādyavatāre tamasvitvaduḥkhasaṃsargādiśravaṇād muktānāmīśvarabhāve punarbandhāpattiḥ| tasya vipraśāpāmoghatvādisvakṛtamaryādāparipālanāya kathaṃcid bhṛguśāpādisatyatvaṃ pratyāyayituṃ naṭavadīśvarasya tadabhinayamātraparatvāt| anyathā tasya nityamuktatvaniravagrahasvātantryasamābhyadhikarāhityādiśrutivirodhāt| tasmādyāvatsarvamukti parameśvarabhāvo muktasyeti bimbeśvarabhāve na kaściddoṣaḥ|| ayameva pakṣaḥ śrutisūtrabhāṣyādyanuguṇaḥ| tathā hi samanvayādhyāye tāvad "dahara uttarebhyaḥ" ityādhikaraṇe "atha yadidamasmin brahmapure daharaṃ puṇḍarīkaṃ veśma daharo'smin antarākāśaḥ" ityādiśrutinirdiṣṭo daharākāśo na bhūtākāśa, nāpi jīvaḥ, kiṃ tu parameśvaraḥ, uttarebhyo vākyaśeṣebhyaḥ| "ubhe asmin dyāvāpṛthivī antareva samāhite yāvānvā ayamākāśastāvāneṣo'ntarhṛdaya ākāśa eṣa ātmā'pahatapāpmā vijaro vimṛtyurviśoko vijighatso'pipāsaḥ satyakāmaḥ satyasaṅkalpaḥ" ityādinā pratipādyamānebhyo dyāvāpṛthivyādyādhāratvalakṣaṇaguṇebhyo hetubhya iti nirṇīya `uttarāccedāvirbhūtasvarūpastu' itisūtrāntareṇa daharavidyānantaramindraprajāpatisaṃvāde "ya ātmā'pahataprāpmā" ityādinā apahatapāpmatvādiguṇāṣṭakayuktamātmānamupadeśyamupakṣipya "ya eṣo'kṣiṇi puruṣo dṛśyate eṣa ātmā"iti jāgradavasthāyāṃ draṣṭṛtvenākṣisannihitasya "ya eṣa svapne mahīyamānaścarati eṣa ātmā" iti svapnāvasthāpannasya "tadyatraitatsuptassamastassamprasannaḥ svapnaṃ na vijānāti eṣa ātmā" iti suṣupabtyavasthāpannasya "eṣa samprasādo'smāccharīrāt samutthāya paraṃ jyotirupasampadya svena rūpeṇābhiniṣpadyate sa uttamaḥ puruṣaḥ" ityavasthātrayottīrṇasya ca jīvasyopadeśāj jīve'pyasti apahatapāpmatvādiguṇāṣṭakamiti na taddaharākāśasya parameśvaratvanirṇāyakam| "ya eṣa svapne" ityādiparyāyeṣu pratiparyāyam "etaṃ tveva te bhūyo'nuvyākhyāsyāmi" iti śravaṇena sphuṭasvapnādijīvaliṅgānāṃ dvitīyādiparyāyaṇāmeva jīvaviṣayatvam, prathamaparyāyasya ca brahmaviṣayatvamiti codyānavakāśādityāśaṅkya tatra caturthaparyāye nirūpyamāṇaḥ sakalabandhavinirmuktatvenāvirbhūtasvarūpo jīvaḥ pratipādyaḥ| na tu saṃsārikāvasthābhedakaluṣitaḥ| tatra satyasaṅkalpatvādiguṇabādhāt| avasthātrayopanyāsasya tattadavasthādoṣābhidhānena caturthaparyāyopadeśaśoṣatvapratipatteriti samādadhānaḥ sūtrakāraścaturthaparyāye pratipādyasya muktasyeśvarabhāvāpattiṃ spaṣṭamāha| tadabhāve mukte'pi satyasaṅkalpatvādyayogād anukrāntasya guṇāṣṭakasya īśvarādanyatrāpi bhāve kṛtaśaṅkāparihārālābhācca| tasmin sūtre `tasmādavidyāpratyupasthāpitamapāramārthikaṃ jaivaṃ rūpaṃ kartṛtvabhoktṛtvarāgadveṣādidoṣakaluṣitamanekānarthayogi tadvilayanena tādviparītamapahatapāpmatvādiguṇakaṃ pārameśvaraṃ rūpaṃ vidyayā pratipadyate' iti bhāṣyakāro'pyatispaṣṭaṃ muktasya saguṇeśvarabhāvāpattimāha| avirodhādhyāye'pi "eṣa hyeva sādhu karma kārayati taṃ yamebhyo lokebhya unninīṣata eṣa u evāsādhu karma kārayati taṃ yamadho ninīṣate" ityādiśrutestattatkarmakartṛtvena tattatkarmakārayitṛtvena ca upakāryopakārakabhāvenāvagatayorjīveśvarayoraṃśāṃśibhāvarūpasambandhanirūpaṇārthatvenāvatārite `aṃśo nānāvyapadeśāt' ityadhikaraṇe `jīvasyeśvarāṃśatvābhyupagame tadīyena saṃsāraduḥkhabhogena īśvarasyāpi duḥkhitvaṃ syāt| yathā loke hastapādādyanyatamāṃśagatena duḥkhenāṃśino devadattasyāpi duḥkhitvaṃ, tadvat| tataśca tatprāptānāṃ mahattaraṃ duḥkha prāpnuyāt, tato varaṃ pṛrvāvasthā saṃsāra evāstviti samyag jñānānarthakyaprasaṅgaḥ' iti śaṅkāgranthena bhāmatyādiṣu spaṣṭīkṛtam| bimbapratibimbabhāvakṛtāsaṅkaramupādāya samāhitena bhāṣyakāro muktasya īśvarabhāvāpattiṃ spaṣṭīcakāra| sādhanādhyāye'pi `sandhye sṛṣṭirāha hi' ityadhikaraṇe svapnaprapañcasya mithyātve vyavasthāpite tatra mithyābhūte svapnaprapañce jīvasya kartṛtvamāśaṅkya `parābhidhyānāttu tirohitaṃ tato hyasya bandhaviparyayau' itisūtreṇa `jīvasyeśvarābhinnatvāt sadapi satyasaṅkalpatvādikamavidyādoṣāttirohitamiti na tasya svapnaprapañce sraṣṭṭatvaṃ sambhavati' iti vadan sūtrakāraḥ `tatpunastirohitaṃ sat paramabhidhyāyato yatamānasya jantorvidhūtadhvāntasya timiratiraskṛteva dṛkchaktirauṣadhaviryādīśvaraprasādātsaṃsiddhasya kasyacidevāvirbhavati, na svabhāvata eva sarveṣāṃ jantūnām' iti tatsūtrābhiprāyaṃ varṇayan bhāṣyakāraśca muktasya svapnasṛṣṭyādyupayogisatyasaṅkalpatvādyabhivyaktyaṅgīkāreṇa parameśvarabhāvāpattiṃ spaṣṭīcakāra| phalādhyāye'pi "svena rūpeṇābhiniṣpadyate" iti mucyamānaviṣayāyāṃ śrutau `kena rūpeṇābhiniṣpattirvivakṣitā' iti bubhutsāyā `brāhmeṇa jaiminirupanyāsādibhyaḥ' itisūtreṇa brāhmaṃ rūpamapahatapāpmatvādi satyasaṅkalpatvādyavasānaṃ sarvajñatvasarveśvaratvādi ca, tenābhiniṣpattiḥ "ya ātmā'pahatapāpmā" ityādyupanyāsena "sa tatra paryeti jakṣan krīḍan ramamāṇaḥ strībhirvā yānairvā" ityādyaiśvaryāvedanena ceti jaiminimatam| `cititanmātreṇa tadātmakatvādityauḍḍalomiḥ' ityanantarasūtreṇa "evaṃ vā are'yamātmā'nantaro'bāhyaḥ kṛtsnaḥ prajñānaghana eva" ityādiśrutyā `caitanyamātramātmasvarūpam' ityavagateḥ `tanmātreṇābhiniṣpattiḥ'iti matāntaraṃ copanyasya `evamapyupanyāsātpūrvabhāvādavirodhaṃ bādarāyaṇaḥ' iti siddhāntasūtreṇa `vastudṛṣṭyācaitanyamātratve'pi pūrvoktaguṇakalāpasya upanyāsādyavagatasya māyāmayasya baddapuruṣavyavahāradṛṣṭyā sambhavāda na śrutidvayavirodhaḥ' iti avirodhaṃ vadan sūtrakāraḥ, sūtratrayamidamuktārthaparatvena vyākurvan bhāṣyakāraśca muktasyeśvarabhāvāpattiṃ spaṣṭamanumene| bhābhatīnibandhaprabhṛtayaśca śrutyupabṛṃhitamidaṃ sūtrajātaṃ, bhagavato bhāṣyakārasya udāhṛtaṃ vacanajātaṃ ca tathaivānvavartanta| na ca śrutyupabṛṃhitasya etāvataḥ sūtrabhāṣyavacanajātasya aiśvaryamajñānatirohitaṃ sad dhyānādabhivyajyata ityavocat|| śarīriṇaḥ sūtrakṛdasya yattu tadabhyupetyoditamuktahetoḥ|| iti saṃkṣepaśārīrakoktarītyā'bhyupetyavādatvaṃ yuktaṃ vaktum| tasmānmuktānāmīśvaramāvāpatteravaśyābhyupeyatvādetadasambhava eva pratibimbeśvaravāde doṣaḥ| tadāhuḥ kalpatarukārāḥ `na māyāpratibimbasakya vimuktairupasṛpyatā' iti| etadasambhavaśca ekajīvavādapāramārthikajīvabhedavādayorapi doṣaḥ| yattu kaiścit dvaitibhirucyate bhedasya pāramārthikatvena muktau jīvasyeśvarabhāvābhāve'pi tatrāpīśvara iva pṛthagapahatapāpmatvādiguṇasambhavādavirodha iti| tattuccham| tathā sati jīvasyāpahatapāpmatvādikamastīti na tasya brahmaliṅgatvamiti śaṅkāparihārālābhena `uttarāccedāvirbhūtasvarūpastu'iti sūtravirodhāt| `brāhmeṇa jaiminiḥ' itisūtre jīvagatasyāpahatapāpmatvādeḥ `upanyāsādhibhyaḥ'ityātrādiśabdārthatvena pareṣāmapyabhimatasya "jakṣan krīḍan ramamāṇaḥ"ityādiśrutyuditasya jakṣaṇādeśca brāhmatvanirdeśavirodhācca| bhede teṣāṃ guṇānāṃ satyatvena `cititanmātreṇa'itisūtroktasya muktajīvānāṃ caitanyamātratvasya `evamapi' iti siddhāntasūtre'ṅgīkāravirodhācca, `sampadyāvirbhāvaḥ' ityadhikaraṇavirodhācca| tatra hi `svena rūpeṇābhiniṣpadyate', iti śrutau āgantunā kenacidrūpeṇābhiniṣpattirnocyate svenaśabdavaiyarthyāpatteḥ| yena rūpeṇa āgantunā svayamabhiniṣyadyate tasyātmīyatvasyāvaktavyatvāt| tasmādātmavācisvaśabdopādānāda nityasiddhena svasvarūpeṇaivābhiniṣpattirvivakṣitā, na tu kena ciddharmeṇeti vyavasthāpitam| kiñcedamapahatapāpmatvādi jāvasya muktāvāgantukaṃ cet, `sampadyāvirbhāvaḥ' iti muktāvāgantukarūpaniṣedhena `parābhidhyānāttu tirohitam' `uttarāccedāvirbhūtasvarūpastu' ityapahatapāpmatvāderbandhamuktyostirobhāvāvirbhāvapratipādanena ca virodhaḥ syāditi nityasiddhaṃ vācyamiti bandhasya mithyātvaṃ durvāram| nityasiddhamapahatapāpmatvaṃ hi sarvadā pāpmarahitatvam| na ca vastutaḥ sarvadā pāpmarahite pāpmasambandhaḥ, tanmūlakakartṛtva bhoktṛtvasambandho vā pāramārthikaḥ sambhavati| evaṃ ca jīvasyeśvarābhedo'pi durvāraḥ| śrutibodhyatadabhedavirodhibandhasya satyatvābhāvāt| anyathā saṃsāriṇi nityāsigaddhasatyasaṅkalpatirodhānoktyayogācca| na hi jāvasya saṃsāradaśāyāmanuvartamāno yatkiñcidarthagocaraḥ kaścidastyavitathasaṃkalpastirohi ta iti parairapīṣyate| kiṃ tvīśvarasya yannityasiddhaṃ niravagrahaṃ satyasaṅkalpatvam, tadeva jīvasya saṃsāradaśāyāmīśvarābhedanabhivyaktyā svakīyatvenānavabhāsamānaṃ taṃ prati tirohitamityeva samarthanīyamiti ghaṭṭakuṭīprabhātavṛttāntaḥ| nanvapahatapāpmatvaṃ na pāpmavirahaḥ kiṃ tu pāpmahetukarmācaraṇe'pi pāpotpattipratibandhakaśaktiyogitvami na tasya nityasiddhatvena bandhasya mithyātvaprasaṅgaḥ| evaṃ satyasaṅkalpatvamapi śaktirūpeṇa nirvācyamiti neśvarābhedaprasaṅga iti cet, maivam| evaṃ śabdārthakalpane pramāṇabhāvāt| na hi pāpajananapratibandhikā śaktiḥ saṃsārarūpaparibhramaṇadaśāyāṃ pāpānutpattyarthaṃ kalpanīyā| tadānīṃ tadutpatteriṣṭatvāt| vidyotayaprabhṛti tu vidyāmāhātmyādevāśleṣaḥ `tadadhigama uttarapūrvaghayoraśleṣavināśau tadvyapadeśāt' iti sūtreṇa darśitaḥ| tata eva muktāvapyaśleṣa upapadyata iti vyarthā śaktikalpanā| tasmādudāhṛtaśrutisūtrānusāribhirmuktajīvānāṃ yāvatsarvamukti vastusaccaitanyamātratvāvirodhibaddhapuruṣavidyākṛtaniravagrahaiśvaryatadanuguṇaguṇakalāpaviśiṣṭaniratiśayānandasphuraṇasamṛddhanissandhibandhaparameśvarabhāvāpattirādartavyeti siddham|| vidvadgurorvihitaviśvajidadhvarasya śrīsarvatomukhamahāvratayājisūnoḥ| śrīraṅgarājamakhinaḥ śritacandramaulerastyappadīkṣita iti prathitastanūjaḥ || 1 || tantrāṇyadhītya sakalāni sadā'vadātavyākhyānakauśalakalāviśadīkṛtāni| āmnāyamūlamanurudhya ca sampradāyam siddhāntabhedalavasaṅgrahamityakārṣīt || 2 || siddhāntarītiṣu mayā bhramadūṣitena syādanyathā'pi likhitaṃ yadi kañcidasya|| saṃśodhane sahṛdayāḥ sadayā bhavantu satsampradāyapariśīlananirviśaṅkāḥ ||3|| || iti śāstrasiddhāntaleśasaṅgrahe caturthaḥ paricchedaḥ|| || samāpto'yaṃ granthaḥ||
